* Team interview (skills \\& mindset)
* Case or challenge
* Founder chat \\& offer We move fast - and give clear feedback.

Ready to help transform buildings into better places to live, own, and finance? Let’s talk.#### **About us** At credium, we’re on a mission to make owning the new renting - by building the digital infrastructure that powers simple and sustainable homeownership.

We enable mortgage banks, property owners, and real estate professionals to understand buildings better and faster - from floor plans to energy efficiency, from renovation potential to solar readiness.

We're a VC-funded startup with major banks as customers and a purpose that matters.

title: Director, SaaS Migration Program Execution (m/w/d)
description:
Part of the Wolters Kluwer’s CP \\& ESG division, our award-winning CCH® Tagetik expert solution provides the strategic \\& financial intelligence platform that enables CFOs and their peers, in global enterprises, to propel their strategy with faster and better-informed decisions. With embedded AI and state-of-the-art governance, the open and extensible platform easily connects leading operational solutions to create enterprise-wide insights, drive growth, and navigate change for our customers to gain the greatest value, today and tomorrow.

**Role Summary**
---------------- The **Director, SaaS Migration Program Execution (m/w/d)**, will be responsible for overseeing the entire migration process for **Wolters Kluwer CCH Tagetik’s existing customer base**. This position will own the transition from legacy deployment and commercial models to the strategic cloud platform and the latest packaging and pricing models. Responsibilities include:

* Managing the migration of commercial models for cloud customers who are still using legacy models.
* Leading both the commercial and technical migration for on-premise customers.

This role is accountable for converting migration strategy into operational execution, coordinating cross-functional teams across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Cloud Operations, Legal, Finance and Product.

The position requires a highly hands-on leader capable of driving customer migrations at scale while managing complex customer-specific situations, particularly within the on-premise installed base where commercial, contractual, technical and organizational complexity is highest.

The role serves as the central point of accountability for migration outcomes, capacity planning, execution governance, risk management, and business value realization.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Migration portfolio management**

* Own the global SaaS migration portfolio, maintaining a consolidated view of all migration opportunities across customer cohorts and geographies.
* Translate migration strategy into executable annual and quarterly migration plans, customer migration waves and measurable business outcomes.
* Own customer prioritization, migration sequencing and cohort governance, continuously reassessing customer readiness, migration complexity and commercial opportunity throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Recalibrate migration priorities and customer cohorts based on new customer information, migration outcomes and changing business priorities.

**Migration program leadership**

* Lead execution of the global SaaS migration roadmap across all migration cohorts and regions.
* Establish and operate the Migration Execution Office as the central coordination function across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Consulting Partners, Cloud Operations, Finance, Legal and Product.
* Orchestrate end-to-end execution across all participating functions, ensuring effective planning, dependency management, handovers and accountability throughout the migration process.
* Ensure migration execution remains aligned with strategic objectives, customer commitments, available capacity and financial targets.
* Drive consistent execution through standardized migration methodologies, operational playbooks, templates and governance processes.

**Migration governance \\& performance management**

* Establish and facilitate the governance structure supporting the migration program including executive decision forums, operational reviews and performance reporting.
* Define, monitor and continuously improve migration KPIs, dashboards and reporting to provide transparency on migration progress, customer status, commercial outcomes, delivery performance and business case realization.
* Identify systemic bottlenecks, operational risks and recurring execution challenges, driving corrective actions across the organization.
* Own migration exception management, ensuring customer, commercial, contractual, technical and operational escalations are resolved efficiently and consistently.
* Ensure adherence to commercial guardrails, approval processes, pricing governance and migration policies.

**Capacity planning \\& execution readiness**

* Define migration capacity requirements across Professional Services, Consulting Partners, Cloud Operations and supporting functions, balancing migration demand with available delivery resources.
* Ensure migration readiness across all participating functions prior to each migration wave, including resource availability, governance, customer preparation and operational planning.
* Provide executive recommendations on resource allocation, outsourcing opportunities, partner utilization and execution scalability.

**Customer migration execution**

**On-premise customer migration (technical \\& commercial)**

* Oversee end-to-end execution of commercial and technical migrations from customer qualification through technical assessment, commercial design, implementation, testing, product transition and post-go-live optimization.
* Coordinate cross-functional delivery teams throughout the migration lifecycle while proactively resolving delivery risks and execution blockers.
* Ensure consistent execution quality across regions through standardized migration methodologies and operational standards.

**Cloud customer migration (commercial)**

* Lead the commercial migration program for existing cloud customers transitioning to the new packaging and pricing model.
* Partner with Sales and Renewal teams to execute structured, cohort-based commercial migrations aligned to predefined customer lifecycle triggers such as renewals, cloud expansion opportunities and cross-sell events.
* Balance customer retention, migration velocity, commercial standardization and ARR realization while ensuring compliance with commercial governance and negotiation guardrails.

**Continuous improvement**

* Capture lessons learned from completed migration waves and incorporate them into future migration planning, execution standards and governance processes.
* Continuously improve migration methodologies, planning assumptions, operational playbooks, reporting and customer engagement models.
* Drive increased standardization and scalability of migration execution while maintaining flexibility for strategic customer situations.
* Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and optimize migration processes across commercial and technical functions.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum Bachelor’s in Engineering, Information Technology, Business or related field.
* 10+ years of experience leading large-scale transformation, cloud migration, SaaS transition or customer lifecycle programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise customer implementations and migrations.
* Strong program management, stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Experience driving operational execution across commercial, technical and services organizations.

**Preferred**

* Experience with enterprise software, SaaS business models or subscription transitions.
* Experience managing global customer transformation programs.
* Knowledge of cloud migration methodologies and enterprise application modernization.
* Familiarity with commercial transformation, pricing migrations and customer retention programs

**Critical success measures**

* Migration wave execution versus plan.
* On-prem ARR converted to cloud ARR.
* Customer retention during migration.
* Migration cycle time and throughput.
* Delivery capacity utilization.
* Business case realization.
* Executive stakeholder satisfaction.

Your mission is to turn Isar's vertical integration and the data it generates into an unfair advantage.

This is not a maintenance role. Day-to-day operations need to be reliable, but the real mandate is bigger: build the digital backbone that allows the company to move at mission speed. You set direction, create focus, remove noise, make trade-offs, and hold the organization accountable for outcomes. Functional leads own day-to-day execution; you own the operating model, roadmap, priorities, standards, and business impact.

You will work in a high-ownership environment with little room for bureaucracy, politics, or theoretical transformation work. We need someone who can think strategically, operate pragmatically, and drive execution relentlessly. Someone who understands that great IT is not about tools — it is about enabling people, processes, data, and decisions to move faster.

The role works closely with Information \\& Cybersecurity as an independent counterpart responsible for security governance, risk, compliance, threat detection, and assurance.

* Lead and develop the Enterprise IT \\& Data organization and its functional leads.

* Partner with Information \\& Cybersecurity on operational security standards.

title: Business Development Lead - Nordics & DACH
description:
Kangal AI builds frontier artificial intelligence that creates information advantage for those solving the world's most complex problems. * A defining, founding role owning an entire region in an early, venture-backed company, with a competitive salary and meaningful equity.
* Work that matters, for clients operating at the highest level.
* Founder-level access and real ownership, working shoulder to shoulder with the founders.

title: Internal Control (Senior) Associate
description:
**About CF Assurance (CF A)** Our mission at Controlling and Finance Assurance (CF A) is to provide objective, factual and independent foresight to help Siemens be excellent and to improve the overall success of the company. As a business partner to Siemens management, we leverage our expertise in a wide range of topics in order to create an impact. We offer an inspiring, diverse and inclusive environment for our people to develop professionally and personally. Our core values – being respectful, curious, humble and open – define how we work together as a department.

To deliver on our vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, CF A offers a unique Growth and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong learning and encourage our people towards continuous upskilling as a natural part of their career. This is your chance to build your network within the company and become part of a diverse, international and innovative team.

**About CF A Internal Control (IC)** CF A Internal Control (IC) is the central governance department for the internal control system at Siemens. We create impact through the definition and continuous improvement of a state-of-the-art internal control methodology and the support of our global internal control community in applying it. In close collaboration with corporate governance owners, we maintain a central repository of globally harmonized control requirements (the ‘Policy and Control Masterbook’) as well as our ‘Risk and Internal Control (RIC) Manual’ as the foundation for the internal control process.

As Siemens transforms into **ONE Tech Company**, our IC department plays a critical role in ensuring robust Internal Controls across the enterprise, especially over Financial Reporting (ICFR) and Sustainability Reporting (ICSR). We are at the forefront of leveraging innovative technologies – including **Generative AI** – to enhance control effectiveness, drive automation, and support Siemens' strategic growth levers.

We are looking for a dedicated, results-oriented pioneer who leverages their expertise and inspires others to give their best. You are comfortable challenging established approaches and driving change where it creates value. **Be bold and apply now** to become a part of our CF Assurance Internal Control team in Munich or Erlangen.

**Accelerate your career and change the world of tomorrow with us.**

**What You'll Do:**

* **Drive Innovation with Generative AI (GenAI):** Ideate, design, and implement innovative use cases leveraging **GenAI** to transform IC processes – covering ideas from automated control testing and risk assessment to intelligent documentation and anomaly detection. You will be a key driver in exploring how GenAI can enhance control effectiveness, efficiency, and insights.
* **Shape the Future of Internal Controls Methodology:** Be part of the team responsible for the effective yet efficient design of Siemens' Internal Control methodology, especially for **IT controls** of systems relevant for financial reporting (e.g., ITGC/ITAC) and sustainability reporting.
* **Own and Evolve the IC Framework:** Take responsibility for the IT Controls part of our Internal Control System (ICS) methodology and update the **RIC Manual** to reflect new methodological developments, regulatory requirements, and technological advancements.
* **Enable and Empower the Global IC Community:** Coach ICS professionals throughout the world on all aspects of the internal control system and become the primary contact for IT Controls methodology and emerging topics like platform- and GenAI-driven controls.
* **Develop and Deliver Training \\& Guidance:** Create and deliver Internal Control trainings, guidance materials, and presentations to support the global rollout of methodologies and tools, fostering a culture of continuous learning and excellence.
* **Collaborate with the External Auditor:** Align and discuss Internal Control topics and methodology with the external auditor to ensure compliance and best-practice alignment.
* **Keep Management informed:** Understand global patterns regarding IT controls of the Siemens Group and evaluate control deficiencies, leveraging data analytics and AI-driven insights where applicable, and be confident to bring relevant topics into management’s view.
* **Contribute Beyond IC:** Engage with the broader CF Assurance function and expand your experience through assignments as a guest auditor, contributing to the **'CF A innovation process'**, or supporting cross-functional transformation initiatives.

**Your Profile for "Making the Future Possible":**

* **Strong Academic Foundation:** Degree in business administration, information systems, finance, or related studies, ideally a master’s degree.
* **Proven IC \\& IT Controls Expertise:** **Extensive professional experience** in Internal Control (including ICFR) with a focus on **IT controls**. You understand the role IT systems like SAP ERP play in an ICFR control landscape and how systems enable IT Application Controls (ITACs) and are protected by IT General Controls (ITGCs).
* **Passion for Innovation \\& GenAI:** Strong interest and ideally hands-on experience in **Generative AI** and its application to business processes. You are excited to explore, ideate, and pilot GenAI use cases that drive automation, intelligence, and efficiency in internal controls and risk management.
* **Curiosity for other relevant Technologies:** Genuine interest in topics like **RPA, low-code apps, AI/ML**, and their potential benefits and challenges in ICFR and ICSR environments. You stay current with technological trends and are eager to experiment and learn.
* **Growth Mindset:** You enjoy taking on new challenges and growing with them. You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable pioneering new approaches.
* **International \\& Intercultural Experience:** Work experience in an international business setting and intercultural collaboration is a strong plus, reflecting Siemens' global footprint and diverse teams.
* **Adaptability \\& Results Orientation:** You impress with your ability to adapt to a fast-growing, dynamic environment, your focus on results, teamwork, and customer orientation.
* **Excellent Communication Skills:** Strong communication skills in **German and English** (written and spoken) to engage effectively with global stakeholders.
* **Digital Proficiency:** Very good **MS Office skills** and comfort working with digital tools and platforms. Willingness and ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies is essential.

**Why Join Us?**

* Contribute to strategic initiatives around **GenAI, digital business, and innovation** in the context of **internal controls**.
* Work at the intersection of **governance, technology, and innovation**, shaping the future of internal controls in a global technology leader.
* Access to **continuous learning and development** opportunities, including exposure to cutting-edge technologies like GenAI, and the chance to grow your career across Siemens.
* Join a **diverse, international, and inclusive team** that values curiosity, collaboration, and bold thinking.

**Ready to pioneer the future of Internal Controls? Apply now and make an impact with us!**

title: Duales Studium angewandte Wirtschaftsinformatik

An der OTH Amberg-Weiden verbindest du Informatik, Wirtschaft und moderne Technologien miteinander. Je nach deinen Interessen kannst du außerdem eigene Schwerpunkte setzen – zum Beispiel in **KI-Management**, **E-Commerce Management**, **Smarte Logistik** oder **Digital Business Consulting**. So gestaltest du dein Studium individuell und bereitest dich optimal auf deinen Berufseinstieg vor.

title: Product Design Intern (f/m/d)
description:
#### **Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO** LiveEO turns satellite data into business-ready risk intelligence. Using Earth observation and AI, we help businesses detect and act on critical risks across infrastructure networks and global supply chains, earlier, at scale, and with less manual effort.

You'd be joining the team behind Treeline, our vegetation management solution for utilities. Treeline shows grid operators where vegetation threatens power lines.

You'd work on a new capability within it: wildfire prevention and storm. Wildfire is about where fuel and clearance risk concentrate ahead of a season, and where mitigation crews should go first. Storm is about which parts of the network are exposed when a front is forecast, and where restoration should be prioritised afterwards. Same underlying picture of the vegetation, two very different decisions built on top of it.#### **Your challenge** This is an internship with real ownership. You'll take real problems from our roadmap and carry them through the full design process — framing the problem, ideating, validating solutions with customers, handing over to development and iterating on them. The people using them are utility vegetation planners and grid operations teams making decisions about where to send crews.

You'll do that with the support and mentorship of our Senior Product Designer for Treeline, who will review and guide your work throughout — a weekly 1:1, twice-weekly design reviews with design team on live work, and a structured handover in your first month of everything she knows about the product and its users. You'll have someone experienced alongside you at every stage, and increasing independence as you go. Day to day you'll sit with the wildfire and storm PM and engineer, part of the squad from week one. **This is an onsite role in Berlin.** **We're looking for someone who can commit to 5 days a week, 40 hours, for the full 6-month term, working in person with the squad.** We're hiring this role with the intention of making a permanent offer if it's the right fit on both sides. **What you'll do*** **Take real problems and work them through end-to-end:** framing, ideation, exploration, and high-craft UI, with a senior designer reviewing and guiding along the way.
* **Understand how these customers actually work today**: under real users’ needs and use that to frame the problems worth solving. Including validating your designs with customers and internal stakeholders.
* **Hand over and iterate with development**: working with engineers through build and release, learning how to handover to development and seeing your work live and reviewing that it’s up to spec.
* **Contribute to our design foundations**: learn new processes as tools change, but not to miss out on the fundamentals that are important for our work. Being able to contribute components and patterns with proper states, variants, and documentation, built pragmatically rather than exhaustively.
* **Work fast and iteratively** — prototype, test, and refine, we move quickly and can iterate as we deliver

#### **Your profile** We're hiring for how you think and how you work, not for experience you haven't had time to accumulate yet.* **A genuine willingness to learn**, and openness, you will not know everything and receiving and applying feedback as well as picking things up quickly are key for success on our team
* **You speak up and bring ideas.** We want your perspective in the room from the start, not once you've settled in.
* **Open to feedback** — you take critique well, iterate fast, and treat a review as useful rather than personal.
* **Curiosity about a scientific domain.** Vegetation, wildfire behaviour, and storm exposure are genuinely interesting problems, and we're looking for someone who finds them so and asks questions.
* **Strong visual craft** — components, states, spacing, and typography that hold up without constant correction.
* **Systems thinking**: you see patterns and reuse, not one-off screens.
* **Judgement with reference material** — you adapt an established pattern with reasoning behind it, rather than reproducing it because it's there.
* **Self-direction**: you take the initiative to organise and validate your own work rather than waiting to be handed a plan.
* **You raise blockers early** and aren't afraid to ask questions. Going quiet when you're stuck is the one thing that genuinely doesn't work here.
* **Final-year or recently completed studies** in design, HCI, or an equivalent self-taught path, with at least one project involving real users, however small.
* **Fluent English**, written and spoken — all documentation, critique, and collaboration run through it.

**Nice to have*** HTML/CSS to read code and communicate with the development team.
* Curiosity about AI tools and how they fit into a design workflow.

**Not required:** any satellite, remote-sensing, utility, or wildfire background. We can teach the domain in six months — we can't teach curiosity about it.#### **Your Benefits**

* Real design ownership from week one — not a shadow internship, you'll take actual roadmap problems through to shipped features
* Direct mentorship from our Senior Product Designer, with weekly 1:1s and twice-weekly design reviews on live work
* A small, high-trust team where your work actually matters — you'll sit with the wildfire and storm PM and engineer as part of the squad
* Exposure to how satellite data and AI translate into real business decisions for enterprise customers
* BVG ticket subsidy
* Urban Sports Membership
* A spacious, lively office in the heart of Kreuzberg

#### **About us** LiveEO is a well funded startup founded in 2018 and based in Berlin. Our primary service is modelling risk to our customers’ assets and infrastructure from vegetation, ground deformation and change detection. We currently have around 160 employees from all over the world with a variety of backgrounds

**Benefits**

* Onboarding
* Duzen
* Werte
* Nachhaltigkeit
* Firmenevents
* Teamsport
* Weiterbildung
* Entwicklungschancen
* Altersvorsorge
* Gewinnbeteiligung
* Corporate Benefits
* Empfehlungsprogramm
* Krankenversicherung
* Massagen
* E-Bike- \\& Fahrrad-Leasing
**Onboarding**
-------------- Um dir den Einstieg bei uns so angenehm wie möglich zu gestalten, erstellen wir dir deinen individuellen Onboarding-Plan. Mit Hilfe unserer motivierten Mitarbeitenden, lernst du sowohl unser Team als auch deinen neuen Arbeitsplatz kennen, wirst optimal eingearbeitet und hast stets eine Ansprechperson für offene Fragen. Bei uns bist du nicht allein!

**Duzen**
--------- Ein offenes und familiäres Verhältnis ist für uns das A und O! Daher bieten wir dir von Anfang an das "Du" an.

**Werte**
--------- Wir in der Binder Gruppe haben ein klar definiertes Wertesystem, an dem wir uns tagtäglich orientieren können. So liegen uns besonders Themen wie Respekt, Offenheit, Klarheit, aber auch Qualität und Vertrauen am Herzen. Wir arbeiten als Team gemeinsam und sind füreinander da. Sei auch du ein Teil davon!

**Nachhaltigkeit**
------------------ Da wir sehr zukunftsorientiert sind, ist uns das Thema Nachhaltigkeit extrem wichtig. Wir sind von Climate Partner als "klimaneutrales Unternehmen" zertifiziert und stellen unsere Trauringe aus 100 % recyceltem Gold und Platin her. Darauf sind wir sehr stolz! Mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir auch in Zukunft nachhaltig produzieren und dadurch unseren Teil zum Klima- und Umweltschutz beitragen.

**Firmenevents**
---------------- Gemeinsam mit dir möchten wir unsere Erfolge feiern. Dazu veranstalten wir regelmäßig After-Work-Barbecues, machen gemeinsame Ausflüge und laden zu unserer jährlichen Weihnachtsfeier ein.

**Teamsport**
------------- Du bist gerne sportlich aktiv? Wir auch! Komm mit uns zu regionalen Läufen oder nimm an unserem jährlichen Skiausflug teil.

**Weiterbildung**
----------------- Zeig uns was du kannst! Wir wollen dich nicht nur fordern, sondern auch fördern. Daher hast du bei uns die Möglichkeit, dich jederzeit weiterzubilden und neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen.

**Entwicklungschancen**
----------------------- Bei uns hast du garantiert einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und auch ein Positionswechsel innerhalb der Binder Gruppe ist kein Problem. Wir bieten dir also die besten Zukunftsperspektiven unter knapp 400 Mitarbeitenden im Raum Pforzheim/Enzkreis.

**Altersvorsorge**
------------------ Auch für deine Zukunft ist gesorgt! Denn bei uns erhalten alle Mitarbeitenden einen Arbeitgeberanteil für ihre Altersvorsorge. Damit wollen wir uns schon vorab bei dir für deine Leistungen bedanken und dir deine Sorgen in Bezug auf die Zukunft nehmen.

(nur bei Festanstellung)

**Gewinnbeteiligung**
--------------------- Da du als ein wichtiger Bestandteil unseres Teams natürlich mit für unseren Erfolg verantwortlich bist, bekommst du von uns als kleines Dankeschön auch eine finanzielle Beteiligung am Unternehmensgewinn ausgezahlt.

(nur bei Festanstellung)

**Corporate Benefits**
---------------------- Wir wollen, dass es dir bei uns an nichts fehlt! Daher bieten wir dir viele interessante Extras, wie beispielsweise tolle Angebote von bekannten Marken wie Adidas, Apple und mehr.

**Empfehlungsprogramm**
----------------------- Du kennst jemanden, der auf der Suche nach einer neuen Herrausforderung ist und vielleicht sogar schon Erfahrungen im Schmuckbereich gesammelt hat? Sprich uns gerne deine Empfehlung aus und erhalte bei Einstellung einen attraktiven Bonus als Dankeschön für deine Mithilfe!

(nur bei Festanstellung)

**Krankenversicherung**
----------------------- Deine Gesundheit liegt uns sehr am Herzen, deswegen bekommst du von uns jährliche Zuschüsse über unsere betriebliche Zusatz-Krankversicherung.

**Massagen**
------------ Trotz Arbeitsalltag einfach mal zur Ruhe kommen? Wir machen es möglich! Du hast regelmäßig die Möglichkeit, dich für eine unserer professionellen Massagen einzutragen und dich mal so richtig verwöhnen zu lassen.

**E-Bike- \\& Fahrrad-Leasing**
--------------------------------- Du möchtest gerne Sport mit Klimaschutz verbinden? Dann wäre ein E-Bike oder Fahrrad bestimmt das Richtige für dich. Über unser Unternehmen kannst du ganz leicht E-Bikes und Fahrräder zu super Konditionen leasen. Damit tun wir dir, aber auch der Umwelt, etwas Gutes.

**Warum wir**
------------- Unsere 180 Mitarbeitenden bilden ein gut eingespieltes Team, dem der persönliche und wertschätzende Umgang viel bedeutet. Gemeinsam erarbeiten wir neue, richtungsweisende Lösungen – der Grund, warum wir im Bereich der Trauringproduktion führend sind.

Möchtest du auch ein Teil unseres Teams werden? Wir würden gerne mit dir durch gute und schlechte Zeiten gehen! Als traditionsbewusstes und modernes Unternehmen sind wir auf Wachstumskurs und deshalb immer auf der Suche nach motivierten Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern, die Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte sein wollen.

**Deine Bewerbung**
------------------- Klingt interessant? Dann sende uns gerne deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse) idealerweise als PDF Datei mit Angabe deines frühesten Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung zu.

title: CLP Intelligence Specialist
description:
**Location:** Belgium or Northern Germany

**About us** At Certis Belchim, we work every day to further develop and broaden the landscape of crop protection and Plant Health. Our ambition is to provide integrated programmes that combine biorational and chemical solutions, thereby supporting growers and supply chain partners in addressing the challenges of sustainable plant health and crop production, as well as the increasingly stringent requirements within the value chain.

Thanks to our Japanese shareholders and strategic suppliers, we have access to cutting edge technologies and innovative expertise in the field of Plant Health and crop protection. This unique combination of international innovation strength and local market knowledge enables us to develop distinctive, future proof solutions.

Our European headquarters are located in Londerzeel (Belgium) and Utrecht (The Netherlands). From more than 23 countries worldwide, over 800 dedicated colleagues work together towards a shared goal: contributing to healthy crops, sustainable agriculture and a resilient food supply chain.

Within Certis Belchim, there is an open and informal working atmosphere, with colleagues who are passionate about their profession and the impact they make within Plant Health. We offer a working environment in which professionals are given the space to take initiative, develop themselves and accelerate their careers. Through a pragmatic approach and strong collaboration, we jointly create a positive impact on our sector and beyond.

**About your team** You will join the Safety, Labels \\& Packaging team, part of our global Formulation and Industrial Technology (FIT) organisation. This highly specialised team plays a critical role in ensuring that our products are compliant, safe and ready for market.

Working closely with Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Product Development and colleagues across our international network, you will operate at the intersection of science, regulation and business operations.

The team combines deep technical expertise with a strong focus on continuous improvement. Collaboration is central to the role, as you will work regularly with colleagues across Europe and beyond, as well as with external suppliers, consultants and industry partners.

This is an excellent opportunity to become a recognised expert within Certis Belchim while helping to shape and enhance our future compliance processes.

**How you’ll make impact** By ensuring high-quality Safety Data Sheets, monitoring regulatory developments, and translating complex CLP requirements into practical actions, you will directly support the safe and compliant commercialization of our products. Your expertise will help the organization stay ahead of regulatory changes while continuously improving how we work.

**About y** **our job** As our CLP Intelligence Specialist, you will serve as the global subject matter expert on Classification, Labelling and Packaging (CLP) requirements and Safety Data Sheets (SDS). Combining technical expertise with strong stakeholder management and a continuous improvement mindset, you will help ensure our product portfolio remains compliant, competitive and ready for future regulatory developments. In this role, you will:

* Be the SDS expert: Take ownership of the creation, maintenance, harmonisation and distribution of Safety Data Sheets across our global product portfolio.
* Serve as the internal expert on chemical regulations: Provide specialist guidance on CLP, REACH, SDS requirements and related legislation, helping the business navigate regulatory complexity while enabling innovation.
* Drive proactive compliance intelligence: Monitor emerging regulatory developments and translate their impact into practical business actions, ensuring processes remain efficient, compliant and future-ready.
* Lead PCN and UFI management: Coordinate Poison Centre Notification (PCN) submissions and maintain the associated UFI database to ensure our products remain compliant and continue moving seamlessly through the market.
* Build strong cross-functional partnerships: Act as the link between specialist teams, collaborating closely with Regulatory Affairs, Product Development, Supply Chain and Commercial colleagues to support sustainable business growth.
* Support innovation through regulatory expertise: Provide specialist advice on product classification, co-formulants and regulatory requirements, helping to bring new products to market successfully and compliantly.
* Own and develop the regulatory knowledge hub: Maintain knowledge databases, guidance documents and best-practice resources relating to CLP and associated regulations, ensuring expertise is accessible across the organisation.
* Champion a culture of compliance: Deliver engaging training sessions and promote awareness of regulatory requirements, helping colleagues understand their responsibilities and embed compliance into everyday decision-making.
* Drive operational excellence: Lead and support continuous improvement initiatives that simplify, streamline and optimise complex compliance processes across the business.
* Play a key role in ensuring Certis Belchim stays ahead of regulatory developments and is well prepared for future market requirements. You will make a real difference by turning proactive compliance into tomorrow’s market success.

**About you** You are passionate about regulatory compliance, chemical legislation, and continuous improvement. You enjoy diving into technical details while keeping the bigger picture in mind and translating complexity into practical solutions.

We believe you'll be successful in this role if you bring:

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in chemistry, Bioscience Engineering or another relevant scientific discipline.
* At least 5 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, SDS management, chemical compliance or a related field.
* Strong knowledge of CLP, REACH, Safety Data Sheets and related European chemicals legislation.
* A solid understanding of chemical classification principles and their practical application.
* Experience with regulatory databases and systems; experience with LISAM would be a distinct advantage.
* A proactive approach to monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into business improvements.
* Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Strong communication skills, enabling you to explain complex regulatory topics to a wide range of stakeholders.
* A curious and analytical mindset, with a strong focus on continuous improvement and the confidence to challenge the status quo.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken, as this is our global business language. This role will particularly suit someone who loves being a technical expert, enjoys building structure in complex environments, and gains energy from collaborating across teams and cultures.

This role is only open to candidates who hold a valid European Union work permit. We do not offer visa sponsorship for this position. Applications from candidates without a valid EU work permit will not be considered.

**Working with us means** joining our team means becoming part of an international, knowledge-driven organization where you can build your career while contributing to meaningful innovation in Plant Health.

* You will work in a hybrid set ‑ up. Ideally, you live within commuting distance of one of our Certis Belchim offices in Londerzeel or Hannover. In that case, you will spend around 60% of your time working from the office and 40% remotely.
* Regular collaboration with colleagues across Europe and occasional travel to our Londerzeel headquarters are part of the role.
* A varied and autonomous role is offered in which ownership of your work is central, while being supported by an experienced and collaborative network of colleagues.
* A competitive salary package is provided, complemented by a performance-related annual bonus that recognizes your contribution from the start.
* A competitive gross annual salary in the range € 60.000,00 - € 70.000,00 (depending on experience), complemented by a 12.5% performance-related annual bonus that recognises your contribution from the start.
* A culture built on our values *Collaboration, Creativity, Passion, Integrity, and Ambition* is experienced daily in the way colleagues work together and support each other.
* A growth-oriented environment surrounds you, where initiative is encouraged and where shaping your own career path is actively supported.
* Continuous development is enabled through access to a learning academy, combined with regular feedback and coaching.
* A healthy work–life balance is supported by flexible working hours and a culture that recognizes that wellbeing and performance go hand in hand.
* A people-first organisation ensures that success is driven by teamwork, respect, and genuine connection.
* The opportunity is offered to join a well-established and respected industry player while contributing to a more sustainable future in Plant Health.

**Inspired?**

description:
**About Us**
**Factor Eleven** 
 is the leading drive-to-store revenue platform for brick-and-mortar retailers and CPG brands. Our platform automates the entire lifecycle of digital promotion communication — from media planning and ad creation through campaign delivery, billing, and reporting. Operating as a high-touch enterprise managed service, humans orchestrate campaign strategy while our platform automates execution, driving tangible store revenue uplift at scale.

**YOUR MISSION**
 As a
 **Data Analyst Commercial** 
 , you are the analytical backbone of our Commercial organization. You own the processing, validation, and interpretation of customer revenue and campaign performance data, transforming complex datasets into clear, evidence-based insights that directly support commercial decision-making and client success.

Working closely with Commercial VPs, Retail Experts, and cross-functional partners, you ensure that our Commercial Framework delivers accurate, transparent, and scalable performance analyses. Your work enables us to demonstrate measurable store revenue uplift, strengthen long-term client relationships, and continuously improve how data supports our commercial growth.

Beyond delivering analyses, you actively identify opportunities to automate recurring workflows, improve data quality, and build scalable analytical processes that elevate the maturity of our Commercial function.

**Your Responsibilities**
* Own the end-to-end processing, validation, and analysis of customer revenue and campaign performance data across multiple retail clients.
* Measure and evaluate campaign effectiveness by analysing store revenue uplift, campaign periods, and print versus digital performance using our Commercial Framework.
* Translate complex analytical findings into clear, client-ready insights and recommendations that support Commercial VPs and Retail Experts in customer conversations.
* Build recurring reports, dashboards, and performance analyses that provide transparency on campaign success and commercial performance.
* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of datasets through structured quality assurance and validation processes.
* Continuously improve and automate recurring analytical workflows by developing templates, scripts, and scalable reporting solutions using modern analytical tools.
* Collaborate closely with Commercial, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to improve data availability, reporting quality, and analytical efficiency.
* Support the preparation of client presentations and commercial business cases by providing robust, evidence-based performance analyses.
* Identify opportunities to optimize existing analytical processes and contribute to building scalable structures that support F11's continued growth.
* Act as the commercial data expert, helping non-technical stakeholders understand analytical methodologies and performance drivers in a simple and actionable way.

**Who You Are**
 We welcome different career paths, including:

* 2–4 years of experience in Data Analytics, Commercial Controlling, Business Intelligence, or a comparable analytical role.
* Experience in retail, FMCG, trade marketing, media, AdTech, or another commercial environment where data is used to measure business performance.
* Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets; experience with SQL is required, while Python or BI tools are a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to independently structure, process, validate, and interpret complex commercial datasets.
* Experience translating analytical results into actionable business recommendations rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Strong understanding of KPIs, campaign performance measurement, commercial controlling, and performance reporting.
* A structured, detail-oriented, and quality-focused way of working combined with a high level of ownership and accountability.
* A proactive mindset with a genuine interest in improving processes through automation, AI, and scalable analytical solutions.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment where building new structures and continuously improving existing processes is part of the role.
* Native German skills and fleuncy in English.

title: Senior Analyst, In-Field Repair Quality
description:
As the largest global shared micromobility business, Lime is on a mission to build a future where transportation is shared, affordable and carbon-free. A Time Magazine 100 Most Influential Company, Lime has powered more than one billion rides in close to 30 countries across five continents, spurring a new generation of clean alternatives to car ownership. Learn more at li.me.

Lime is hiring a Senior Analyst to join our Global Operations team. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of improving in-field repair quality performance— developing key metrics, building tools that drive real-time visibility, and delivering targeted analysis that informs operational decisions and strategic opportunities.

You'll serve as the functional bridge between Local Operations and our Product organization, translating operational needs into structured data requirements and tooling improvements. You'll collaborate closely with Local Operations, Product, Data Science, and Hardware teams to help shape the future of Lime's in-field repair quality across all of our operations as we continue to scale.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, technically strong, and passionate about using data to solve complex problems. You're equally comfortable partnering with local operations teams and product or engineering stakeholders — and you know how to both structure a process and build a dashboard. If you have 3+ years of experience in business analytics or operations, strong data analysis and visualization skills, and a drive to influence outcomes through insight, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a hybrid role open to candidates based anywhere in Europe (London, Berlin, Paris, Munich, or Copenhagen preferred), within 120 minutes of a Lime warehouse. The role requires occasional travel (\\~10%) to Lime warehouses or other locations for team meetings.

**What You’ll Do**
* Improve visibility into in-field repair quality: Define and maintain metrics to track repair performance, effectiveness, compliance, efficiency, and ROI — and build tooling to surface these insights in real time across operations
* Build models and dashboards: Use SQL, Tableau, and spreadsheets to develop repair volume forecasting models, quality compliance dashboards, and performance reports for local operations teams — with robust logic, clearly defined assumptions, and intuitive interfaces
* Monitor trends and diagnose performance gaps: Track repair efficiency and quality compliance over time, identify root causes behind variances or emerging trends, and recommend actionable solutions at both tactical and strategic levels
* Turn operational complexity into structured clarity: Bridge Local Operations and Product/Tech by converting messy, real-world business needs into crisp specs, user stories, data requirements, and SOPs that teams can actually execute against
* Formalize and improve operational processes: Map and document quality workflows, surface inefficiencies, and partner with Local Operations to define and roll out improved standard operating procedures
* Collaborate with partner teams to improve efficiency: Provide insight and targeted analysis to troubleshoot issues or highlight opportunities. Partner with Operations leadership and local teams to land recommendations and drive action through to resolution
* Drive continuous improvement in data analytics capabilities across global operations: Contribute to a culture of data-driven decision making and analytical excellence through peer collaboration, knowledge sharing, and support

**About You**
* Extremely strong proficiency in data analytics, including advanced SQL, spreadsheet modeling, and data visualization (e.g. Tableau or equivalent).
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience
* 3+ years of experience in business analytics or operations analytics, with demonstrated ability to build reports and dashboards used by operational stakeholders
* Experience translating business needs into functional data and reporting requirements, ideally working closely with a Product or Engineering team
* Ability to structure and document operational processes, comfortable with ambiguity and working from first principles when standard frameworks don't exist
* Curious mindset to spot trends in data, deep-dive root causes, and generate proposals for both tactical and strategic solutions
* Clear verbal and written communicator, with strong collaboration and influencing skills across both field teams and technical stakeholders

**Preferred Experience**
* Python, Google Apps Script, or other automation/scripting capabilities are a strong plus
* Previous experience in a fast-paced, scaling operations environment (gig economy, last-mile, field services, or similar)
* Experience working closely with Product or Engineering teams on tooling/product improvements If you want to make an impact, Lime is the place for you. Not sure if you meet all the qualifications? If this role excites you we encourage you to apply. Explore all opportunities on our career page.

title: Software Developer eisTIK (m/d/w)
description:
**Deine Aufgabe bei CGM** 
 : Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen sind wir in 19 Ländern tätig und beschäftigen fast 9.000 engagierte Mitarbeitende. Du wirst in einem dynamischen und innovativen Umfeld arbeiten, das voller Möglichkeiten steckt. Mit Deinem Einsatz und Deiner Leidenschaft hast Du die Gelegenheit, einen nachhaltigen Unterschied zu machen.

**CGM Leverages AI:** 
 Wir suchen Menschen, die die Kraft von KI im eHealth-Umfeld spüren, den Wandel mitgestalten wollen und mit neugieriger Leidenschaft erkennen, wie Technologie Gesundheit smarter, einfacher und besser machen kann.

 Bist Du leidenschaftlich an zukunftsweisenden Produkten interessiert? Hast Du das Talent, Ideen in konkrete, wertschöpfende Lösungen umzusetzen und dabei immer das große Ganze im Blick zu behalten? Dann suchen wir genau Dich!

**Dein Beitrag**
* Du konzipierst, entwickelst und wartest Modulkomponenten unserer Standardsoftware in den Bereichen Controlling, Finanzbuchhaltung, Patientenmanagement und HR und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter.
* Du entwirfst und implementierst leistungsfähige Business-Intelligence-Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS) und gestaltest konzernweite BI-Projekte aktiv mit.
* Du modellierst und optimierst Data-Warehouse-Strukturen, entwickelst komplexe T-SQL-Abfragen, konzipierst ETL-Prozesse und stellst die Qualität sowie Performance unserer Datenplattformen nachhaltig sicher.
* Du analysierst große Datenmengen, führst Performance-Optimierungen datenbanknaher Anwendungen durch und schaffst die Grundlage für aussagekräftige analytische Auswertungen und fundierte Geschäftsentscheidungen.
* Du setzt moderne KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge wie GitHub Copilot, Claude oder Devin im Entwicklungsalltag ein, beteiligst Dich an Code Reviews, Release-Prozessen sowie der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsstandards.

**Das Bringst Du Mit**
* Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Business-Intelligence-Lösungen, Data Warehouses oder datenbanknahen Anwendungen sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL, T-SQL, MDX und der Performance-Analyse relationaler Datenbanken.
* Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets, bevorzugt an einer renommierten Universität, kombiniert mit einem ausgeprägten Qualitätsanspruch, analytischer Exzellenz und einer Leidenschaft für datengetriebene Softwareentwicklung.
* Erfahrung mit Microsoft SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS), ETL-Prozessen, Datenmodellierung sowie modernen Entwicklungswerkzeugen wie Git, GitLab, Jira und idealerweise SAP.
* Begeisterung für KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung sowie praktische Erfahrung im produktiven Einsatz moderner Werkzeuge wie GitHub Copilot, Claude, Devin oder vergleichbarer Lösungen zur Steigerung von Qualität, Effizienz und Produktivität.
* Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1), gute Englischkenntnisse sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, komplexe technische Fragestellungen gemeinsam im Team zu lösen.

**Das Kannst Du Von Uns Erwarten**
* Fortbildungsangebot: Nutze individuell zugeschnittene Weiterbildungsangebote und entwickle Deine fachlichen, methodischen und persönlichen Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiter. Wir investieren gezielt in Deine Entwicklung und fördern Deine Expertise in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering und Künstlicher Intelligenz.
* Mobile Work: Arbeite an zwei Tagen pro Woche remote und an drei Tagen im Büro. Diese Flexibilität unterstützt Dich dabei, Beruf und Privatleben optimal miteinander zu verbinden.
* Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten und exklusiven Vorteilen bei renommierten Partnern und Anbietern – ein zusätzliches Plus zu Deinem Engagement bei CGM.
* Events: Tausche Dich auf internen Veranstaltungen und Fachformaten mit Experten verschiedenster Disziplinen aus und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der datengetriebenen Gesundheitsversorgung.
* Work-Life-Balance: Nutze unser Job-Bike-Leasing und weitere Angebote für einen gesunden Ausgleich zum Arbeitsalltag. So bleibst Du mental und körperlich in Balance, während wir gemeinsam innovative Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen entwickeln.

**Vielfalt ist Teil von CGM!** 
 Wir freuen uns unabhängig von Behinderung, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität auf Deine Bewerbung.

 Bewirb Dich jetzt online mit Deinen aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (inkl. allen Zeugnissen, Gehaltsvorstellung und nächstmöglichem Eintrittstermin).

title: Controller (w/m/d) Business Intelligence / Reporting
company: HZaborowski - Die Personalberatung für HR, CSR & Leadership
description:
Unser Kunde, ein etabliertes Unternehmen im Logistik- und Versorgungsmanagement des öffentlichen Sektors mit Zentrale in Köln, hat die Transformation auf SAP S/4HANA erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Im nächsten Schritt liegt der Fokus auf der weiteren Digitalisierung der Unternehmenssteuerung. Das zentrale Controlling sucht daher Verstärkung, um die Entwicklung eines integrierten, KPI-basierten Reporting-Systems voranzutreiben. In dieser unbefristeten Vollzeitposition gestaltest du als Experte für Reporting und Business Intelligence die Architektur der zukünftigen Datenlandschaft maßgeblich mit.

**Controller (w/m/d) Business Intelligence / Reporting**

**Deine Aufgaben:**

* KPI-System \\& Governance: Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung des unternehmensweiten Kennzahlensystems voran, definierst Reporting-Standards und etablierst Governance-Regeln für belastbare Daten.
* Architektur \\& Datenmodellierung: Als Bindeglied zwischen Fachbereichen und IT übersetzt du fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare Datenmodelle und wirkst aktiv an der Reporting-Architektur mit.
* BI-Lösungen: Du konzipierst und implementierst moderne Dashboard-Lösungen und entwickelst Self-Service-BI-Angebote für das Management kontinuierlich weiter.
* Strategische Steuerung: Du stärkst Instrumente wie die Balanced Scorecard (BSC) und sorgst dafür, dass strategische Ziele durch konsistente Daten transparent und steuerbar werden.
* Schnittstellenmanagement: Du steuerst die Anforderungsaufnahme, schärfst die Bedarfe der Fachseiten und begleitest die technische Umsetzung zielgerichtet.

**Dein Profil:**

* Hintergrund: Du hast ein Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder (Wirtschafts-)Informatik abgeschlossen, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Controlling oder BI.
* Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Praxis im Controlling, Reporting oder BI-Umfeld mit und hast bereits KPI-Systeme sowie Reporting-Governance weiterentwickelt.
* SAP-Kompetenz: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse im SAP-Umfeld, insbesondere in SAP BW/4HANA und den Datenstrukturen von SAP S/4HANA. Erfahrung in Datenmodellierung und ETL-Prozessen ist für dich selbstverständlich.
* Tools \\& Technik: Du beherrschst SQL und den sicheren Umgang mit Datenbanken. Praxiserfahrung mit BI-Tools, Power BI oder SAP Analytics for Office rundet dein technisches Profil ab.
* Persönlichkeit \\& Sprache: Du arbeitest strukturiert und konzeptionell stark, verstehst betriebliche Zusammenhänge und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch (C2-Niveau).

**Das erwartet Dich:**

* Sicherheit \\& Kultur: Eine unbefristete Anstellung in einem krisensicheren Umfeld, geprägt von einer offenen Feedback-Kultur und regelmäßigen Gehaltsanpassungen.
* Wachstum: Eine strukturierte Einarbeitung in ein dynamisches Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Deine Weiterentwicklung wird durch interne und externe Maßnahmen aktiv gefördert.
* Flexibilität: Nutze die gleitende Arbeitszeit (06:30 bis 21:00 Uhr ohne Kernzeit) und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten.
* Umgebung: Moderne Arbeitsplätze in Köln mit bester Anbindung an ÖPNV und Autobahn sowie kostenlosen Firmenparkplätzen. Zusätzlich profitierst du von attraktiven Corporate Benefits.

description:

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a
 **Senior Retail Media Intelligence Manager** 
 to join our growing Retail Media team.

In this role, you will act as the intelligence and performance partner for the Retail Media business, ensuring stakeholders have timely, accurate, and actionable insights to support decision-making. You will own reporting and analytical deliverables across Retail Media and serve as the team's subject matter expert on performance measurement, data quality, reporting, and business insights.

Working at the intersection of
 **Retail Media, Merchandising, Digital Marketing, Offline Marketing, and Co-Marketing** 
 , you will help stakeholders understand performance, identify growth opportunities, evaluate campaign effectiveness, and drive data-informed decisions. You will translate complex datasets into clear recommendations that support supplier partnerships, campaign optimization, and Retail Media revenue growth.

What You'll Do

**Own Retail Media Reporting \\& Data Delivery**
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of agreed Retail Media reporting and data products.
* Own recurring business reporting and performance tracking processes.
* Deliver ad-hoc analyses and reporting requests to support stakeholder and business needs.
* Partner with Analytics and Data teams to improve reporting efficiency, automation, and scalability.
* Ensure stakeholders have access to reliable and consistent performance data to support decision-making.

**Drive Performance Insights**
* Analyze campaign, advertiser, audience, supplier, and commercial performance data to identify opportunities, trends, and risks.
* Translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.
* Support performance reviews and business planning processes through data-driven insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness, advertiser outcomes, and business performance.
* Conduct exploratory analyses to answer key business questions and uncover growth opportunities.

**Act as the Retail Media Data \\& Insights Expert**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Retail Media reporting, measurement, and analytical topics.
* Represent Retail Media in cross-functional discussions related to analytics, reporting, and performance measurement.
* Provide expert guidance on data interpretation, KPI development, and performance evaluation.
* Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders seeking to understand business performance and growth opportunities.
* Bridge business requirements with Analytics and Data teams to ensure the Retail Media function receives the insights and support it needs.

**Build Strong Cross-Functional Partnerships**
* Act as the trusted intelligence partner for Retail Media stakeholders across the business.
* Work closely with Merchandising teams to identify opportunities to grow supplier engagement, improve campaign performance, and generate insights that support supplier-facing discussions.
* Partner with Digital Marketing teams to evaluate campaign effectiveness, audience performance, and optimization opportunities across digital channels.
* Collaborate with Offline Marketing teams to support measurement, reporting, and performance evaluation of brand and co-funded marketing initiatives.
* Support Co-Marketing teams with performance insights, supplier reporting, campaign evaluation, and actionable recommendations.
* Build strong relationships with Analytics, Product, Commercial, and Marketing stakeholders to improve measurement capabilities and drive data-informed decision-making.

**Continuous Improvement**
* Advocate for a data-driven culture within the Retail Media organization.
* Identify opportunities to improve analytical capabilities, reporting processes, and stakeholder self-service.
* Promote best practices in reporting, measurement, and insights generation.
* Share knowledge and analytical expertise across teams.
* Drive continuous improvement of the Retail Media intelligence function.

**The duration of the contract will be 12 months.**
**Qualifications**
**Experience**
* 5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Marketing Intelligence, Analytics, Retail Media, E-commerce, or related analytical disciplines.
* Proven track record of delivering insights and recommendations that influence business decisions.
* Experience working with senior business stakeholders in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, advertising, e-commerce, or Retail Media ecosystems.

**Technical Skills**
* Advanced SQL skills.
* Experience working with large and complex datasets.
* Strong experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
* Solid understanding of KPI frameworks, reporting methodologies, and business performance measurement.
* Familiarity with attribution, incrementality, experimentation, forecasting, audience analysis, or campaign measurement methodologies is a strong advantage.

**Personal Attributes**
* Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to translate complex analyses into clear business narratives and recommendations.
* Curious, proactive, and commercially minded.
* Comfortable balancing operational delivery with strategic improvement initiatives.
* Able to influence stakeholders through insight and expertise rather than authority.

**Additional Information**
 Headquartered in Munich, with offices across Madrid, Krakow, Wroclaw, London and Vienna, we collaborate because we genuinely love working together - so you’ll be at the heart of an incredible, multinational team. We trust each other to get the job done, which means you’ll benefit from hybrid working, spending 60% of your time in the office and 40% at home. There’s an option to work for 20 days abroad in approved countries too.

Add to that development opportunities that help you to shape your own career path, excellent training and support, wellbeing offers, subsidised transport or bike leasing, plus 20% discount across all our products, and you’ll begin to get a sense of what sets us apart.
 **Find out more about the specific benefits at your local office in our blog posts.**
**A note on compensation:** 
 We believe in being transparent about salary ranges. The range shown reflects the full scope that the role can grow into over time, depending on experience, skills, and impact. Most offers are positioned around the midpoint of the range, ensuring a fair and consistent approach across our teams.

At zooplus, we believe in equal opportunity and support everyone to fulfil their potential. We recognise the power of listening and learning from each other and embrace diversity and inclusion of all.

Central to the role is proactive prevention: monitoring and alerting to catch issues before impact, proactive issue detection and rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA). You will support our 1st and 2nd level support teams with deep-dive code/environment level troubleshooting and automation of repetitive tasks.

**INCLUSIVE BY DESIGN** If you think you have what it takes, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

At Zalando, our vision is to be the leading European technology platform for fashion and lifestyle – one that thrives on diversity and is truly inclusive by design. We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation and creativity, and we actively seek out talent from all backgrounds.

We actively seek to reduce bias in our hiring and employment processes, focusing on your qualifications, skills, and contributions. To support this, we kindly ask that you refrain from including personal details such as your photo, age, or marital status in your CV, ensuring a fair and equitable evaluation based solely on your abilities and potential.

We are committed to providing an exceptional and accessible candidate experience for everyone. If you require any accommodations to support you throughout the hiring process, please let us know – we are here to assist you.

Discover more about our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace: https://jobs.zalando.com/en/our-culture/diversity-and-inclusion

**WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING)**
---------------------------------------------

* Monitoring, Alerting \\& Observability: Implementing tools and dashboards to track system health and business processes in real-time, ensuring the team is proactively notified of any technical or functional anomalies.
* Incident \\& Problem Management (L3-Support): Providing expert-level troubleshooting to resolve complex technical issues, performing root-cause analysis and proposing solutions to prevent recurring failures.
* Performance Optimisation \\& Load Testing: Optimizing system performance and scalability by assessing responsiveness under load and fine-tuning configurations to ensure a seamless experience for our users.
* Security Management \\& Vulnerability Scanning: Proactively identifying and mitigating security vulnerabilities within the application and its environment, following a standardized framework.
* Compliance \\& Audit Readiness (ISO 27001, SOC2, GDPR): Ensuring all operations meet legal and industry standards and providing the necessary evidence for internal or external audits.

**WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF**

* Proficiency in implementing and managing dashboards and alerting frameworks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, or New Relic).
* Experience in Cloud-native environments (AWS), working with Infrastructure as Code and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and load / performance testing.
* A curious mindset, eager to investigate root causes and find sustainable solutions.
* A collaborative approach; you enjoy bridging the gap between technical teams and stakeholders to foster operational excellence.

**OUR OFFER** Tradebyte provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.

* Employee shares program
* 40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners
* 2 paid volunteering days a year
* Hybrid working model - work where it works for you within Germany or the UK, with occasional office attendance required for moments that matter.
* Work from abroad for up to 30 working days a year
* 27 days of vacation a year to start for full-time employees
* Relocation assistance available (subject to prior agreement)
* Family services, including counseling and support
* Health and wellbeing options (including Wellhub, formerly Gympass)
* Mental health support and coaching available
* Drive your development with our training offerings and biannual peer-to-peer review

**ABOUT TRADEBYTE** At Tradebyte, we work with the biggest players in e-commerce - from trendsetting fashion brands to major online retailers. Our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered.

We offer flexible work schedules, professional development opportunities, and a real commitment to work-life balance. We embrace diverse perspectives and ensure that every voice is heard and respected, because you’re unique and that matters to us.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for new colleagues who share our passion. Love what you do - do what you love. Join Tradebyte, an independent company within the Zalando Group!

Marianne Rachinger marianne.rachinger@tradebyte.com Nach der Prüfung werden unsere Recruiter*innen über eine offizielle Zalando E-Mail-Adresse (@zalando.de) Kontakt aufnehmen.

-------------------- Zalando wurde 2008 in Berlin gegründet und ist die führende europäische Technologieplattform für Mode und Lifestyle. Wir verbinden 62 Millionen aktive Kund*innen mit mehr als 7.000 Marken in 29 Märkten. Unser Geschäft basiert auf einer einzigartigen, KI-gestützten Daten- und Infrastrukturplattform. Für unsere Kund*innen bietet unser Multi-App-Ansatz – bestehend aus Zalando, ABOUT YOU und Lounge by Zalando – ein inspirierendes, hochgradig personalisiertes Einkaufserlebnis. Für unsere Partner bauen wir das Betriebssystem für den E-Commerce. Über ZEOS, Tradebyte und SCAYLE öffnen wir unsere Logistik-, Software- und Servicekapazitäten für Marken und Einzelhändler*innen zur nahtlosen, grenzüberschreitenden Skalierung ihres Geschäfts.

Our vision is to establish HUGO BOSS as the leading premium tech-driven fashion platform worldwide and to be one of the top 100 global brands. At HUGO BOSS, we work as a team to apply our knowledge, skills and experience together and create a diversity of ideas and solutions. What unites us? We love fashion, we change fashion!

At HUGO BOSS, you have the opportunity to contribute your personality, ideas and creativity — because only when we break new ground together can we create something unique. Become part of our team of more than 19.000 employees worldwide and shape your future at HUGO BOSS!

At HUGO BOSS, we are shaping the future of customer engagement through data, AI, and personalization. As part of our transformation towards becoming the leading premium tech-driven fashion platform worldwide, we are building a best-in-class customer data ecosystem that enables relevant, real-time and personalized experiences across all customer touchpoints.

As **Expert IT Consultant Customer Data Platform \\& Personalization (m/f/d)**, you take ownership of our CDP capabilities and act as the key technology advisor for customer data activation, audience management, identity resolution, marketing orchestration and personalization use cases.

You bridge business ambitions and technology capabilities, ensuring that customer data becomes a strategic asset driving acquisition, retention, loyalty and lifetime value across all markets and channels.

If you believe in the power of customer data, technology and digital innovation, join our team and take on the following responsibilities.

**What you can expect:**

**Own and Drive the Customer Data Platform Landscape**

* Take end-to-end IT ownership of our Customer Data Platform ecosystem and related customer data activation capabilities.
* Act as the primary IT consultant for customer data, audience management, segmentation and real-time activation topics.
* Design scalable and future-proof customer data architectures supporting global business requirements.
* Ensure seamless integration between CDP, Marketing Automation, Loyalty, Personalization, Customer Master Data and Digital Commerce platform

**Enable Data-Driven Marketing \\& Personalization**

* Consult business stakeholders on customer data strategies, segmentation concepts and activation opportunities.
* Translate complex marketing and personalization requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Support the development of next-generation customer journeys leveraging AI, predictive models and real-time customer signals.
* Ensure personalization capabilities across website, app, CRM, loyalty and paid media channels.

**Solution Design \\& Technology Leadership**

* Create technical concepts and solution blueprints for complex customer engagement initiatives.
* Assess feasibility, risks, scalability and operational impact of new business demands.
* Align with architects, product teams and implementation partners to ensure consistent technical designs.
* Promote API-first, event-driven and cloud-native integration patterns.

**Customer Data Governance \\& Compliance**

* Ensure high-quality customer data management processes and governance principles.
* Support data privacy, consent management and compliance requirements across all customer touchpoints.
* Drive best practices for customer identity resolution, profile unification and audience activation.
* Ensure secure, compliant and scalable usage of customer data throughout the ecosystem.

**Product \\& Vendor Management**

* Collaborate closely with product owners and business stakeholders to define product roadmaps and priorities.
* Work closely with external implementation partners and SaaS vendors.
* Challenge vendors on architecture decisions, scalability, security and operational excellence.
* Identify market innovations and emerging technologies to continuously improve our customer engagement stack.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure availability, monitoring, supportability and continuous improvement of CDP-related services.
* Drive platform adoption through documentation, knowledge sharing and enablement activities.
* Support incident resolution and root cause analysis for customer data and integration related issues.
* Establish KPIs and performance measurement frameworks for platform success and business value realization.

**Innovation \\& Strategic Advisory**

* Act as a trusted advisor for Customer Engagement, CRM, Loyalty and Marketing Technology topics.
* Be up to date and share industry trends in customer data platforms, composable martech architectures, AI-driven personalization and customer engagement.
* Provide recommendations that support HUGO BOSS growth objectives and customer experience ambitions.
* Contribute to the long-term evolution of our Customer Engagement Solutions landscape.

#LI-YC1

**Your profile:**

**Professional Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in IT Consulting, Marketing Technology, Customer Data Platforms or Customer Engagement Solutions.
* Proven experience leading complex customer data initiatives in international environments.
* Strong background in digital transformation, customer experience and enterprise integration.

**Functional Expertise**

* Deep understanding of customer data management, identity resolution and audience activation.
* Strong knowledge of personalization, customer journey orchestration and marketing automation concepts.
* Experience with consent and preference management, customer data governance and privacy regulations.
* Strong understanding of omnichannel customer engagement strategies.

**Technical Expertise**

* Ideally hands-on experience with leading mar-tech and CDP solutions

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and conceptual thinking.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Strong facilitation and consulting capabilities.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for innovation and customer experience.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders across business and IT organizations.

**Your benefits:**

* We offer a competitive salary and attractive benefits, including vacation and Christmas bonuses, a mobility allowance / Deutschlandticket, an annual clothing allowance, a company pension scheme, and our SHIP share program.
* Made for Me: Enjoy the freedom of our flexible working models. With “Threedom of Work”, spend 3 days in Metzingen and up to 2 days working remotely. Benefit from our “Me Time” program for personal time off and the option of 30 days of “Mobile Work EU” annually.
* High-performing people need a healthy balance. Take advantage of the employee gym, a variety of sports activities, a 37-hour workweek, and 30 vacation days a year.
* Exclusive discounts for shopping and arts: benefit from discounts for family and friends along with free entrance to more than 15 international art museums.
* Does innovation drive you? Same for us! This passion is reflected in our modern workplaces and innovative tools.
* Sustainability is one of our key values, and more than just a trend. We are committed to environmental, animal and climate protection, and human rights. As part of our commitment, we offer an environmentally friendly bus shuttle.
* We also place great importance to good taste when it comes to food. Welcome to our award-winning GOOD TIMES restaurant \\& the BOSS bar.

We are a global company with our employees representative of the world at large. Our inclusive culture embraces each person’s authenticity and individuality. We are committed to equal employment opportunity. And we believe our equitable work environment helps unleash your full potential and inspires you to thrive.

title: Chief Revenue Officer (m/w/d)
description:

* Verständnis für Marketing, Customer Success und Account Management
* Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

**THE ROLE \\& THE TEAM** As a Principal Technology Vendor Manager (all genders) you will be part of the team responsible for developing and maintaining long-standing relationships with our largest Technology vendors.

The team is at the heart of where Technology decisions happen in Zalando - Zalando Technology Foundation (ZTF). The mission of Zalando Technology Foundation is to enable Zalandos, foster a culture of self-service, fast paced decision making, collaboration, and capitalize on the scale of the company to drive business excellence.
