title: Social Media Manager
description:
Madrid
Tiempo completo
Empleado permanente
  
**Tu Misión**
------------- Construir y consolidar la presencia digital de Clicars como referente en el sector de la compraventa de vehículos de ocasión en España, convirtiendo seguidores en clientes a través de contenido orgánico de alto impacto y una comunidad digital activa.

**¿Cómo será tu día a día?**
----------------------------

* Definir y ejecutar la **estrategia de redes sociales**: plataformas prioritarias, pilares de contenido, tono de voz, cadencia de publicación y marco de medición.
* Planificar y publicar **contenido nativo** adaptado a cada plataforma: vídeo vertical, reels, carruseles, stories, directos e hilos.
* Optimizar el contenido para algoritmos y trabajar el **Social Search** (TikTok Search, Instagram Explore, YouTube Search).
* Analizar audiencias, monitorizar métricas y elaborar informes periódicos accionables para equipos internos y dirección.
* Identificar y gestionar colaboraciones con influencers y creadores de contenido alineados con los valores de Clicars.
* Diseñar activaciones de comunidad (sorteos, retos, concursos, UGC) para aumentar el alcance orgánico.
* Liderar la cobertura en redes de eventos, lanzamientos, estudios de mercado y apariciones en medios.
* Diseñar flujos de trabajo con herramientas de IA para escalar la producción de contenido de forma eficiente.
* Aparecer en cámara como voz y cara de Clicars en redes sociales: vídeos explicativos, tours de producto, directos y activaciones.
* Mejora continua de procesos del área: Identificar de forma proactiva ineficiencias en los flujos de trabajo de social media (producción, publicación, reporting, gestión de influencers) y proponer e implementar mejoras operativas.
* Documentar procesos, actualizar metodologías en función de los resultados y contribuir a la evolución del área más allá de la ejecución del día a día.
**¿Qué buscamos?**
------------------

* Mínimo **5 años de experiencia** en gestión de redes sociales, social media management o marketing de contenidos en entornos de alta demanda orgánica.
* Experiencia demostrable en **creación de contenido nativo** (vídeo vertical, reels, stories) y **presencia natural en cámara**.
* Dominio de **Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio** y analítica nativa de plataformas para medir el retorno real de la actividad en redes.
* Experiencia gestionando **colaboraciones con influencers** y activaciones de comunidad.
* Manejo de herramientas de producción (**CapCut, Adobe Premiere**) y de IA aplicadas al contenido.
* Titulación en Marketing Digital, Comunicación, Periodismo, Publicidad o afines.
* Español nativo e inglés intermedio.
* Valorable: experiencia en automoción, e-commerce o marketplaces.
**¿Qué ofrecemos?**
-------------------

**Remuneración**

* Horquilla salarial: 30-40K.
* Horario: 40h semanales L-V 9:00-18:00h con 1 día de teletrabajo
* Plan de compensación totalmente flexible: formación, comida, transporte, guardería, seguros de salud, planes de pensiones, etc.
* Descuentos especiales en compra y financiación de coches Clicars.
* Un mundo de ventajas en TheStellantisClub donde podrás encontrar multitud de ofertas, promociones y descuentos.
* Descuentos en alquiler de vehículos con Europcar.
* Disposición de hasta el 90% de tu salario devengado (hasta un máximo de 990€) o el en cualquier momento a través de nuestra app.
* Píldoras de educación financiera.
* Planes de ahorro mensual. A través de nuestra app podrás crear huchas virtuales y destinar el dinero que necesites para conseguir tus objetivos.
* Descuentos y promociones con BBVA.
* Por ser persona trabajadora de una empresa socia de Ganvam, puedes formar parte del Club de Vendedores, de manera totalmente gratuita. Una plataforma online de beneficios exclusivos para empleados y familiares con más de 500 tiendas online.

**Conciliación de la vida laboral y familiar** Con este ritmo de vida tan frenético, queremos darte facilidades para que te sea más sencillo.

* Lanzadera con un punto de encuentro en el metro más cercano (mañana, mediodía y tarde).
* Mínimo 23 días hábiles vacaciones y este año te corresponden 26.
* A través de Wellhub tendrás acceso gratuito a aplicación online en directo de fitness, yoga, aplicaciones de terapia, nutrición, hábitos saludables, mindfulness y meditación, para dejar de fumar y mucho más. Además de un portal de internet con actividades para toda la familia.

**Salud** Nos preocupamos por tu salud y la de tus familiares.

* Descuento en póliza de seguro de salud con los mejores precios del mercado. Además, está exento de IRPF a través de nuestra retribución flexible.
* Acceso a Seguro de Vida Colectivo a cargo de Clicars, para todas las personas con estatus de empleado. Incluye cobertura de fallecimiento e incapacidad absoluta y permanente con una compensación de dos años de salario bruto.
* Acceso a eventos deportivos de diferente índole (fútbol, carreras solidarias, torneos de pádel, etc).
* Acceso gratuito a la app de Calm que fomenta el mindfulness.
* Uber eats con Clicars te facilitan descuentos promocionales de entrega de comida por encargo.

**Desarrollo personal y profesional** Queremos que crezcas con nosotros tanto personal como profesionalmente, nos preocupamos por tu desarrollo.

* La mejor plataforma de inglés a través a precios muy competitivos. Además, está exento de IRPF a través de nuestra retribución flexible.
* Plan de formación.
* Por ser empleado de Clicars, UNIR nos hace un 35% de descuento en su catálogo de estudios y ahora, también, a nuestros familiares de 1º grado.

**Sostenibilidad social y medioambiental**

* #KilometrosQueSuman a Mensajeros de la Paz, entre otras Asociaciones y apoyo en la distribución de alimentos.
* Apoyamos el empleo inclusivo y juvenil.
* Somos muy conscientes de la sostenibilidad medioambiental por lo que tenemos un compromiso #PlasticNeutral con la reducción de la huella de plástico y acciones de compensación como jornadas voluntarias para recoger plástico de nuestros ríos.

**¿Quiénes somos?**
------------------- Clicars, compañía española pionera en venta de coches reacondicionados, nació en 2016 y alcanzó los 5 millones de euros de facturación en su primer año de vida. En la actualidad se ha consolidado como una de las 1.000 empresas de mayor facturación en España y un equipo de 600 empleados. Clicars, que es pionera en el mercado del coche reacondicionado en nuestro país, ofrece vehículos reacondicionados mecánicamente impecables y extremadamente fiables, que permiten un ahorro de hasta el 30% con respecto a los modelos nuevos.

En 2017, la compañía cerró un acuerdo de capital con Aramis Group, número 1 en venta de coches reacondicionados en Europa. Es la única empresa del sector con dos fábricas de reacondicionamiento de España (Madrid y Valencia) con capacidad de reacondicionamiento de 30.000 coches al año. Además de Madrid, también cuentan con puntos de venta físicos en Zaragoza, Valencia, Alicante, Córdoba y Málaga.

Con una edad media de 36 años, somos una empresa joven y dinámica que valora la meritocracia y el crecimiento profesional. Ofrecemos un ambiente de mejora continua basado en trabajo en equipo y respeto a nuestros valores de transparencia, sencillez y confianza para crear equipos de alto rendimiento.

Conoce más en https://www.clicars.com/sobre-nosotros Ni nuevo ni segunda mano, conduce reacondicionado.

*En Clicars, valoramos la diversidad y la inclusión como elementos clave de nuestra cultura. Creemos que un equipo diverso nos fortalece y fomenta la innovación. Nos dedicamos a ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades y a valorar las diferencias individuales, sin importar el origen, género, orientación sexual, edad o religión. Únete a nuestro equipo y forma parte de una comunidad donde cada persona es valorada y respetada por su singularidad.*

title: SRE Platform Engineer
description:
Audiense is a next-generation analytics-to-action platform that helps organizations deeply understand and strategically activate their consumers.

We are a global, remote-first company, with people working from different countries and time zones. English is the working language, and we collaborate daily across Europe and North America.

The SRE Platform team is based in Spain and works closely with colleagues in the US, Canada, Belgium, and other locations. Clear communication, trust, and sustainable collaboration are their team values.

We’re looking for an **SRE Platform Engineer** to join our team, who will help build internal product and platform capabilities to unify Audiense’s overall experience. The team works with a strong product mindset, Extreme Programming practices (pairing, TDD), and a focus on long-term, systemic impact, even when results are not immediate.

If you enjoy working collaboratively, and are open to learning, and bringing your own perspective and experience to the team, then maybe this post is for you! You should also feel comfortable operating a dual space that:

* Builds platforms and infrastructures with clear ownership and intent
* Designs solutions that other teams can realistically adopt
* Make technical decisions with systemic impact This is not a pure execution role, and not a detached infrastructure role either. It’s a role for someone who enjoys thinking about **why** something should exist as much as **how** to build it.

**The Team** You'd be joining a well-established team, with around 10 years of active collaboration across product and engineering.

The SRE Platform team exists to reduce the cognitive load of other engineering teams, so they can produce more value without needing deep knowledge of our cloud infrastructure, SOC2 inventory requirements, and base security. They do this by unifying the Audiense engineering experience through simplicity, consistency, and intelligent guidance.

The SRE Team builds their own roadmap, while carrying cross-team responsibility. They treat what is built as internal product, designed for reuse. Some tools serve the team, but others that matter most are used by other engineering teams — real products, with real users. Most take the SRE team out of the loop of application changes (beyond deployments or testing), covering secrets, configs, rightsizing, and first provisioning, so others move with less friction and lower cognitive load.

Their impact is not always immediately visible to end users, but when it works well, the entire platform moves faster, safer, and more coherently. They continue to evolve the platform for security, reliability, and cost-efficiency, balanced with close collaboration so what we build is adopted sustainably. The relationship with other teams is genuinely fluid and healthy: their constructive feedback regularly helps us improve our tools and surface new projects.

**How they work**

* The team works with a **strong product mindset**, even when building internal platforms.
* Their day-to-day work is grounded in real agile practices, not just ceremonies:
* Extreme Programming as a reference framework
* Pair programming as a regular practice
* Test-Driven Development
* Incremental delivery and early feedback
* A constant focus on understanding **why** we build something, not just **what** These practices are not optional add-ons; they are a fundamental part of how they work. We’re looking for someone who is already comfortable in this kind of environment, or who is genuinely motivated to work this way.

The team aims for an environment where it is safe to ask questions, to say “I don’t know yet”, and to learn in the open. We care more about how we work together and how we learn than about heroic individual performances.

**The Challenge**

* Over the next phase, the team is focused on several strategic initiatives:
* Democratise deep cost analysis for other engineering teams — beyond AWS Cost Explorer.
* Embrace Kubernetes: level up the team on standards and migrate suitable ECS workloads.
* Improve KTLO management by automating the mechanical work, leaving only decisions and prioritisation to humans.

This role lives in a constant, and healthy, tension between advancing the team’s own roadmap and ensuring that what we build truly enables the rest of the organisation.

So far, one of the biggest challenges has not been purely technical. It has been finding the right balance between moving forward with their own product roadmap and ensuring that the tools and solutions we propose are adopted organically and sustainably by other teams.

Each team has its own roadmap, priorities, technical constraints, and organisational realities, so changes are rolled out gradually and on purpose. As an SRE team, a well-paced adoption is what makes an entry safe and stable, and keeps it from feeling like an imposition — the exception being anything that touches the security or reliability of the system, where we move more firmly.

To be fully transparent: today, a significant part of the team's non-maintenance work still comes from other teams' roadmaps, and maintenance takes a large share of their capacities. Building a clearer product roadmap of their own is an ongoing effort, and helping shape it is part of what this role can contribute — something we’re very open about.

**What you’ll do**

* Design, build, and evolve the platform and infrastructure, helping shape the SRE Platform roadmap as it takes form.
* Build internal tools and automation, often with AI (Claude Code), to improve the developer experience across teams.
* Reduce the cognitive load of KTLO by automating manual, human-run steps so maintenance takes less and less of the team's time.
* Provide infrastructure support to developer teams, helping to ship faster, more safely, and more autonomously.
* Operate and improve containerised workloads on AWS ECS and Kubernetes (AWS EKS) in production.
* Manage and evolve cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform).
* Improve reliability, observability, performance, and cost-efficiency across the platform.
* Make technical decisions that balance local and global impact.
* Participate actively in architecture, design, and prioritisation discussions.
* Work closely with product, design, and engineering teams, delivering incrementally and learning continuously.
* Raise the bar through mentoring, feedback, and example.
* Help keep us SOC2-compliant: join the recurring ceremonies, keep monitoring on green, and ensure new platforms comply from day one.

**What you bring**

* Have worked in product-minded platform or infrastructure teams, not just ticket-driven operations.
* Have experience running and supporting production infrastructure and internal platforms used by other teams.
* Care about reliability, security, observability, and cost-efficiency as first-class concerns.
* Are comfortable with ambiguity and real-world trade-offs.
* Understand that meaningful impact is often indirect and takes time.
* Enjoy collaboration and understanding other teams’ constraints.
* Care deeply about software quality *and* the value it creates.
* Some experience as an SRE, platform, or infrastructure engineer — you’ve contributed to running and supporting production systems.
* Working knowledge of cloud (AWS) and containers, enough to be productive and adapt quickly.
* A genuine interest in Kubernetes and some hands-on exposure to it.
* Comfort with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform is a plus).
* Strong communication, collaboration, and an end-to-end ownership mindset.

**Experience** We’re not looking for someone fresh out of training — that’s reflected in a range starting at €50k. We want someone with **real experience** who is excited to grow into running Kubernetes at scale.

We’re not looking for a perfect checklist or a specific background. We’re looking for experience, judgement, and a strong product mindset.

We know that careers are rarely linear. Career breaks, changes of direction, or coming from less traditional paths into engineering are all compatible with this role. If in doubt, tell us your story.

**What you’ll grow into over the next months:**

* Running Kubernetes (AWS EKS) in production with confidence.
* Making technical decisions that go beyond your own code, across complex, multi-team systems.

**Technologies** The tech stack evolves, but today the team works with:

* **Infrastructure as Code:** Terraform as the primary IaC tool to provision, manage, and evolve cloud infrastructure.
* **Containers \\& orchestration:** Docker containers running on AWS ECS and Kubernetes (AWS EKS) in production.
* **Cloud:** AWS as the main cloud provider, across a broad range of managed services.
* **Languages \\& tooling:** JavaScript / TypeScript and Node.js for building internal tools, automation, and services.
* **AI-assisted engineering:** Claude Code and other AI tools to build internal tooling and improve the developer experience across teams.

Beyond the direct stack, they operate in a technically diverse ecosystem, with teams using different technologies and architectures, some more modern and some more legacy.

You don’t need to master all of them, but you should be able to understand them, communicate with their teams, and design solutions that can realistically be adopted.

**AI at Audiense** At Audiense, AI is not just a product feature; it’s also part of how we build software.

We use AI to enhance our products, improve user experience, and accelerate how we deliver value. In the SRE Platform team specifically, they use AI, and Claude Code in particular, to build a lot of internal tools that streamline their daily routines and improve the experience of other Developer teams.

At the same time, engineering teams actively incorporate AI-powered tools and workflows into their daily work, from exploration and prototyping to development and validation.

We see AI as an enabler, not a goal in itself. What matters to us is its real impact on product quality, learning speed, and the effectiveness of our teams.

**Our Engineering Principles** The way the SRE Platform team works is aligned with Audiense’s Product \\& Engineering Principles, which guide decision-making across the company.

Some of the principles that most shape the day-to-day work are:

* **Ask Why** – Always connect technical work to real user or business problems.
* **WIP \\= 1** – Focus, collaboration, and incremental delivery over multitasking.
* **Always Ready to Ship** – Learn early by being ready to deliver at any time.
* **Stay Sharp** – Reduce cognitive load and invest in quality and continuous learning.
* **Software Is a Means to an Outcome** – Avoid unnecessary complexity; build what matters.
* **Courage and Respect** – Psychological safety, open communication, and thoughtful decision-making.

These principles are not decorative. They are used in onboarding, day-to-day decisions, reviews, and how work is assessed.

**What We Offer** In addition to the role itself, at Audiense we offer concrete benefits designed to support both your work and your well-being:

* **Remote-first work** with flexibility around location.
* **Flexible working hours**, based on trust and autonomy.
* **Paid time off**
* **Learning budget and dedicated learning time** during working hours.
* A strong focus on **work–life balance** and long-term sustainability.
* **Company-provided equipment** for a comfortable setup.
* **1Password account** for secure credential management.

(Some benefits may vary depending on location and contract type.)

**Final Note** If you are not sure whether your profile is the right fit, you can still apply and let us decide together. A short explanation of your context is enough; there is no need for a “perfect” application. We welcome people with different backgrounds and experiences, and we do not expect anyone to meet 100% of the criteria.

**The pay range for this role is:** 50 - 60 EUR per year(Spain (Remote))

title: Business Intelligence Associate
description:
**Location**
------------ San Francisco / San Mateo

**Employment Type**
------------------- Full time

**Location Type**

**Department**
-------------- Operations

**Company Overview**
-------------------- Parasail is redefining AI infrastructure by enabling seamless deployment across distributed GPU networks, optimizing for cost, performance, and flexibility. Our mission is to give AI developers a fast, cost-efficient, scalable cloud experience free from vendor lock-in.

We build the company the same way we build the product. Parasail runs on agents, from kernel optimization through to how we answer questions about our own business, and this role sits close to the center of that.

**Role Summary**
---------------- Every inference request we serve is a decision about hardware, cost, and performance. Making those decisions well, at scale, across a distributed GPU fleet, is a data problem before it is anything else. The intelligence layer behind those decisions is one of Parasail's real advantages, and it is what this role owns.

Our internal analytics are agent-native. Teams ask the business questions directly and get real analysis in minutes, on data infrastructure designed so that people and agents query it the same way. It is a different way to run a company, and it is a large part of why a small team moves as fast as we do.

You will own and expand that layer. You will design the data models behind fleet and unit economics, build the analytical capabilities the rest of the company runs on, and turn questions that used to take a week into answers that take a minute. Work you ship compounds, because it becomes something the entire team can use immediately.

You will work through MCP connections and agentic tools every day. We expect you to be productive in that stack from week one.

**Questions You Will Answer**
-----------------------------

* What does a token actually cost us across hardware generations and workload profiles, and where does that curve bend?
* Which workloads run best on which hardware, and what is that difference worth to a customer?
* Where is capacity earning, and where is it waiting, across every GPU and every region we operate in?
* How does a model's benchmark performance translate into real unit economics at production scale?
* As the fleet gets more efficient, how much of that can we hand back to customers as better pricing?

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design and own the data models behind fleet economics, capacity, and utilization
* Build the analytical capabilities and reporting the company makes decisions from, and expand what our internal agentic tooling can answer
* Build and maintain the pipelines that bring infrastructure, usage, billing, and customer data into one coherent view
* Develop dashboards and models connecting operational performance to revenue, margin, and capital efficiency
* Build verification into the data layer so answers stay trustworthy as the product evolves quickly
* Partner with infrastructure, finance, product, and go-to-market to anticipate what they need to know
* Use agentic tooling to automate analysis and reporting, and raise the ceiling on what one person can cover

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 2 to 5 years in business intelligence, data analytics, analytics engineering, operations analytics, or a similar hands-on data role
* Strong SQL, plus Python or a comparable language for data work
* Daily proactive use of agentic AI tools with MCP connections to pull data from source systems
* Real curiosity about how a business works underneath the metrics, and the drive to chase a number until you understand it completely
* Technically literate enough to work directly with infrastructure and engineering teams and reason about what the systems are doing
* Ability to explain what the data says, and how confident you are in it, to any audience
* High ownership and strong instincts for what is worth measuring
* Excited by a fast-moving startup where you get to define your own scope

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in operations, manufacturing, logistics, or another environment where asset utilization and yield drive the business
* Cloud infrastructure, data center, GPU, or semiconductor exposure
* Usage-based or consumption-based billing experience
* Experience building internal tools, pipelines, or automation
* Familiarity with dbt, warehouse modeling, or observability tooling

**Compensation \\& Benefits**
----------------------------

* Competitive base salary with meaningful equity
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* Generous PTO and company holidays
* 401(k) and family-planning benefits
* High visibility with the executive team and direct exposure to how the business is run
* The chance to build agentic data infrastructure that the entire company runs on Parasail is an equal opportunity employer committed to workplace diversity and reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants with disabilities.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

**About the role** We are seeking a Senior **Data Analyst** to join our Operations Analytics team in Barcelona. You will partner closely with Rover’s Operations org, driving initiatives and supporting analytics towards furthering Rover’s customer experience. This is a high-visibility role involving direct collaboration with a diverse set of stakeholders to **define, measure, test and improve** the success of customer experience programs and product developments. A key component of this position will be providing product analytics support for our Bookings Confidence team, which aims to tackle customer service improvements through product developments.

The ideal candidate is a passionate problem-solver who comfortably translates ambiguous business challenges into clear questions, deep analysis, and strategic recommendations that drive action.

You’ll be joining an international team, reporting to a Barcelona based Analytics manager, with colleagues and stakeholders split between Barcelona and Seattle. This is a hybrid role: we're in our Poblenou office two days a week (Mondays and Thursdays), so you'll need to be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

*This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.*

### **Your Responsibilities:**

* **Thought Partnership:** Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, making data-driven recommendations on **optimization strategies** within customer experience.

* **Strategic Planning \\& Measurement:** Partner with Ops Program leadership to define the strategy for measuring program health and operational performance, including establishing **comprehensive metrics**, developing crisp reporting, and setting up **monitoring rhythms**.
* **Performance Analysis:** Conduct in-depth analysis of key CX (Customer Experience) operational metrics to identify **emerging trends and opportunities**, which will inform deeper research and analytical efforts.
* **Executive Communication:** Develop and present **crisp narratives** resulting from analytics findings and investigations to senior Operations leaders, focusing on both identified problems and proposed solutions.
* **Data Infrastructure Support:** Support the construction and maintenance of our core **reporting abstractions** (built in dbt), BI reporting and AI semantic layers

### **What we're looking for (must-haves):**

* At least 4 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Master’s degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
* Ability to code in Python/R
* Hands on experience leveraging AI tools for analytics
* Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
* Hands-on experience in workforce forecasting
### **Compensation:**

* In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €47,124 - €57,120. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees.
* The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process.

* Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going

title: Senior Data Engineer Snowflake + DBT
description:
**Somos Cívica**
---------------- Corría el año 2008. El WhatsApp no existía, los datos vivían en Excel y las nubes estaban solo en el cielo.

La idea era sencilla de explicar, pero ambiciosa de ejecutar: crear un espacio donde las personas pudiesen colaborar, una consultora tecnológica donde los datos y el desarrollo se unieran para impulsar soluciones a medida, siempre con el trato cercano de toda la vida.

Hoy seguimos fieles a esa esencia: combinamos el poder de los datos y la ingeniería de software para ayudar a empresas a tomar mejores decisiones, innovar y crecer… sin perder nunca el factor humano que nos hizo nacer. Y sí, lo hacemos para grandes compañías, con presencia nacional e internacional, que confían en nosotros para proyectos de alto impacto.

Así empezamos, y así seguimos: con tecnología, sí, pero con alma. Porque, para nosotros, la innovación no va solo de código y servidores, sino de poner la tecnología al servicio de las personas. Aquí nadie es un número de ticket ni un “usuario final”: somos personas trabajando con otras personas, con nombres, ideas y muchas ganas de aportar.

La colaboración es nuestro sistema operativo. Porque sabemos que, cuando combinamos talento, compromiso y un poco de sentido del humor, el resultado no es solo un buen producto: es una forma de trabajar que genera impacto real, refuerza comunidades y mejora vidas.

Esto es Cívica: tecnología con propósito, personas que se implican y un equipo que cree que colaborar es mucho más que compartir documentos en la nube. Y si algo tenemos claro, es que el talento es el corazón de todo lo que hacemos. No solo el de quienes se sientan en nuestras oficinas, sino también el de quienes confían en nosotros como clientes y partners. Cuidar, desarrollar y retener ese talento no es una tarea más: es nuestra ventaja competitiva, y por eso hacemos realidad nuestro lema ***People Beyond Tech***, recordando cada día que la tecnología avanza rápido, pero las personas son las que marcan la diferencia.

**¿Quieres saber qué hacemos?**
------------------------------- En Cívica, usamos la tecnología como una palanca para mejorar realidades.

Acompañamos a grandes organizaciones en su viaje hacia la transformación digital, alineando datos, diseño y desarrollo con impacto tangible en el negocio. Así es como lo hacemos:

* **Data Analytics:** Transformamos datos en decisiones. Creamos informes, dashboards y portales que convierten información cruda en inteligencia estratégica.
* **Data Engineering:** Diseñamos y gestionamos arquitecturas que aseguran flujos de datos fiables, continuos y escalables.
* **Data Quality \\& Governance:** Creamos ecosistemas de confianza. Establecemos controles y políticas para garantizar que los datos siempre digan la verdad.
* **Artificial Intelligence:** Damos inteligencia al futuro. Modelos predictivos y sistemas automatizados que optimizan procesos y multiplican el valor.
* **Front \\& Back Development:** Construimos soluciones robustas. Desde aplicaciones web hasta APIs, traducimos necesidades de negocio en tecnología útil y escalable.
* **Design:** Diseñamos experiencias claras. Combinamos funcionalidad y estética para conectar con las personas desde la primera interacción
* **Business \\& Management:** Hacemos que la tecnología hable el idioma del negocio. Alineamos soluciones con los objetivos específicos de sectores como banca o seguros, asegurando resultados desde el día uno.

**¿Por qué enamorarte de nosotros?**
------------------------------------ Porque no todas las empresas tienen tan claro el papel que quieren jugar en el mundo como lo tenemos en Cívica. Para nosotros, no se trata solo de lo que hacemos, sino de por qué y cómo lo hacemos. No nacimos para seguir tendencias tecnológicas, sino para construir soluciones con propósito, con rigor técnico, transparencia y transformaciones reales para las organizaciones que las utilizan.

El epicentro de nuestro trabajo no está solo en los resultados, sino en el enfoque. Cada proyecto nace de una escucha atenta, una necesidad real y una convicción compartida: la tecnología debe ser comprensible, escalable y transformadora. Desde la ingeniería hasta el análisis, desde el gobierno del dato hasta el diseño, todo lo que hacemos sigue una lógica colaborativa y humana.

Diseñamos plataformas que mejoran servicios, desarrollamos sistemas para tomar decisiones de negocio y acompañamos a organizaciones que entienden que los datos no son solo activos, sino herramientas de cambio. Trabajamos con instituciones, empresas y administraciones públicas que buscan tecnología comprensible, escalable y que genere valor. Lo hacemos con herramientas punteras —Snowflake, dbt, Google Cloud, entre otras—, pero, sobre todo, con una forma de pensar crítica, abierta y honesta.

Hemos crecido paso a paso, consolidando un equipo interdisciplinario que combina pensamiento crítico, excelencia y una visión ética sobre el uso de la tecnología. Nuestra trayectoria no se mide solo en líneas de código, *pipelines* y *dashboards* actualizados, sino en vínculos de confianza, valor aportado y transformaciones reales.

En Cívica no se trata de hacer más, sino de hacer mejor. Por eso, para quienes buscan un entorno donde la tecnología se construye con criterio, conciencia y confianza, este es un lugar al que es fácil querer sumarse.

**¿Qué buscamos?**
------------------ Sabemos que esta oferta no es para todo el mundo (ni lo pretendemos).

**Buscamos a quienes no se conforman con el “esto siempre se ha hecho así”.** Aquí venimos a mover cosas. A veces demasiado. A veces nos equivocamos. No somos perfectos, pero lo que sí tenemos son ganas. De hacer cosas que molen, que importen, que dejen huella. Y de crecer.

De currar con gente con criterio, con energía positiva, con ganas de dar opinión y de trabajar en equipo. Y sí, también de disfrutar. Porque, como dice nuestro CEO, Josep: “Aunque estemos trabajando, no hace falta estar todo el día con un palo en el c…”.

Bueno, mejor esta parte te la contará cuando os conozcáis.

**¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades en este rol?**
---------------------------------------------------- Esta no es una oferta puntual ni para cubrir un proyecto concreto.

Buscamos un compañero de viaje que quiera crecer con nosotros y sumar al largo plazo en el equipo de **Cívica.** Claro. Manteniendo el mismo estilo y formato que el ejemplo, quedaría así:

El rol a incorporar es el de **Data Engineer**, con foco en:

️ **Desarrollo y mantenimiento de procesos ELT/ETL en entornos cloud:** Diseñar, implementar y mantener flujos de integración y transformación de datos escalables, garantizando su eficiencia, fiabilidad y alineación con las necesidades del negocio.

️ **Diseño y optimización de modelos de datos en Snowflake:** Construir y evolucionar modelos de datos robustos y eficientes, asegurando un almacenamiento optimizado, alto rendimiento y una adecuada gobernanza de la información.

️ **Desarrollo de transformaciones y lógica de negocio con dbt:** Implementar modelos, transformaciones y reglas de negocio mediante dbt, promoviendo la modularidad, reutilización y mantenibilidad de las soluciones de datos.

**Calidad del dato y buenas prácticas analíticas:** Aplicar estándares de modelado analítico, validación y control de calidad para garantizar la consistencia, precisión y confiabilidad de los datos.

**Optimización de rendimiento y costes:** Analizar y mejorar consultas SQL, estructuras de datos y procesos en Snowflake, maximizando el rendimiento y optimizando los costes operativos.

**Colaboración con equipos multidisciplinares:** Trabajar estrechamente con equipos de negocio, BI y arquitectura para comprender los requisitos analíticos y transformarlos en soluciones técnicas de alto valor.

**Documentación técnica y gobierno del dato:** Documentar modelos, linaje de datos, reglas de negocio y procesos desarrollados, asegurando la trazabilidad, comprensión y mantenibilidad de las soluciones.

**Control de versiones y despliegue de soluciones:** Participar en la gestión de despliegues entre entornos, revisión de código y control de versiones, garantizando la calidad y estabilidad de los desarrollos realizados.

**Que la comunidad te acompañe...**
----------------------------------- Dale al play y descúbrelo....️

**¿Qué necesitamos por tu parte?**
---------------------------------- Estos son nuestros **NO negociables**:

**Experiencia como Data Engineer (+5 años)**, porque buscamos una persona con recorrido en proyectos de datos que pueda aportar criterio técnico, autonomía y buenas prácticas desde el primer día.

️ **Conocimiento avanzado de SQL**, porque trabajarás diseñando modelos de datos, desarrollando transformaciones complejas y optimizando el rendimiento de consultas y procesos analíticos.

️ **Experiencia sólida con Snowflake**, porque gran parte de nuestra arquitectura de datos se apoya en esta plataforma para el modelado, la carga, la optimización y la gestión eficiente de la información.

️ **Experiencia con dbt**, porque desarrollamos nuestras transformaciones y modelos siguiendo una metodología modular, escalable y mantenible, apoyándonos en tests, documentación, macros y gestión de dependencias.

**Conocimientos de modelado analítico**, porque necesitarás diseñar soluciones basadas en modelos dimensionales, capas de datos y data marts que permitan responder eficazmente a las necesidades de negocio.

**Experiencia con Git y control de versiones**, porque trabajamos de forma colaborativa siguiendo procesos de revisión de código, trazabilidad y despliegue controlado.

**Conocimiento de buenas prácticas de desarrollo y calidad del dato**, porque la fiabilidad, validación y mantenibilidad de nuestras soluciones son aspectos clave en todos los proyectos.

Y además...

**Sería ideal que tuvieses experiencia con Python**, porque puede formar parte de automatizaciones, procesos auxiliares y desarrollos dentro del ecosistema de datos.

️ **Nos encantaría que hubieses trabajado con plataformas cloud como AWS, Azure o GCP**, porque algunos de nuestros proyectos se apoyan en estos entornos para el almacenamiento, procesamiento y gestión de datos.

**Estaría genial que tuvieses experiencia con herramientas de orquestación de procesos**, ya que nos ayudan a automatizar, monitorizar y escalar nuestros flujos de datos de forma eficiente.

**Nos acabarías de enamorar si has trabajado con Airflow**, porque es una de las herramientas más utilizadas para la gestión y programación de pipelines de datos complejos.

### **Y a nivel personal...** **Autonomía y organización**, para gestionar el trabajo técnico de manera estructurada y eficiente.

**Orientación a la calidad, el rendimiento y la mantenibilidad**, buscando siempre soluciones robustas y sostenibles en el tiempo.

**Capacidad analítica**, para comprender las necesidades del negocio y transformarlas en modelos y soluciones de datos de alto valor.

**Buena comunicación**, tanto con perfiles técnicos como funcionales, facilitando la colaboración entre equipos.

**Proactividad**, proponiendo mejoras continuas y detectando riesgos o ineficiencias antes de que se conviertan en problemas.

**Espíritu de equipo**, colaborando activamente en entornos multidisciplinares y compartiendo conocimiento con el resto del equipo.

**Rigurosidad en la documentación y validación**, garantizando la calidad y trazabilidad de los desarrollos realizados.

**¿Cómo será nuestro proceso de selección?**
--------------------------------------------

**Primera llamada — ¡Hola, hola!** Si tu perfil nos hace ojitos, te llamaremos para una charla breve y romper el hielo. Queremos conocerte un poco y contarte por qué creemos que podrías encajar con nosotros.

**Videollamada con Talento — Nos ponemos cara** Si seguimos conectando, agendamos una videollamada para hablar de tú a tú. Te contaremos más sobre Cívica, cómo trabajamos y cómo vivimos nuestra cultura de equipo... Y, por supuesto, también queremos escucharte.

**Charla techie — Hora de hablar en tu idioma** Si hay match, llega el momento de sumergirnos en lo que más te gusta: herramientas, tecnologías, proyectos, retos... Una charla con nuestro equipo técnico para evaluar tu nivel.

**¿Ya está? ¿Así de fácil?** Pues sí. Ni gymkanas imposibles ni entrevistas eternas. Queremos que el proceso sea tan fluido como tomarte un café con alguien que te cae bien (aunque sea por videollamada).

**¿Qué ocurrirá en tu primera semana?**
--------------------------------------- Tu incorporación empieza en nuestra oficina de Granada, pero lo más importante no será el lugar: será cómo te vas a sentir.

Desde el primer minuto, todo estará preparado para ti.

Uno de nosotros te recibirá, te enseñará la oficina y te presentará al equipo. A partir de ahí, solo tendrás que centrarte en disfrutar y empezar a vivir la experiencia Cívica.

Tendrás una primera reunión con el equipo de **People Care**, donde te contarán todo lo que necesitas saber: tu contrato, beneficios, dinámicas internas, eventos y cómo cuidamos de quienes trabajan aquí.

Te recibirá también el equipo de **Sistemas**, que te entregará todas las herramientas para que puedas empezar a trabajar sin preocupaciones.

Conocerás a tu equipo de proyecto, y tendrás una bienvenida por parte de **Producción**, para entender cómo encajas en el engranaje de la compañía.

Pero eso no es todo. Nuestro CEO y CTO se reunirán contigo para contarte en primera persona hacia dónde vamos, en qué creemos y por qué lo hacemos así. Porque no se trata solo de trabajar, se trata de **compartir una visión**.

Además, tendrás siempre a alguien del equipo de Talento a tu lado. Desde el primer día y durante todo tu recorrido, habrá momentos de acompañamiento, escucha y revisión conjunta para asegurarnos de que estás bien, creciendo y disfrutando.

En Cívica, tu primera semana no es un aterrizaje: **Es el comienzo de un viaje que queremos recorrer contigo.**

**¿Qué podemos ofrecerte?**
--------------------------- Si has llegado hasta aquí, es que algo te hemos despertado por dentro (y esa era la idea). Ahora solo queremos darte el empujón final. Y no, no vamos a soltarte la típica lista de beneficios tipo promesas de año nuevo que todos sabemos que no se cumplen. Aquí lo que decimos, lo hacemos.

Las cosas claras y el talento contento.

**Contrato indefinido** **y estabilidad** desde el minuto uno: queremos que te sientas parte del equipo a largo plazo, sin sustos.

**Proyectos innovadores** con tecnología moderna: aquí no venimos a reinventar la rueda, pero sí a aprender cada día y potenciar al máximo todas tus habilidades.

**Formación continua** y **desarrollo profesional:** invertimos en tu crecimiento con un presupuesto flexible para que accedas a cursos, certificaciones, clases de inglés y todo lo que necesites para potenciar tu talento. Además, fomentamos el intercambio de conocimiento y el aprendizaje colaborativo a través de nuestras tribus y comunidades, donde crecer juntos es nuestra filosofía.

**Comunidades y conocimiento compartido:** Nuestra Oficina Técnica es un espacio para crecer, aprender, compartir experiencias y sentirnos parte de algo más grande.

‍**Equipo técnico consolidado**: un espacio donde cada uno aporta y crece en un ambiente auténtico y positivo. Nuestros líderes son grandes profesionales y referentes técnicos que siempre están para apoyar y guiar.

️**Vacaciones que crecen contigo**: 23 días laborables al año, y ¡1 día más cada 2 años de antigüedad! (hasta 30 días).

**Compensación por teletrabajo**: 562,50 €/año para que montes tu oficina en casa como a ti te gusta.

**Retribución flexible**: ¡Elige los beneficios que mejor van contigo! Formación, comida, transporte, guardería… y más.

**Todo el equipo necesario, a tu disposición**: PC, silla, pantalla, teclado, ratón, reposapiés… Queremos que trabajes cómodo/a, estés donde estés.

**Biblioteca de libros y juegos en la oficina de Granada**: Tenemos estanterías llenas de cultura y entretenimiento. Puedes llevarte lo que quieras a casa ️‍️**WellHub**: Acceso a un montón de actividades deportivas a precio reducido. Tú eliges la cuota, nosotros ponemos el acceso.

️**Descuentos por ser parte del equipo**: Gracias a IBenefits, podrás acceder a cientos de ofertas y descuentos en ocio, salud, moda, deporte y más.

**Apoyamos los hobbies que unen a las personas**: Si compartes una afición con tu compañeros, colaboramos económicamente para que podáis disfrutarla juntos.

Porque creemos en un entorno donde trabajar, crecer y pasarlo bien van de la mano.

**Cuidamos de las personas de verdad:** Porque detrás de cada puesto hay una historia, una vida y muchos momentos que merecen ser acompañados. Nos gusta estar presentes en los días especiales y también en los logros cotidianos, con pequeños gestos que dicen mucho. En tu cumpleaños, te llega un desayuno sorpresa a casa para empezar el día con una sonrisa. Si vas a ser mamá o papá, celebramos contigo desde el primer instante, porque formar una familia también forma parte de tu camino en Cívica. Cuando completas un reto deportivo, reconocemos tu esfuerzo y dedicación, como hacemos con cada paso que das…Y eso es solo una parte de todo lo que te espera.

**Nuestros eventos**
-------------------- En Cívica hay vida más allá de los proyectos. Creemos que cuando el entorno es positivo, el trabajo deja de ser solo trabajo y lo profesional y lo personal pueden convivir en armonía. Por eso, impulsamos iniciativas que te conectan con lo que te gusta y con quienes te rodean:

* **Deporte y Cultura** Contamos con grupos deportivos y organizamos eventos culturales para mantenernos activos, creativos y conectados, siempre con el apoyo y la colaboración de la empresa.

* **Civicervezas \\& Civipregunta** Cada primer viernes de mes arrancamos el día con la **Civipregunta:** un encuentro informal en el que Josep Roig, nuestro CEO, comparte novedades y responde a todas nuestras preguntas.

Y a mediodía, llegan las **Civicerves** pagadas por la empresa: una oportunidad para compartir tiempo con los compañeros y desconectar del ritmo diario.

* **Comida de Navidad** Cada año celebramos juntos la comida de Navidad, un clásico para cerrar el año con buen ambiente y grandes momentos.

* **Cívica Day** Un día especial para disfrutar, desconectar y celebrar. Invitamos a nuestras parejas e hijos para compartir este momento con quienes más queremos, y mostrarles el lugar donde trabajamos y pasamos gran parte de nuestro día a día. (¡Sí, adjuntamos pruebas gráficas!)

**Las historias de Cívica se cuentan mejor desde dentro, ¿Quieres conocerlas?**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Podríamos contarte muchas más cosas sobre cómo es trabajar en Cívica. Pero preferimos que lo hagan quienes lo viven cada día.

Estas son algunas voces reales del equipo. Personas que, como tú, un día decidieron sumarse a este viaje.

**¿Listo/a para escribir con nosotros el próximo capítulo de esta historia?** *En* ***Cívica Software S.L.*** *creemos firmemente en el talento y en las personas, sin etiquetas. Valoramos la diversidad como una fuente de enriquecimiento y crecimiento, y por eso garantizamos un proceso de selección justo, basado únicamente en las competencias y la motivación de cada persona candidata.* *Queremos que cada persona pueda aportar lo mejor de sí misma en un entorno donde se sienta valorada y respetada.*

title: Website Growth Engineer
description:
**About ElevenLabs**
-------------------- ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning \\& development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

**About the role** ElevenLabs is building the most advanced AI audio platform in the world. Millions of creators, developers, and businesses use our products, and our website is one of the company’s most important sources of new users and subscriptions.

We are looking for a Growth Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, product, data, and business. You will build and optimize the experiences that help users discover ElevenLabs, understand its value, and become active customers.

This is a highly autonomous role focused on measurable outcomes. You will identify growth opportunities, form hypotheses, build and launch experiments, analyze the results, and decide what to do next. You will work across conversion-rate optimization, organic search, programmatic pages, onboarding, web performance, and experimentation infrastructure.

Organic search and our website are major drivers of new signups and subscriptions at ElevenLabs. Engineers on this team have the opportunity to generate significant business impact through rapid experimentation, improvements to high-traffic pages, and systems that scale successful ideas across thousands or millions of search intents.

The right person is a strong product-minded engineer who enjoys moving quickly, working with data, and owning problems from initial idea through implementation and measurable impact. You should be equally comfortable analyzing a funnel, discussing an experiment with design, building the solution, and evaluating whether it worked.

**What you will do**

* Identify and build opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and revenue
* Own growth experiments from hypothesis through implementation, instrumentation, launch, analysis, and iteration
* Build and improve high-traffic product pages, landing pages, onboarding experiences, and programmatic page systems
* Improve technical SEO, crawlability, structured data, internal linking, page quality, and website performance
* Collaborate with design, SEO, product, data, marketing, and frontend engineering to turn successful experiments into scalable systems

**Requirements**

title: COA Manager
description:
Madrid, Spain | Full time | Hybrid | R1562641  
Overview IQVIA provides scientific solutions spanning clinical trials, real-world evidence, and consulting across the drug product lifecycle. The Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient \\& Site Strategy team manages a broad COA portfolio and is expanding the use of COAs beyond traditional clinical trials and RWE into routine care, registries, health systems, quality measurement, and Population Health settings.

This role is designed to lead the cross-portfolio operational implementation of Population Health initiatives. The role holder translates a strategy co-developed by Sales and COA Management into scalable implementation models, readiness frameworks, governance processes, and execution plans across therapeutic areas.

Role \\& responsibilities  
1. Implementation roadmap, governance and operating model  
Translate the Population Health strategy co-developed by Sales and COA Management into an actionable implementation roadmap, including workstreams, milestones, dependencies, risks, decision points, and leadership updates.  
Own the Population Health implementation operating model across the COA portfolio, ensuring clear roles, decision rights, escalation paths, and hand-offs between Sales, COA Management, TA COA Managers, technology, standards, and delivery teams.  
Develop and maintain implementation governance tools, including RACI, issue/risk logs, status dashboards, readiness criteria, implementation playbooks, and cross-functional working group structures.  
Ensure implementation workstreams are aligned with scientific goals, operational feasibility, portfolio priorities, stakeholder needs, regulatory expectations, and long-term scalability.  
2. Cross-functional implementation leadership  
Coordinate implementation across therapeutic areas and COA Managers, ensuring that instrument owners provide asset-level content while this role owns the cross-portfolio implementation framework.  
Partner with health data standards, LOINC, FHIR, HL7, EHR integration, scoring, data platforms, privacy/data governance, eCOA implementation, healthcare technology, quality measurement, RWE/HEOR, and delivery teams.  
Identify and manage implementation risks and dependencies, including technology readiness, EHR workflow barriers, data exchange requirements, privacy/data-sharing considerations, scoring and interpretation needs, and operational burden for providers or patients.  
Facilitate cross-functional working sessions and ensure clear ownership, decision logs, action tracking, dependencies, and escalation routes.  
3. Portfolio and therapeutic-area readiness  
Define and maintain a cross-portfolio Population Health readiness framework, including criteria for COA selection, metadata readiness, scoring and interpretation requirements, translation/version readiness, coding readiness, benchmarking needs, and evidence requirements.  
Coordinate with TA COA Managers, starting with the Cardiovascular COA Manager, to assess instrument-specific implementation readiness and identify gaps that must be closed before deployment in routine care, registries, health-system pilots, or early-adopter programs.  
Support scalability by creating reusable templates and implementation models that can be applied beyond cardiovascular to future therapeutic areas such as respiratory, CNS, oncology, rare disease, pediatrics, and other priority areas.  
Ensure implementation plans protect scientific quality, copyright and licensing integrity, scoring validity, and operational feasibility.  
4. Health-system, routine-care and registry enablement  
Define how COAs can be operationalized in routine care, health systems, registries, quality measurement, value-based care, and Population Health programs.  
Develop implementation models for provider-facing interpretation, patient-facing outputs, benchmarking, outcomes reporting, care pathway monitoring, risk stratification, and population-level analytics.  
Lead the portfolio-level approach to LOINC/FHIR/EHR readiness while relying on COA Managers for instrument-level content, versions, samples, licensing assumptions, scoring logic, and scientific validation input.  
Support early-adopter programs, academic collaborations, registry pilots, and health-system enablement by defining the implementation model, coordinating internal execution, and tracking readiness and adoption metrics.  
5. Evidence, adoption and continuous improvement framework  
Translate implementation learnings into refinements of the Population Health operating model, readiness framework, and future roadmap.  
Coordinate with portfolio and scientific teams to align publications, validation work, registry evidence, and real-world implementation outputs with Population Health priorities.  
Define implementation evidence needs that support clinical credibility, healthcare adoption, benchmarking, quality measurement, and future scalability.  
Maintain feedback loops with the Population Health Strategist and Sales teams so that market signals and customer learnings inform implementation priorities, and implementation feasibility informs market strategy.  
6. Interface with Population Health Strategist, Sales and Business Development  
Partner closely with the Population Health Strategist to translate market, customer, and regional priorities into implementation requirements, readiness plans, and operational roadmaps.  
Provide scientific, operational, readiness, and implementation input to sales enablement materials, proposals, and customer discussions when Population Health implementation expertise is required.  
Advise on implementation feasibility, resource needs, dependencies, risks, and sequencing for business cases and strategic investment decisions.  
Remain clearly separate from sales targets, customer acquisition, BD pipeline ownership, commercial negotiation, and commercial close responsibilities, which remain with Sales / Business Development.  
Ensure the strategy remains co-developed between Sales and COA Management by bringing implementation feasibility, scientific quality, portfolio readiness, and operational scalability into strategic discussions.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in public health, health economics, outcomes research, health informatics, life sciences, healthcare administration, business/product management, or related field; advanced degree preferred.  
7+ years of experience in Population Health, HEOR, RWE, healthcare implementation, health-system consulting, registry strategy, outcomes research, digital health, quality measurement, market access, or related roles.  
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders, ambiguous scope, implementation dependencies, and evolving operating models.  
Prior COA/PRO experience is strongly preferred but can be developed if the candidate has strong Population Health implementation and healthcare-system expertise.  
Ability to translate complex scientific, technical, operational, legal, quality-measurement, reimbursement, and commercial requirements into scalable workflows, governance tools, readiness frameworks, service catalogues, and implementation materials.  
Excellent communication, facilitation, executive-ready writing, and stakeholder-influence skills, including the ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences.  
Strong project/program management discipline, including roadmap development, milestone tracking, dependency management, risk/issue management, action tracking, and governance reporting.  
English fluency, spoken and written, is required.

* Own high-impact analytical initiatives spanning Finance, Product, Marketing, and Operations.
* Influence executive decisions through data, strategic thinking, and business partnering.
* Join a collaborative, high-performing team where your analyses directly contribute to company performance and long-term success.

**Our Principles**

* **Challenge, disagree and commit** - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

**DESCRIPTION** We are looking for an IAM IT Operations and Service Manager to join the Identity and Access Management PSL (Product Service Line) in Albacete, Spain. IAM PSL is part of IM (Information Management), in the Infrastructures \\& Digital Platforms department.

Identity and Access Management (IAM) products enable our internal and external users to be properly identified, authenticated \\& authorized to access Airbus Helicopters and Airbus Group Applications.

The AH IAM PSL delivers and deploys the solution, products and services with an end-to-end accountability. We will manage the products lifecycle, both developing the products and operating them, in close relationships with Airbus Group.

Our Access IT products sustain Authentication, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Encryption and digital certificates. And our Identity IT Products sustain User management (Provisionning/Deprovisionning, Privileged accounts, Recertification, …) and Directory services (Identity Directory, Metadata Synchronization, …) The IAM IT Products are mainly : PingIdentity products (PingFederate and PingID), F5 bigIP and Microsoft PKI for Access. And Active Directory, Identity Management, OneLogin for Identity. Automation is running on Ansible; Cyber IAM is based on Oradad, PingCastle and Silvefort; Incident and Change management on Service NOW. The compliance dashboard uses Palantir Foundry.

* *Tracking the execution of the request, change and incident within the defined lead time.*
* *Document in the incident or associated document precise information in order to accelerate the next tricky similar cases.*

description:
**Job title:** Global Category Manager **Location:** Europe, preferably in Spain **Reports to:** VP of Procurement **Job type:** Full-time

**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV AND COVER LETTER IN ENGLISH FOR CONSIDERATION**

**Overview:** NSI is a leading player in the natural private label food industry, dedicated to providing high-quality, organic, and sustainably sourced food products to consumers. We believe in promoting healthy and conscious eating choices, and our range of products reflects our commitment to quality and sustainability.

**Mission:** The Global Category Manager is responsible for securing a resilient, cost-competitive, and high-quality global supply chain for NSI's strategic raw materials while protecting the business from commodity volatility, supply disruptions, geopolitical risks, and supplier performance failures. Beyond managing existing supply networks, this leader serves as a strategic business development partner by identifying, developing, and commercializing new supply chains, ingredients, origins, and supplier relationships that enable new customer opportunities, product innovation, and profitable growth. By building strategic supplier partnerships and leveraging market intelligence, this role will create sustainable sourcing capabilities that fuel NSI's long-term growth.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute global sourcing strategies that secure a resilient, cost-competitive, and high-quality supply of NSI's strategic raw materials.
* Build new global supply chains that create competitive advantage, enable new business opportunities, and support product innovation.
* Identify, qualify, and develop strategic suppliers across Africa, India, Southeast Asia, South America, and other key sourcing regions.
* Lead commercial negotiations for supply agreements, pricing structures, and forward-buying strategies that protect margins while ensuring supply continuity.
* Monitor global commodity markets, crop conditions, geopolitical events, freight, currency, and other market dynamics to provide actionable market intelligence and pricing recommendations.
* Develop supplier diversification strategies that mitigate geographic, climate, supplier concentration, and geopolitical risks.
* Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships through regular international travel to supplier origins, trade shows, and industry events (approximately 40% travel).

* Implement supplier performance management processes, including scorecards, KPIs, contract governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure suppliers meet NSI's food safety, quality, sustainability, traceability, and regulatory requirements.

* Minimum 10 years’ experience in commodity trading, with a focus on organic food ingredients.
* Experience sourcing at least one commodity or product category aligned with NSI's portfolio, with the ability to expand into additional categories.
* Demonstrated success developing suppliers and sourcing programs across Africa, India, Southeast Asia, and/or South America.
* Extensive experience with agricultural commodities, commodity markets, supplier negotiations, and forward pricing strategies.
* Strong commercial instincts with the ability to identify sourcing opportunities that create competitive advantage and new business opportunities.
* Excellent negotiation skills with the ability to build long-term supplier partnerships while achieving favorable commercial outcomes.
* High business acumen with a strong understanding of commodity economics, landed costs, freight, tariffs, foreign exchange, and supply chain risk.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate market trends and make data-driven decisions.
* Exceptional relationship-building, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally approximately 40% of the time.

**Education and experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree required in Business, Economics, International Trade, Supply Chain, Agribusiness, or a related field. Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred, especially with a focus on international trade, supply chain, or finance.
* Experience with SAP or comparable ERP systems and sourcing analytics tools preferred.

title: Data Governance Analyst
description:
**About MediaRadar** MediaRadar, equips marketing, sales and analytics leaders with the intelligence they need to stay ahead. Our platform delivers always-on, AI-enabled Creative, Competitive, Commercial and Market Intelligence—spanning ad strategy, media spend, creative assets and brand messaging across 30+ media channels and five million brands.

The result: faster, cleaner and more actionable intelligence that drives competitive advantage.

**About the Role** We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Governance Analyst to support the day-to-day execution of our taxonomy, rules, and reference data framework. This role turns governance standards into working artifacts — authoring and maintaining taxonomies, business term definitions, and data rules in our governance platform, and keeping them accurate, consistent, and free of conflict as the organization scales.

You will be the hands-on engine behind the governance function, working closely with the Senior Data Governance Lead, Data Operations, and the Reference Data team to maintain the rule and taxonomy libraries that drive classification and data quality. This is a high-ownership, execution-focused role for someone who values structure and precision and wants to see governance standards actually used in production rather than living only as documentation.

**Requirements** **Responsibilities**

* Author, maintain, and version taxonomies, business term definitions, and classification hierarchies in the governance platform.
* Translate approved governance decisions into structured, testable data rules and apply rule IDs consistently across taxonomies.
* Run routine rule-library analysis to detect duplicates, conflicts, and coverage gaps, and prepare findings for governance review.
* Maintain metadata, documentation, and change history so definitions and rules remain traceable and auditable.
* Support intake and triage of new rule and definition requests from Data Operations and business stakeholders.
* Prepare reference data and golden-record candidates for governance certification, flagging anomalies and exceptions.
* Produce clear documentation and quick-reference guides that help stewards and analysts apply standards independently.
* Assist in preparing governance reporting, dashboards, and stakeholder updates.

**Success Measures**

**Success in this role will be measured by:**

* Rule \\& Taxonomy Integrity – Low and declining rates of duplicate, conflicting, or orphaned rules and definitions.
* Coverage – Measurable progress against taxonomy and reference data coverage targets across tiers.
* Turnaround – Timely, accurate processing of rule and definition requests within agreed SLAs.
* Traceability – Complete, auditable change history and documentation for governed artifacts.
* Usability – Stewards and analysts can apply standards from documentation without repeated escalation.
* Operationalization – Authored rules and definitions are actively used in classification and quality workflows.

**Key Qualifications and Role Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in data governance, data management, data quality, analytics, or data operations.
* Hands-on experience maintaining taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, business glossaries, or rule libraries.
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data, spreadsheets, and governance tooling.
* Ability to translate governance decisions into precise, consistent, testable rules.
* Comfort with ambiguity and evolving standards in a maturing governance environment.
* Familiarity with data quality dimensions (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness).
* Exposure to DAMA / DMBOK concepts a plus.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.

We help organizations make better decisions by giving data analysts, business analysts, GIS professionals and developers faster, more flexible and more secure ways to analyze and visualize spatial data, whether that means optimizing network planning, assessing risk or identifying growth opportunities.

With 150+ team members across the US and Europe, and backing from top-tier investors (Insight Partners, Accel, Salesforce Ventures and more), CARTO is disrupting legacy GIS with a modern, cloud-native approach.

We are looking for a commercially driven Partner and Alliance Manager to grow CARTO's partner-sourced revenue across North America. You will build a named portfolio of system integrators, take them from signature to production, and structure the commercial terms that turn partner activity into recurring revenue.

Our cloud alliances are the foundation we build our partner motion on. Snowflake, Google Cloud, Databricks, Oracle and AWS are where our customers already run their data and AI. You will maintain those relationships across North America and use them to open and accelerate the integrator motion built on top. The better together story is the point: the cloud platform holds the data, the integrator delivers the programme, and CARTO is the spatial layer that makes it work.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role, ideal for someone with practical experience of integrator practices, cloud data platforms, and spatial analytics or GIS.

This seat sits on the US East Coast, or in a time zone offering equivalent daily overlap with the Global Partner Director and the EMEA-based partner team. Candidates outside the US who meet the overlap requirement will be considered.### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Build a named North American integrator portfolio.** Activate priority partners, move them into production, and hold them to committed quarterly volumes of qualified opportunity.
* **Develop each partner into a selling practice.** Take partners through technical enablement, into joint solutioning, then a first co-sell, and on to delivering in their own right. Back this with sales-led demand activity such as roundtables, client events and technical workshops.
* **Structure commercial agreements that lead to revenue.** Negotiate reseller, OEM and partner instance terms. Propose margin and discount within approved bands. Own deal registration and the rules of engagement with our direct sales team, and resolve channel conflict quickly when it arises.
* **Maintain CARTO's cloud alliances in North America.** Own the day-to-day relationships with Snowflake, Google Cloud, Databricks, Oracle and AWS, co-sell alongside their field teams, and use those relationships as the route into integrator opportunity. Handle marketplace transactions and partner funding requests as they arise.
* **Qualify and forecast with discipline.** Every partner-originated opportunity is qualified to MEDDPICC. Keep Salesforce clean on partner records and sourced versus influenced attribution, and give a grounded call on what lands this quarter and next.
* **Represent partners internally.** Carry partner needs and alignment across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Product and Engineering.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

* 6 to +10 years in partnerships, channel or business development, ideally in a System Integrator focused on B2B SaaS, data and analytics, or geospatial.
* **Demonstrable sell-through revenue.** Resale, OEM, embedded or partner-delivered, not solely referral or co-sell attainment.
* A track record of building a delivery practice inside a partner, from first technical enablement through to the partner selling and delivering independently.
* Experience at both ends of the integrator spectrum: the global firms such as Deloitte, Capgemini, Accenture and Slalom, and the specialist data and geospatial integrators.
* Fluency in channel commercial mechanics: margin models, discount bands, deal registration, rules of engagement and channel conflict.
* Working knowledge of the cloud data ecosystem and its partner programs across Snowflake, Google Cloud, Databricks, Oracle and AWS.
* Comfort with MEDDPICC, or an equivalent methodology, and the credibility to hold partners to it.
* Strong North American market knowledge, with spatial analytics or GIS experience strongly preferred. Public sector exposure is a plus.
* You use AI to scale your own output, and you can show how.
* Collaborative by instinct. Our partner team runs as one global group with a shared number and deliberately overlapping remits, which works through real-time collaboration rather than handoff.

### **Benefits**

* Competitive compensation and stock options
* Private medical insurance
* Flexible remote work culture
* A truly global, diverse team
* The chance to build a channel business, not inherit one

### **About CARTO** We specialize in delivering innovative solutions and exceptional services to meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we strive to exceed expectations and drive success in every project we undertake.
