title: Head of Consumer Finance
description:
We are **Impress**. We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love.

We are the largest chain of ortho clinics with fully digital processes. We have revolutionized the invisible orthodontic sector with the best team of professionals specialized in making people smile and using the latest technology for the diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of all cases.

Born in Barcelona in 2019, in just 6 years, we’ve grown to pioneer leading care, flagship clinics and state-of-the-art tech across 10 countries and more than 150 locations, and we are expanding fast! Our aim is to improve people’s health and quality of life across the globe.

At Impress, we are scaling at an unprecedented pace. As our **Head of Consumer Finance department**, you will own and scale our Consumer Finance function at group level. Reporting to the CFO, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of patient financing: negotiating commercial terms and credit facilities with financing partners, expanding our partner network across markets, and leading the operations team that ensures every local Sales organization offers the right financing solution for each patient.

This is a high-impact, group-level role combining commercial negotiation, partnership management and operational leadership across an international footprint.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Commercial \\& Partnership Strategy**

* Manage the global consumer finance strategy and partner roadmap across all market
* Negotiate and renegotiate commercial terms (rates, fees, acceptance criteria, settlement terms) with existing and new financing partners to improve economics as the business scale
* Secure expanded credit facilities and capacity commitments to support patient volume growth
* Identify, evaluate and onboard new financing partners and products (installment lending, BNPL, medical loans) tailored to each market
* Benchmark partner performance on approval rates, cost, conversion and patient experience, maintaining healthy competition across providers.

**Operations \\& Team Leaders**

* Lead, mentor and develop a Consumer Finance Operations team of 3–4 people
* Ensure local Sales teams are equipped with the right financing options and procedures for each patient profile, maximizing approval and conversion rates
* Define and standardize financing workflows, eligibility criteria and escalation processes across countries
* Act as the central point of coordination between financing partners, local Sales and Country teams, Finance and Compliance.

**Performance, Analytics \\& Governance**

* Own the key performance indicators for the function: approval rates, cost of finance, conversion and partner profitability by market
* Build reporting and dashboards for leadership on consumer finance performance and its impact on the patient journey
* Ensure compliance with consumer credit regulation, data protection and partner contractual obligations across all jurisdictions
* Partner with Finance on forecasting, budgeting and planning related to financing terms.

**Candidate Profile**

* 8+ years' experience in consumer finance, lending partnerships, payments/BNPL, fintech or financial services, including direct commercial negotiation responsibility
* Proven track record negotiating credit facilities and partner agreements at scale
* Experience managing and developing high-performing teams
* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with a solid grasp of consumer credit economics
* International or multi-market experience
* Fluent Spanish and English (working language); additional European languages an advantage
* Excellent stakeholder management across commercial, operational and senior leadership levels
* Experience in healthcare, dental, elective medical or high-ticket consumer services
* Experience scaling a function within a high-growth, investor-backed environment.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
**We power people’s progress.**
 At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

**Meet the team!**
 At Preply, data is at the heart of every decision we make. We run hundreds of A/B tests to continually optimize our product, each with its own analytical and tracking challenges. The complexity of our subscription model, along with the unique dynamics of tutor-learner interactions, offers an exciting opportunity for those looking to make a real impact.

As a Staff Data Scientist , you will own the data strategy for a critical product domain (e.g., Growth, Retention, Marketplace) and act as the senior analytical authority in that space. You will partner with Directors and VPs across Product, Engineering, and Business to shape long-term strategy, influence investment decisions, and ensure our roadmap is grounded in rigorous, scalable measurement frameworks.

Our Data Team is dedicated to empowering top-quality decision-making. Do you want to know how? Visit our Tech Radar to learn about the technologies we use at Preply!

**What you’ll be doing:**
* Develop and formalize a strategic understanding of the key value drivers of your domain, including user behavior, marketplace dynamics, pricing, and long-term unit economics - and translate these into actionable decision frameworks used by leadership.
* Define the long-term measurement and experimentation strategy for your domain, identifying structural growth levers and step-change opportunities beyond incremental optimization.
* Design the experimentation programme in your domain and execute, and evaluate large-scale experiments to test new ideas and measure their effectiveness in driving business outcomes.
* Lead deep analytical investigations into customer behavior and retention dynamics, reframing ambiguous business questions into structured analyses that drive step-change improvements in long-term value.
* Own impact modeling and scenario analysis for major product initiatives, enabling quarterly and annual planning decisions through robust forecasting, trade-off analysis, and risk assessment.
* Own the definition and governance of key metrics within your domain, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment with company-level objectives.
* Act as a senior thought partner to product, engineering, and data leaders, driving alignment across teams and elevating analytical standards across the organization.
* Lead cross-domain analytical initiatives (e.g., company-wide LTV modeling, pricing strategy, marketplace health framework).

**What you need to succeed:**
* Demonstrated track record of materially influencing product or business strategy in complex environments, with clear examples of company-level impact.
* Expertise in experimentation and causal inference, including operating under imperfect conditions, resolving ambiguity, and guiding high-stakes decisions where clean experiments are not always feasible.
* Strong understanding of subscription and marketplace economics, including LTV modeling, cohort dynamics, retention mechanics, pricing trade-offs, and long-term value optimization.
* Strong technical proficiency (e.g., SQL, Python) with the ability to review and elevate the analytical work of others, set coding standards, and design scalable analytical workflows.
* Experience mentoring and technically guiding senior data scientists, contributing to the overall growth and maturity of the data organization.
* Curiosity, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, as well as the ability to proactively identify and address challenges.
* Ability to influence Directors and VP-level stakeholders, navigate conflicting incentives, and drive clarity in high-stakes strategic discussions.
* Interest in the bigger picture, feeling excited to impact the product roadmap and strategy.

**Nice to have:**
* Background in 2-sided marketplaces or digital businesses (B2C, B2B2C).
* Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Amplitude, Mixpanel, Heap).
* Experience applying advanced analytical methods (e.g., forecasting, causal modeling, pricing optimization) to drive structural business improvements.
* Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
* Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field.
* Demonstrated experience developing Senior Data Scientists and contributing to raising the analytical bar across teams.

**Why you’ll love it at Preply**
* An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
* A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning \\& Development budget and time off for your self-development;
* A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
* Access to free mental health support platforms;
* The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!)

**Our Principles**
* Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.
* We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.
* Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.
* Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.
* Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.
* Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.
* Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.
* Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.
* Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.
* One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

title: Senior Principal Business Analyst
description:
**Craft:**
 Data, Analytics \\& Strategy

**Job Description:**
 We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded
 **Senior Principal Business Analyst** 
 to join our Growth Analytics organization in a role focused on improving how King understands, models, and scales growth.

This role sits at the intersection of Marketing, Product, Finance, Analytics, and our game teams. You will work on some of the most important commercial questions for the business: how marketing investment translates into player growth, revenue, profitability, and long-term company performance; how CPI, RPI, elasticity, incrementality, and player quality interact; and where King should invest to unlock the next level of sustainable growth.

As Senior Principal Business Analyst, you will help raise the quality of the analytical and commercial thinking behind major growth decisions. You will shape how models are interpreted, challenge whether assumptions make sense, connect insights across teams, and ensure outputs are translated into better investment, forecasting, and strategic decisions.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can operate independently in ambiguous environments, bring structure to complex business questions, and influence senior stakeholders through analytical depth, commercial judgement, and clear communication.

Your Role Within Our Kingdom

* Define the Commercial Logic Behind Growth Decisions You will help establish the frameworks King uses to interpret growth performance, evaluate investment opportunities, and connect marketing activity to broader company outcomes. You will ensure that models, assumptions, and recommendations are not only analytically sound, but commercially meaningful and relevant to senior decision-making.
* Set the Standard for Growth Model Interpretation You will raise the quality of how analytical models are interpreted and applied across the business. This includes assessing outputs from attribution, elasticity, incrementality, forecasting, or player-value models, identifying where outputs are directionally useful or commercially fragile, and ensuring insights are translated into decisions the business can confidently act on.
* Strengthen Forecasting, Elasticity, and Investment Governance You will shape how forecasting and investment assumptions are created, tested, and governed across growth planning. You will assess how CPI, RPI, player quality, product performance, marketing scale, marginal returns, payback, and expected value interact, ensuring assumptions are evidence-based, commercially realistic, and aligned with company goals.
* Guide Portfolio-Level Growth Trade-Offs You will bring structure to complex investment questions across games, channels, geographies, audiences, and marketing initiatives. You will help senior stakeholders understand where additional investment is likely to create value, where returns may begin to soften, and where alternative growth opportunities or product synergies should be prioritised.
* Connect Marketing, Product, Finance, and Company Performance You will shape how the organisation understands the relationship between marketing performance, product outcomes, player behaviour, monetisation, retention, live operations, and company-level growth. You will identify where product momentum, marketing activity, and portfolio strategy can reinforce each other to create stronger commercial outcomes.
* Drive Better Executive Decision-Making You will turn complex analysis, model outputs, and uncertain evidence into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. You will explain what we know, what we do not know, which assumptions matter most, and what trade-offs are required. Your focus will be on improving the quality, consistency, and confidence of strategic growth decisions across the organisation.
* Raise the Analytical Bar Across Teams You will act as a senior expert and multiplier across Growth Analytics and partner teams. You will coach others on commercial reasoning, modelling interpretation, assumption quality, and executive communication, helping build stronger analytical judgement across the organisation.

Skills to Create Thrills

* Advanced Analytical and Commercial Thinking You are highly skilled at turning ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems, connecting data, assumptions, and commercial context to clear recommendations.
* Financial and Growth Acumen You understand how marketing investment connects to revenue, profitability, forecasting, and company-level performance. You are comfortable working with concepts such as CPI, RPI, ROAS, payback, incrementality, marginal returns, player quality, and investment efficiency.
* Elasticity and Forecasting Expertise You have experience working with elasticity, response curves, scenario modelling, investment planning, or commercial performance models. You understand how changes in investment can affect both cost and return, and how to assess whether scaling assumptions are realistic.
* Technical Fluency and Model Judgement You are comfortable working with large datasets and analytical workflows using SQL, Python, R, or similar tools. You have the technical fluency to understand model logic, challenge outputs, identify weak assumptions, and assess whether conclusions are well supported by the evidence.
* Cross-Functional Influence You can work effectively with Marketing, Product, Finance, Analytics, and game teams, creating clarity around complex questions and helping stakeholders align around better decisions.
* Executive Communication and Judgement You can explain complex analytical concepts in simple, business-relevant language. You know when to go deep, when to simplify, when to challenge, and how to communicate uncertainty, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

Tasty Bonus Points

* Experience in gaming, mobile apps, digital entertainment, or another high-scale consumer business.
* Experience working on marketing investment models, response curves, elasticity analysis, forecasting frameworks, attribution models, or commercial planning tools.
* Experience connecting marketing performance with product outcomes, engagement, retention, monetisation, or portfolio-level financial performance.
* Experience working closely with Finance teams on forecasts, investment cases, budget planning, or business performance reviews.
* Knowledge of tools and platforms such as BigQuery, Looker, Airflow, Python, R, or modern data modelling workflows.
* A passion for using data to improve strategic decision-making, challenge assumptions, and unlock sustainable growth.

**About King**
 With a mission of
 *Making the World Playful* 
 , King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as
 *Farm Heroes Saga* 
 . King games are played by more than 200 million monthly active users. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Commerce Analytics & Insights
description:
What You'll Do:

We are looking for a senior, strategic, and hands-on Data Scientist to lead the data and methodological backbone of Commerce Analytics and Commerce Insights at Criteo. This person will own the analytical rigor behind the work: building and improving pipelines, understanding source tables and data dependencies, ensuring reliable execution, and defining or validating the methodologies behind key metrics and outputs.

This role is not only about producing analyses. It is about creating trusted, scalable analytical foundations for Commerce Analytics and Insights, while staying close enough to business context to ensure the work remains relevant and useful.

Success in this role means pipelines and analytical workflows are reliable, maintainable, and trusted; metrics are clearly defined, methodologically sound, and consistently applied; and analytical outputs are accurate and resilient enough for repeated commercial use. Data dependencies, assumptions, and limitations should be documented and understood, while manual analytical work should decrease over time as scalable solutions are introduced.

This role is not the primary owner of client orchestration or commercial project leadership. Its center of gravity is data execution, methodological rigor, and scalable analytical foundations.

What You'll Do

* Own the data-science and analytical execution layer of Commerce Analytics and Commerce Insights
* Build, improve, and maintain data pipelines that power recurring analytics and insightgeneration
* Develop deep understanding of source tables, data lineage, business logic, and data qualityrisks
* Ensure analytical outputs are correct, consistent, and operationally reliable
* Define, document, challenge, and improve methodologies behind key metrics, cuts, andanalytical frameworks
* Partner with Solution Architect and commercial stakeholders to translate business questionsinto robust analytical approaches
* Drive the hands-on execution of analyses across commerce analytics and commerce insightsuse cases
* Create scalable approaches rather than one-off manual work whenever possible
* Investigate data issues, edge cases, or inconsistencies and resolve them with strongownership
* Contribute to documentation, process improvement, and knowledge transfer so that work canscale beyond one individual
* Help identify where automation, standardization, or better data design can improve quality and speed
* Stay close to business context so that technical execution remains aligned with client and program needs Who You Are:

* Senior and hands-on, with strong ownership of both execution and quality
* Deeply comfortable with data engineering and pipelines, analytical logic, and metric design
* Strong SQL, Python, spark and strong coding skills for data processing and workflowdevelopment
* Experience building production-grade or near-production analytical pipelines
* Experience documenting methods and educating stakeholders on metric definitions and analytical caveats is a plus
* Able to understand what tables mean, how they connect, and where business interpretation can go wrong
* Methodologically rigorous, with strong judgment on how to define and validate metrics
* Structured and practical: you can move from ambiguous business questions to executable analytical solutions
* Comfortable collaborating with client-facing and non-technical stakeholders, even if this is not the center of gravity of the role
* Strategic enough to improve the system, not just execute within it
* Significant experience in data science, analytics engineering, analytical product work, or a similar role in a data-rich environment
* Strong understanding of experimentation, metrics, methodology design, and analytical QA
* Experience working with large-scale behavioral, commerce, or media datasets We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!

Who We Are:

We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks \\& mental health support.

🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.

💸 Fair pay \\& perks – Attractive salary, with performance-based rewards and family-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.

Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

title: Business Analyst (BI & Data)
description:
En
 **RockStar Data** 
 ayudamos a bares, restaurantes y grupos de ocio nocturno a entender su negocio con datos reales, no con intuiciones.

Conectamos sus herramientas operativas (TPV, contabilidad, RRHH, reservas, compras) a un Data Warehouse propio y las traducimos en dashboards claros, KPIs financieros en tiempo real y asistentes de IA para interactuar directamente con la información del negocio.

Buscamos un/a Business Analyst que actúe como puente estratégico entre las necesidades de negocio de nuestros clientes y el equipo técnico de Data \\& AI, garantizando que cada métrica, proceso y dashboard aporte un valor directo a la toma de decisiones.

Tareas

**¿Cuál será tu misión?** Liderar la toma de requerimientos de negocio, el diseño funcional de KPIs y la validación de soluciones analíticas, asegurando que los datos integrados en nuestra plataforma reflejen fielmente la realidad operativa y financiera de nuestros clientes.

**Tus responsabilidades**

* **Toma y traducción de requerimientos:** 
 Identificar las necesidades analíticas de los clientes y traducirlas en especificaciones funcionales, historias de usuario y modelos de procesos.
  
* **Definición y validación de KPIs:** 
 Diseñar y auditar reglas de negocio para métricas clave (EBITDA, margen sobre ventas, COGS, ticket medio, productividad laboral, inventario) asegurando máxima precisión.
  
* **Mapeo e integración de sistemas:** 
 Analizar la estructura de datos de los sistemas de origen de los clientes (POS/TPV, ERPs contables, gestores de turnos) para guiarlos en la estandarización de sus datos.
  
* **Pruebas de aceptación y calidad (UAT):** 
 Validar dashboards, modelos de datos y respuestas del chat de IA antes del despliegue en producción, garantizando la trazabilidad lógica de los números.
  
* **Facilitación y workshops:** 
 Conducir sesiones de discovery y seguimiento con clientes y stakeholders clave para priorizar necesidades y refinar el backlog analítico.
  
* **Optimización de procesos:** 
 Proponer mejoras continuas en la estructura de dashboards, documentación funcional y flujos de trabajo entre el cliente y el equipo técnico.

Requisitos

**¿Qué buscamos en ti?**

* Experiencia: 1–3 años en roles de Business Analysis, Análisis Funcional o Consultoría de Negocio/BI.
  
* Formación: Grado en ADE, Economía, Finanzas, Business Analytics, Ingeniería Industrial o similar.
  
* Criterio financiero y de negocio: Dominio sólido de P\\&L, márgenes operativos y estructura de costes empresarial.
  
* Herramientas de datos: Manejo intermedio/avanzado de herramientas de visualización (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau) y conocimientos prácticos de SQL para exploración de datos.
  
* Habilidades de comunicación: Capacidad para estructurar problemas complejos y explicarlos con claridad tanto a perfiles técnicos como a propietarios o directores de operaciones.
  
* Gestión de proyectos: Familiaridad con metodologías ágiles (Scrum/Kanban) y herramientas de gestión (Jira, Notion).

**Valoraremos positivamente:**

* Experiencia previa en el sector de la hostelería, restauración, retail o SaaS B2B.
  
* Interés o experiencia aplicada en tecnologías de Generative AI e integración de modelos LLM en flujos de datos.
  
* Conocimientos sobre arquitectura de datos en la nube (BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake).

Beneficios

**¿Qué ofrecemos?**

* Modalidad hibrida en Barcelona centro.
  
* Salario competitivo según valía y experiencia aportada.
  
* Impacto directo: Formarás parte del núcleo del producto en una fase de crecimiento acelerado, transformando la gestión digital de un sector clave.
  
* Formación y desarrollo: Aprendizaje continuo en arquitectura de datos moderna, BI avanzado e Inteligencia Artificial aplicada.
  
* Cultura: Entorno dinámico, transparente y enfocado a resultados.

RockStar Data no es un SaaS más.

Es la infraestructura que está profesionalizando la hostelería desde dentro. Si te apasiona entender cómo los números cuentan historias y quieres aprender a convertir datos en decisiones...
 **te estámos esperando.**

 You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

**Docplanner at scale**
 We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us.

**And why should you join us?**
 Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

In this role as a Product Analyst at Docplanner you'll own the metrics and analytical direction for your product area, working directly with Product Directors to influence strategy and roadmap priorities. Your insights will drive real decisions: what we build, what we kill, and where we invest next.

This means the autonomy to dig into the problems that matter, challenge conventional thinking, and push for change when the data tells a different story. You'll define what success looks like, build the frameworks to measure it, and make sure every major decision is backed by solid analysis.

You'll work with a talented team of analysts, researchers, product managers, designers, and engineers who are obsessed with building the best product. Your analyses will directly shape Product strategy and influence how millions of patients and healthcare professionals experience Docplanner.

 DP Payments is a sub-unit of two fully autonomous product teams, PMs, engineers and a designer — with the mandate and capability to work across virtually any app or repository in the Docplanner ecosystem. We're building a new revenue stream for the company, which means combining the maturity of a scale-up with the agility of a startup.

 Payments has to live inside almost every app and view Docplanner has. We don't get the comfort of a greenfield or a clean separation, but we're held to the expectations of one. The challenge is to keep iterating fast inside a complex ecosystem of mature processes and products.

* Build, maintain and continuously evolve the analytics stack for a complex set of processes spread across many apps and technologies — centred on accepting and processing patient payments to doctors and clinics for their appointments.

**Who are you?**
* You are curious by nature, and you love to ask and answer questions and dig into data.

* You have an excellent understanding of statistics.
* You enjoy constant learning and high autonomy.

* You are familiar with complex Product organizations in the SaaS market.

title: Product Analyst
description:
Due to continuous growth, our Product team is excited to welcome a highly analytical
 **Product Analyst** 
 to help us align data-driven decision-making with business goals across three products at once, each at a different stage.

As Product Analyst, you'll operate on the intersection of product analytics and business analysis: you don't just explain why a funnel underperforms, you translate that into what it means in euros, risk, and compliance terms. You'll work in a fully MCP-equipped, AI-native environment, own the event taxonomy across all three products, automate recurring reporting so you have the time to go genuinely deep on each product, and act as the go-to person for the Growth team on everything A/B testing.

Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Growth, SEM, and Payments, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful, structural impact — not just on individual metrics, but on how the whole team thinks about data.

If you're passionate about solving complex problems, taking full ownership without waiting to be asked, and driving results across multiple products at once, this role is perfect for you!

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product analytics core**
* Independently run funnel, cohort, and retention analysis in Amplitude across all three products.
* Design and interpret experiments (A/B tests), with a clear eye for primary vs. diagnostic metrics.
* Go deeper than headline numbers through segmentation (by country, user segment, acquisition channel, etc.).

Go-to person for Growth on A/B testing

* Be the single point of contact for the Growth team on everything experiment-related: test design, sample size, choice of primary vs. diagnostic metrics, and interpretation of results.
* Be consulted before a test goes live, not only once results come in — safeguarding experiment quality upfront, not just in hindsight.
* Recognize and correct common experimentation pitfalls (peeking, dependent variants, poorly chosen success metrics) before they lead to a flawed rollout decision.

Business and risk layer

* Translate product metrics into unit economics: what a conversion drop costs in ARPPU, CAC, or margin.
* Model scenarios (e.g. the impact of a price change on both conversion and downstream risk indicators).
* Produce output that non-product stakeholders (Payments, SEM, Growth, Finance, C-level) can act on directly — not only PMs.

Ownership: taxonomy \\& reporting

* Own the event taxonomy across all products: proactively track which events are live or deprecated, document renames as they happen, and prevent outdated event names (in skills, dashboards, or AI prompts) from silently producing wrong conclusions. This is a recurring responsibility, not a one-off documentation task — every product release can affect the taxonomy.
* Automate reporting to free up time for depth: turn recurring analyses (funnel health, KPI reviews, country splits) from manual pulls into self-running dashboards/skills, so stakeholders always have current numbers without needing to ask an analyst — and so the time freed up goes into genuinely deep analysis per product, not more of the same routine work.
* Proactively dig into where things "leak": don't wait to be asked — actively look for underperforming segments or funnel steps, and for untapped business opportunities surfacing from the data, then raise them unprompted with PMs or the Project Director.

Take the team by the hand, analytically

* This is not a purely individual-contributor role: bring PMs (and other stakeholders) along in how you reach a conclusion, not just what the conclusion is, so they get better themselves at asking the right data question.
* Actively spot and correct conclusions that the data doesn't support (e.g. correlation presented as causation, or an underpowered sample treated as significant).
* Be the team's analytical conscience: when there's doubt about a number or interpretation, you're the person people turn to — and you take on that responsibility proactively rather than waiting to be asked.

AI leverage

* Work in an environment fully set up with MCPs (Amplitude, Databricks, Linear, Google Drive, etc.) — this is the default way of working, not an experiment on the side.
* Build and maintain reusable Amplitude skills and analysis tooling.
* Use LLMs actively for query generation, first-pass analysis, and reporting.
* Critically evaluate and correct AI output: recognize when a model uses an outdated event name, incorrectly sums a non-additive metric, repeats a stale assumption, or draws a conclusion the underlying data doesn't support.
* Know when not to trust AI: with ambiguous data, conflicting results, or output that sounds "too clean."

**Required Skills**
 We're looking for someone who combines exceptional analytical depth with genuine ownership and the ability to bring others along. Here's what we're looking for:

* Exceptional analytical ability — this isn't a "can write adequate SQL" role; you spot patterns others miss, untangle conflicting signals, and reach the right conclusion under time pressure.
* Independent working knowledge of Amplitude or a comparable product-analytics tool (or demonstrable SQL proficiency to pick this up quickly).
* Experience designing experiments (A/B testing) — able to explain what makes a good primary metric and why.
* Comfortable with unit economics — CAC, LTV, ARPPU, margin — not as buzzwords but as a working model.
* An AI-native way of working: daily use of LLMs throughout the analysis workflow, combined with a critical, verifying mindset.
* A self-starter: capable of setting up your own tooling and workflow in an MCP-rich environment without needing direction — you don't wait for an instruction to build a skill or dashboard, you spot where automation frees up time and act on it.
* Demonstrable proactivity: concrete examples of self-initiated analyses (not requested) that led to a real action or business insight.
* An affinity for maintaining documentation and structure over time (taxonomy, tracking plans) — precision work that quietly erodes if no one explicitly owns it.
* A demonstrated ability to bring others along — not only reaching the right conclusion yourself, but helping colleagues (PMs, engineering) get better at reading and questioning data themselves.

* Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
* The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).

title: Principal Data Analyst
description:
**Who We Are**
**Let's have fun shaping your future!**
 We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga \\& Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them!

**Position Overview**
 We’re looking for a Principal Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. In this senior role, you’ll be a key partner to our game teams, shaping product strategy and driving impactful data-driven decisions that improve our games, boost player engagement, and fuel business growth.

You’ll combine deep quantitative analysis, business acumen, and technical expertise to uncover insights that matter. As a Principal, you’ll also help elevate analytics standards across the company, mentor analysts, and champion a culture of data-informed decision-making.

**What You'll Do**
* Help Shape the Game Strategy: Be a part of the development of data-driven strategies for top games, influencing product roadmaps, features, and monetization.
* Player \\& Product Insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze player behavior, economy trends, and product performance.
* Experimentation \\& Modeling: Design A/B tests and build predictive models (e.g., churn, LTV, segmentation) to assess and forecast outcomes.
* Leadership \\& Communication: Mentor analysts and present insights clearly to senior leadership through compelling storytelling and dashboards.

* Experience in analytics or data science roles, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products.
* Strong business sense and product intuition; you understand how to prioritize what matters most.
* Solid experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and experimentation design.
* Strong background in applied statistics; experience with Bayesian methods is a plus.
* Expert proficiency in SQL and Python for data exploration and analysis.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.
* Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience working with visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or similar.
* Experience mentoring or leading other analysts is a big plus.
* Fast learner, highly meticulous, proactive, and pragmatic.

title: Growth Analytics Engineer [España]🇪🇸
description:
En
 **Product Hackers** 
 estamos construyendo
 **el mejor equipo de Growth del mundo** 
 . Personas altamente creativas, inteligentes e ingeniosas pero con mente científica y absoluta obsesión por los productos digitales. Queremos ser el Space X del Growth, por eso buscamos a los mejores humanos, con las mejores capacidades para convertirlos en astronautas.

Si quieres sumergirte en el universo de los productos digitales, visitar los planetas de nuestros clientes (sus productos digitales) y terraformarlos para que puedan albergar vida (usuarios y clientes) este es el lugar ideal para pasar de ser un mísero humano a un astronauta del producto digital. Sí, también somos muy frikis del espacioX y esas cosas.

*🚀* 
 Además, en Product Hackers encontrarás un equipo que aprende y comparte constantemente, que busca que las ideas se experimenten, se prueben y se implementen sin miedo, porque aquí compartimos aprendizajes, crecemos juntos gracias a esta pasión por el Growth **Somos
 **remote-first** 
 y contamos con grandes profesionales de diferentes puntos del mundo.**
****¿CUÁL ES TU MISIÓN?****
 Como Growth Analytics Engineer, tu misión será que el dato del que dependen las decisiones sea fiable: instrumentar bien desde el principio, auditar lo que ya existe y dejar la medición preparada para experimentar. Trabajarás sobre e-commerce y producto, y con equipos que necesitan leer resultados sin dudar de los números.

Aquí no vas a trabajar solo con herramientas de terceros: tenemos plataforma propia de experimentación y un entorno de agentes con MCPs que usamos a diario para auditar y analizar.

****¿CUÁLES SERÁN TUS CONTRIBUCIONES?****
* Etiquetado de eventos en GTM para GA4 y otras herramientas de analítica.
* Configuraciones avanzadas en GA4 para clientes.
* Diseño de exploraciones en GA4 y de los cuadros de mando que las acompañan.
* Creación de informes de resultados en Data Studio y Power BI.
* Ejecución de auditoría de instrumentación para cada nuevo cliente.
* Diseño y liderazgo de los planes de medición y de las taxonomías de eventos entre plataformas (web, app, servidor)
* Referente técnico de instrumentación de experimentos para los equipos internos y los stakeholders de los proyectos en los que participa.
* Implantación y revisión del consentimiento en la medición (Consent Mode v2, CMPs) y explicación de su efecto sobre los datos.
* Instrumentación y validación de experimentos: que la variante quede registrada, que el reparto de muestra sea correcto y que no haya huecos de datos entre la herramienta de test y GA4.
* Conciliación de datos entre la plataforma de e-commerce y GA4: detectar discrepancias en sesiones, pedidos e ingresos, encontrar la causa y proponer el arreglo.

****¿QUÉ TE HARÁ TRIUNFAR CON NOSOTROS?****
**Hard Skills**
* Tener experiencia de +3 años:
+ Instrumentando e-commerce sobre Shopify o plataforma equivalente: dataLayer, eventos de funnel y de compra, convivencia del contenedor de GTM con el custom pixel, y las limitaciones del checkout.

* Tener experiencia de 2 años en:
+ Entornos ágiles.
+ Creación de dashboards para clientes.
+ Gestión eficaz de tareas y proyectos complejos.
+ Jira, Trello, Asana o similar.

* Contar con altas habilidades de análisis en GA4
* Tener capacidad avanzada de instrumentar con Google Tag Manager.
* Ser capaz de crear dashboards avanzados en Data Studio y Power BI.
* Iniciativa en documentación: dejar por escrito el plan de medición, las decisiones técnicas y los checklists de QA, de modo que otra persona pueda continuar tu trabajo sin preguntarte.
* Experiencia con herramientas de experimentación (VWO, Optimizely o AB Tasty) por el lado del dato: etiquetado de variantes, control de muestra y lectura de resultados.
* Consent Mode v2 y CMPs y su efecto real sobre el dato: modelado, huecos de atribución y tráfico sin asignar.
* Uso de IA en el día a día de analítica: agentes y MCPs para auditar instrumentaciones, acelerar análisis y automatizar QA. No buscamos conocimiento teórico, buscamos que ya lo estés usando en tu trabajo.
* SQL sobre BigQuery a nivel intermedio: agregaciones y JOIN, y manejo de la exportación de GA4 (estructuras anidadas, event_params, UNNEST), con control del coste de las consultas.
* Inglés B2

**Soft Skills**
* Adaptabilidad al cambio.
* Carácter autodidacta.
* Capacidad de trabajo en equipo.
* Excelentes habilidades comunicativas (especialmente a nivel escrito).
* Criterio técnico y capacidad de sostenerlo. Saber decir que una implementación no es fiable y explicar por qué con datos, aunque quien la propone sea el cliente.

****ADEMÁS, SERÁ IDEAL SI TÚ...****
* Tienes conocimientos de:
+ HTML, CSS y JS.
+ Adobe Analytics y Adobe Launch, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Quantum Metric y herramientas similares.
+ Python, R.
+ Etiquetado en servidor (GTM server side, Stape o similar) y conexión de Shopify con herramientas de CRM o email (Klaviyo o equivalentes)

* Cuentas con experiencia en:
+ gestión de píxeles de tracking de servicios de ads.
+ Instrumentación de apps móviles: SDK de Firebase/GA4 para app, eventos y propiedades de usuario, y validación con DebugView.

****¿CÓMO SERÁN TUS PRIMEROS MESES EN PRODUCT HACKERS?****
* El primer mes 📆: Durante las primeras semanas, nos aseguraremos de que conozcas el funcionamiento de Product Hackers y sobre todo de nuestro método. El equipo, los valores que compartimos. Tendrás oportunidad de analizar el funcionamiento actual de la metodología, las herramientas que utilizamos y comenzarás a aportar ideas de mejora. ¡Todos los aportes son bienvenidos!
* El primer trimestre 🌱: Te familiarizarás con los procesos internos y con las demandas externas con el apoyo de todo el equipo. Poco a poco se irán notando las mejoras que comencemos a trabajar y te encontrarás liderando la comunicación con nuestros clientes. Estarás gestionando de inicio a fin al menos un proyecto con cliente
* A la luna 🚀: Product Hackers te proporcionará las herramientas, pero tú serás capaz de desarrollarte tanto de manera profesional como personal, integrando todos los aprendizajes y siendo capaz de aportar un valor añadido tanto a tus responsabilidades como a las de otros equipos. Estamos en constante crecimiento, así que para este momento, seguramente tus responsabilidades y roles se hayan enriquecido bastante.

****¿QUÉ BENEFICIOS PODRÁS ENCONTRAR?****
* Equipo 👨‍👨‍👧‍👧: Un equipo que trabaja de manera remota pero cercana y con la mejor vibra, que está dispuesto a ayudar en todo momento y que comparte la pasión por el Growth. Encontrarás un equipo que tiene muchas habilidades y asumiendo diferentes roles del cual siempre podrás echar una mano y aprender.
* Crecimiento personal y profesional 🔭 :La curva de aprendizaje puede ser dura al inicio, pero una vez que despegas, el progreso es muy rápido y se nota. El crecimiento de Growth Hackers y su proyección es posible gracias a sus astronautas
* Método propio 👾: Hacemos algo especial, algo que no está en todos lados, nos salimos del tradicionalismo y probamos cosas nuevas ya que estamos en un sector que se mueve muy rápido. ¡Qué mejor que aprendas el método y puedas aplicarlo a tu propio negocio!

****TE OFRECEMOS****
* Full remoto + flexibilidad horaria amplia (con la limitación de los horarios de los clientes y reuniones de equipo) ⏰
* Salario entre 28.000 - 36.000 €/brutos anuales (en función de expertise) 💰
* Retribución flexible con Factorial 💸
* Festivos de tu CCAA y locales ✌🏼
* 25 días de descanso (22 días laborables de vacaciones + el día de tu cumpleaños, el 24 y el 31 de diciembre) 🎄
* Jornada reducida en los meses de verano (julio y agosto) 🏖️
* Acceso ilimitado a nuestra plataforma de formación PH School! Valorado en en +3000€/año 👨🏻‍💻
* 500€ de presupuesto para adecuar tu puesto de trabajo en casa + ordenador de empresa (un Macbook Pro). 💻
* Clases en pareja para mejorar tu inglés todas las semanas y conocer a tus compis 🇬🇧
* Eventos de Product Hackers y teambuilding 🫂
* Incentivo por traer nuevos compañeros Devs o GMs 🤑
* Bonus de un porcentaje de lo facturado si nos traes a un cliente 💸
* Plan de desarrollo y formación para que sigas creciendo como profesional de Product Hackers 🚀
* Además de muchos otros más que están por venir porque nos gusta ampliar la lista siempre que podemos ❤️

**¿CUÁLES SON LAS FASES DEL PROCESO DE SELECCIÓN?**

 Manychat is a leading Chat Marketing platform. We help businesses engage with their customers on Instagram, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, and Telegram.

 You'll join the Product Analytics team at Manychat, working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to bring data into every decision we make.This role is perfect for someone who loves turning data into quick action: zooming in to uncover the signal in the noise, and zooming out to see the big picture.  DO \\& CO, The Gourmet Entertainment company was founded and is currently listed in Austria. Special commitment and passionate attention to our guests create an environment that feels like home, wherever they are in the world, defines our uniqueness and makes us leaders across our industry.

**Job Summary**
 The purpose of the IT Data Analyst is to proactively engage with platform developers to support business initiatives for database design, creation and maintenance. Has responsibility for database backups and recovery, performance tuning, capacity planning, maintaining security standards and database upgrades. Develops, implements, and maintains an API/ETL architecture that is consistent with the enterprise strategy. Develops and implements an EAI approach that is compatible with guidelines and local application design goals.

**What will you be doing?**
* Create data models and establish data connections with various data sources, such as SharePoint, SQL databases, Excel, and external APIs.
* Utilize Power Apps formulas, expressions, and workflows to create interactive and intuitive user interfaces.
* Implement business logic and automation using Power Automate (formerly Flow) to streamline processes and improve productivity.
* Determine space requirements for a database, working with developers and system administrators
* Determine and implement the backup/recovery plan for each database, both while in development and as the application moves into production
* Monitor database performance while the application is in development on an ongoing database-by-database basis, to identify potential performance problems before getting to production

title: Analytics Engineer - Finance
description:

You'd design and develop data pipelines, models and features that give Finance leaders visibility into what's happening across the business right now and what comes next. Your work unlocks month-end closes in five days instead of eight, automates manual GL and AR reconciliation, and gives the company the financial foundations it needs for IPO compliance and scale. title: Staff Product Data Scientist
description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

The
 **Staff Product Data Scientist** 
 sits at the intersection of product and strategy, operating as the decision engine for how Super uses data to drive commercial and product outcomes. Working in close partnership with Analytics Engineers, this role owns problem framing, hypothesis generation, and the translation of complex analyses into clear, actionable decisions — directly shaping how millions of customers engage with our products. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who moves from messy business questions to sharp analytical conclusions that influence strategy at the VP and C-suite level.

**What The Role Involves**
*Be the Decision Engine*
* Conduct deep-dive analyses into customer behaviour, product usage, and commercial performance, going beyond surface metrics to uncover causal drivers through rigorous statistical methods
* Distinguish correlation from cause-and-effect, delivering decision memos with quantified impact ranges and clear "so what" guidance for senior stakeholders *Shape Strategy with Data*
* Influence product roadmaps, commercial tactics, and marketing strategies by framing the right questions and designing experiments, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments
* Deliver evidence-based recommendations that directly change the course of decisions at Director, VP, and C-suite level *Define Metrics \\& Specifications*
* Design KPI trees, define metric intent, and specify requirements for Analytics Engineers to implement certified, production-grade data products
* Define tracking plans for instrumentation, specify dashboard requirements and acceptance criteria, and ensure data capture supports decision-making needs *Partner Across the Business*
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Commercial leaders, Analytics Engineers, and Marketers, leading problem-framing sessions and challenging assumptions
* Reframe vague requests into testable hypotheses and bring analytical rigour to high-stakes discussions *Tackle Ambiguity*
* Translate broad business challenges into sharp analytical problems with measurable outcomes, bringing structure to fast-moving, ambiguous environments

**What We Are Looking For**
* Advanced statistical knowledge and applied experience with causal inference methods: A/B testing, confidence intervals, regression, quasi-experimental designs (difference-in-differences, synthetic controls, regression discontinuity), and familiarity with CUPED and variance reduction techniques
* Proficiency in SQL for exploratory analysis and data validation (Snowflake environment)
* Demonstrated track record of producing decision memos, strategy recommendations, or business cases that have measurably influenced product and commercial strategy
* Ability to transform complex causal analyses into clear, compelling narratives for VP and C-suite audiences, making evidence accessible and actionable
* Strong commercial and product acumen — an understanding of how data connects to business outcomes, product design, and customer behaviour
* Comfort with ambiguity and a bias towards answering "what should we do?" rather than "what happened?"
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in analytics, data science, or product data science roles (ideally in product or commercial domains), with direct influence on strategy and growth through causal analysis and experimentation
* Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent professional experience

**What We Offer**
* Medical / Health Insurance
* Open Annual Leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Training \\& Learning Development *Additional benefits vary by country and will be shared during the hiring process.*
**About Super**
 We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

**Shaping the Future of Play**
 Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page: super.xyz/careers *Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming \\& Betting Association (EGBA).*
*At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance.*

title: Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
**About Infront** At Infront, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace, recognizing our diverse team as one of our most valuable assets.

For 25 years, Infront has been empowering financial market experts to make faster, smarter, compliant decisions. Over time, we have expanded our foundation by bringing together companies with more than 75 years of combined market experience and trust. All these years on, we're still building. Opening our new Madrid office marks an exciting next chapter, and we're growing our team in order to write it.

Our strength lies in market data, delivering reliable, accurate information through a powerful suite of tools, spanning Data Intelligence, Wealth Management solutions, and Trading \\& Investor solutions, that our users depend on every day. Today, we are one of Europe’s leading providers of market data and financial software, helping professionals navigate markets with confidence and speed.

**About the Role** We are looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to join our team and play a key role in building the reporting and analytical foundations of our Revenue Operations function.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Revenue Operations, you will own how Infront measures the health and performance of its revenue engine across pipeline, conversion, velocity, seller productivity, and forecasting accuracy. You will provide the reporting, analysis, and insights that support decision-making at every level of the organisation, including the management team and board.

This role combines deep analytical expertise with ownership of the reporting layer within Salesforce. We are looking for someone who genuinely understands data—how it should be structured, analysed, and transformed into meaningful insights. You will go beyond standard reporting to uncover trends, apply analytical techniques where appropriate, and leverage modern AI tools to enhance efficiency and decision-making. While you will work in Salesforce on a daily basis and own the reporting and data that sit on top of it, prior Salesforce expertise is not essential. We are more interested in hiring someone with strong analytical capabilities and will support the right candidate in developing Salesforce knowledge and certifications over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own pipeline analytics and revenue performance reporting, including pipeline health, stage conversion, deal velocity, coverage ratios, seller productivity, and key commercial KPIs.
* Produce consistent and trusted reporting for the management team, ExCo, and Board, identifying trends, anomalies, and the drivers behind performance.
* Support forecasting through data-driven analysis, providing empirical forecast baselines and actionable commercial insights.
* Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and data models across Salesforce and the BI environment, leveraging automation to improve efficiency and reduce manual reporting.
* Apply AI and advanced analytical techniques to automate data preparation, accelerate analysis, develop predictive insights, and create repeatable workflows.
* Conduct deeper analytical investigations, including trend, regression, and cohort analysis, ensuring data is structured for insight generation rather than simple reporting.
* Partner with the CRM and BI Specialist to maintain data quality, governance, and completeness, ensuring the reliability of reporting and analytics.
* Own Salesforce reporting and dashboards, while developing broader system expertise and supporting the evolution of CRM capabilities.
* Support Salesforce administration, including user management, configuration, upgrades, budgeting, user support, training, and adoption of best practices.

**Who you are**

* A background in data science, data analytics, or a quantitative discipline, with a genuine interest in applying it to commercial problems.
* Strong analytical and data-handling skills. Comfortable with SQL and a modern analysis toolkit (Python or R a strong plus), and confident working with messy, real-world data. You think in trends and relationships, not one-off numbers, and are comfortable with techniques such as regression analysis.
* Demonstrable fluency with AI tools for analysis and automation. You use them to work faster and go deeper, not as a novelty.
* Comfortable with SaaS commercial metrics such as ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, win rates, conversion, and churn, or able to demonstrate the ability to learn them quickly.
* Experience building dashboards and reports that non-technical stakeholders actually use. Salesforce reporting experience is a strong plus.
* Able to translate a commercial question into an analytical approach, and an analytical result back into a clear recommendation.
* A genuine interest in learning Salesforce. You do not need to be certified today. Infront will support the right person through training toward Salesforce certification.
* Naturally curious and self-directed, and motivated by solving complex business problems through data.

**Our offer**

**Health \\& wellness** 
 : Benefit from wellbeing initiatives tailored to local needs, including access to an employee assistance programme that provides confidential support to employees and their families.

**Holiday:** 
 Enjoy competitive holiday entitlement aligned with local markets, so you can rest and recharge.

**Remote work:** 
 Enjoy the opportunity to work two days a week from home, with flexible working hours where possible. You may also request to work up to four weeks per year from a different location.

**Learning \\& development:** 
 Support your career progression with access to learning resources, ongoing conversations with your manager, and opportunities to share the knowledge you gain with your team.

**Culture \\& impact:** 
 Be part of an international team with a startup mindset and play a key role in making a meaningful impact.

**Our offices:** 
 Work from Europe’s leading financial centres and be at the heart of where finance happens.

**Additional notes** All candidates selected for employment are subject to Pre-Employment Screening. This process includes professional reference and background checks conducted by our third-party partner, ZINC. These screenings are part of our commitment to ensuring a secure, compliant, and trustworthy workplace.

We kindly ask that you submit your CV in English.

title: Senior Product Data Analyst (Hybrid)
description:

 **Senior Product Data Analyst** 
 to join our Experiments \\& Insights team in Barcelona (hybrid) to help different teams across the organization to succeed in their mission by providing insights generation and data analysis support in a healthy data-informed environment. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

 We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

* We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
* Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
* More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
* Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

**What you will do:**
 The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. Our Experiments and Insights team is the centre of excellence for Online (AB) Experimentation and for providing best practices to generate insights and learning from and for the experiments.

In this role, you would be performing as a product data analyst (tasks are described below) to support a set of product teams, but you will be also part of the next experimentation generation at eDreams Odigeo. The team is constantly investigating best in class methodologies and processes to implement in our business/analysis and tests, which means you will be required to apply your mathematical knowledge in some strategic projects that are focused on taking more accurate decisions maintaining a strong statistical confidence level. Your will be working with multi-disciplinary teams - Qualitative Researchers, Designers, Product Owners, Developers, and Pricing Managers - to blend different statistical and data analytics techniques to generate a holistic understanding of the users and markets.

As a Product Data Analyst inside the team, you will be in charge of:

* Analyse performance and identify behaviours in our different websites and interfaces related to our products;
* Analyse performance and user behaviours in the A/B Tests experiments or Pre-Post run by the product teams;
* Help the product teams to generate their testing hypotheses by providing exploratory analysis about our products, past tests, etc,
* Data cleaning and validation,
* Definition of new tracking that will all mostly be added in Google Analytics (to be able to answer different kinds of research/product questions);
* Build and maintain dashboards (mostly using LookerStudio) and/or reports (mostly in Google Sheets) to share performance information with senior management and C-level stakeholders;
* Lead data-driven initiatives to improve company decision making and business knowledge;
* Responsible for one or more team’s projects such as the investigation and implementation of new methodologies, new data analysis techniques or the usage of new tools;
* Collaborate with user researchers and designers to detect gaps in knowledge about our user; identify research opportunities to fill those gaps.
* NOTE: Data you will be using could come from Google Analytics API or Google Analytics tables in BigQuery, other sources of data stored in BigQuery such as internal databases, customer service database, etc., as well as our data stored and accessible in Microstrategy.

**What you need to succeed:**
 Good to have Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline is a requirement (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, etc.),
* Minimum of 6 years experience in a role with strong analytical component,
* Previous experience in user behavior analysis (product performance) using data from any of the following: Google
* Analytics/Adobe Analytics/Mix Panel/ Amplitude/Matomo.
* Strong knowledge of the math and statistical concepts behind A/B testing,
* Strong knowledge of SQL is a requirement, as well as experience in working with databases and large sets of data,
* Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with the Google toolset (spreadsheets, google docs, etc),
* Knowledge of visualisation tools like LookerStudio, Tableau, Looker or Qlikview,
* Business Proficiency in English,
* A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!

It would be a plus if you have:

* R or Python programming skills (mostly for data extraction and data manipulation),
* Google Analytics knowledge (as well as Google Analytics API, googleAnalyticsR library for R, GA4, etc.),
* Previous experience in programming,
* Knowledge on data structure and data sets management in Google Cloud Platform.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 team.blue is an ecosystem of successful brands working together across regions to provide customers with everything they need to succeed online. 60+ successful brands make up the group, with a team of more than 3,000 experts serving 3.5 million customers across Europe and beyond.

**Position Overview**
 We are looking for an experienced and autonomous Analytics Engineer to join our AI \\& Data function. This role sits at the critical intersection between our Data Management team (responsible for ingesting raw data into our Databricks-based data platform) and our Analytics team (responsible for insights and reporting).

You will take raw data, at various stages of conforming, and transform it into trusted, analytics-ready datasets — building KPIs, semantic models, and data products that feed our presentation and reporting layers. Working across a wide variety of data domains (marketing, product usage, customer care, revenue, and more), you will need to be intellectually curious, self-directed, and proactive: comfortable exploring unfamiliar data landscapes with limited guidance, engaging business partners to understand what the data really means, and making sound judgement calls independently.

We need someone we can trust to pick up a new data domain, figure it out, and deliver at pace. Reporting to the Director of Analytics, you will work closely with data engineers, analytics engineers, and business stakeholders across the group.

**Where you sit in the team**
**The Data function is structured around three layers:**
* Data Management: Ingests raw data from all sources into the Databricks platform. Owns the bronze/raw layer.
* Analytics Engineering → YOU: Takes raw data, conforms and transforms it, builds KPI definitions and semantic models, and delivers reliable data products to the presentation layer.
* Analytics \\& Insights: Consumes the analytics-ready data to produce dashboards, reports and strategic insights for the business.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Proactively engage business partners and domain owners to understand context, validate assumptions, and align on KPI definitions.

**Collaboration \\& Enablement**

* Work with the Analytics team to ensure the presentation layer meets reporting and self-service needs.
* Contribute to data governance: naming conventions, lineage documentation, and model cataloguing.
* Support the broader team in extending analytics coverage to new brands and domains over time.

**Required Experience/skills:**

* Proven ability to work autonomously across multiple data domains simultaneously, figuring out unfamiliar data with limited documentation.
* Strong analytical mindset: able to interrogate data critically, spot anomalies, and validate logic end-to-end.
* Excellent communication skills — comfortable talking directly with business stakeholders to elicit requirements and explain data concepts.
* Experience working across diverse data domains (e.g. marketing, product analytics, customer care, financial/subscription data).

description:

AI literacy and hands-on experience with tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT would be highly valued.

* You anticipate challenges before they arise and take initiative to find effective solutions.

* Learn from the best: Our state of the art workshops guarantee the latest insights into digital advertising

**ABOUT THE JOB**
----------------- MISSION:

The data engineer is a key role in any of the different data squads in charge of development and maintenance of new big data data platforms and data products. His/her main mission is to develop the different data pipelines which ingest, transform and prepare data from different sources into the different layers of our datahub platform and/or data products.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Data Modeling and Pipelines development with Spark and Scala to ingest and transform data from different sources (Kafka topics, APIs, HDFS, structured databases, files…) into HDFS, IBM Cloud Storage (generally in parquet format) or SQL/NOSQL databases followign complex business rules.

* Manage big data storage solutions in the platform (HDFS, IBM Cloud Storage, structured and non-structured databases).

* Data Transformation and Quality: implement data transformation and quality control processes to ensure data consistency and accuracy. Utilize programming languages such as Scala and SQL. And libraries like Spark for data transformation and enrichment operations.

* CI/CD Pipeline Implementation: set up CI/CD pipelines to automate deployment, unit testing, and development management.

* Infrastructure Migration: migrate the existing Hadoop infrastructure to cloud infrastructure on Kubernetes Engine, Object Storage (IBM Cloud storage), Spark as a service on Scala (to build the data pipelines), and Airflow as a service (to orchestrate and schedule the data pipelines).

* Implementation of schemas,queries, and views in SQL/NOSQL databases like Oracle, Postgres or MongoDB.

* Develop and configure scheduling of data pipelines with a combination of shell scripting and AirFlow as a service.

* Validation Testing: conduct unit and validation tests to ensure accuracy and integrity.

* Documentation: write technical documentation (specifications, operational documents) to ensure knowledge capitalization.

* Code Improvement: modify the existing code as per business requirements and continuously improve for better performance and maintainability.

* Configure Dremio Data Virtualization to interface with Parquet or as a way to expose the data in the different data products.

* Performance Optimization and Security: ensure the performance and security of the data infrastructure and follow the best practices of Data engineering.

IT Tools:

* Spark on Scala as legacy data pipeline development language.

* Spark as a service on Scala as data pipeline development platform.

* Experience in the design and development of streaming procesess using Spark Streaming, Spark Structure Streaming and Apache Kafka.

* Management of legacy big data storage solutions (HDFS).

* Management of big data storage solutions (IBM Cloud Object Storage and parquet format).

* Implementation of SQL/NO SQL database schemas ,queries and views (MongoDB, Oracle, Postgres).

* Shell scripting and Airflow as data pipelie scheduling solution,

* Dremio as data virtualization tool.

REQUIREMENTS

* You have experience in IT international companies.
* You have minimum 2 years of proven success in related positions.
* Languages: English B2/C1, French as a bonus.

SKILLS

* Business Skills:

* Knowledge of banking industry and processes.

* Business/IT Relationship.

* Behavioural Skills:

* Ability to understand, explain and support change.

* Ability to Deliver / Results Driven.

* Ability to collaborate / Teamwork.

* Ability to manage a project as a bonus.

* Agile.

description:
