**Consumer Data Readiness Specialist - Media \\& Activation**
 The Consumer Data Readiness Specialist — Media \\& Activation is a hands-on operational role ensuring global consumer media and activation data is complete, accurate, privacy-compliant, and ready for use across marketing platforms, measurement systems, and AI-powered personalization tools. The role sits within the Global Consumer Data team and focuses on data quality, platform data management, consent validation, audience taxonomy, and process documentation to enable trusted, activation-ready consumer data at scale.

This role suits someone who enjoys working in detail: investigating data flow issues across the media and activation ecosystem, ensuring audience segments are built on clean and consented data, validating pipelines from collection points to activation endpoints, and maintaining standards that make consumer data usable, measurable, and compliant across markets.

The role operates with an AI-first mindset, recognizing that clean, consented, identity-resolved data enables AI-driven personalization, lookalike modeling, propensity scoring, and automated media optimization. The specialist ensures data is not only correct, but responsibly usable by machines at speed and scale.

**Scope (global, regional or local):**
 Global

**Key Tasks/ What You'll Do**
* Maintain consumer media and activation data attributes, ensuring complete, accurate, consistent, and AI-ready audience profiles, behavioral signals, campaign tags, identity keys, and segment classifications.
* Investigate and resolve activation data quality issues end-to-end across CDP, CRM, media platforms, clean rooms, and measurement systems.
* Define and document data mapping rules and integration logic to harmonize, deduplicate, and structure consumer data for both human use and machine interpretability.
* Validate consent signals, privacy flags, opt-in/opt-out status, and usage rights to ensure all activation and AI data flows meet GDPR, CCPA, ePrivacy, and local requirements.
* Manage operational interactions with media data partners and platform vendors, monitor data feeds, flag anomalies, and track resolution.
* Integrate new consumer activation data sources by validating formats, aligning taxonomies, confirming consent compliance, and ensuring readiness for platform ingestion and AI activation.
* Support media measurement, effectiveness analytics, MMM, and CPLT by ensuring audience and campaign data is structured, mapped, and quality-assured for attribution, reach/frequency, and ROI needs.
* Maintain audience taxonomies, including segment definitions, interest/intent classifications, lifecycle stages, and channel-specific structures, ensuring global consistency and AI interpretability.
* Use AI tools such as Copilot, GenAI assistants, and automation scripts to improve data validation, anomaly detection, and documentation.
* Identify automation opportunities for audience quality scoring, consent anomaly detection, identity matching, and campaign tagging validation.
* Create and maintain SOPs, data flow diagrams, consent logic maps, platform specifications, audience dictionaries, and troubleshooting guides for users and AI context layers.
* Support training and onboarding of local marketing teams and data stewards on activation data standards, privacy requirements, platform tools, and AI-enabled workflows.
* Drive continuous improvement by flagging recurring issues, proposing process enhancements, and supporting AI-enabled tools and workflows.

**Qualification \\& Competencies:**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Business, Data Analytics, Information Management, or related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in digital/media data operations, audience data management, CDP/CRM data management, or marketing technology — ideally in FMCG, Consumer Health, Pharmaceuticals, or Retail/eCommerce.
* Hands-on experience with consumer activation platforms (CDP, CRM, DMP, DSP) and familiarity with audience data structures, identity resolution concepts, and cross-platform data flows.
* Working experience with media data ecosystems — including walled gardens (Meta, Google, Amazon), retail media networks, programmatic platforms, and clean room environments.
* Working knowledge of data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, ePrivacy) and practical experience validating consent, data usage rights, and privacy compliance in media/activation data flows.
* Experience with 1P data collection (web, app, CRM), 2P data partnerships, and 3P audience data providers — understanding integration challenges and quality/compliance implications.
* Experience defining and applying data mapping rules, deduplication logic, and harmonization standards across multiple consumer data sources and platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — ability to investigate data issues systematically and drive resolution across complex, multi-platform environments.
* Familiarity with data and marketing tools (e.g., SQL, Excel advanced, Power BI, CDP tools like Treasure Data/Salesforce/Adobe, Google Analytics, campaign management platforms), including familiarity with Marketing Mix Mix Modeling (MMM) and attribution methodologies
* AI-curious and AI-literate — comfortable using GenAI tools in daily work, understanding how data quality and structure impact AI-driven personalization, lookalike modeling, and automated optimization, and eager to explore AI applications in media data operations.
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams.
* Experience creating process documentation, SOPs, and training materials.
* Effective communicator — able to work across cultures and functions, explain data and privacy topics clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proactive, self-directed, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment.
* Growth mindset — views AI as a multiplier for marketing effectiveness and actively seeks to integrate AI into workflows.
* Fluent English required; additional languages a plus.

description:
**About MediaRadar**
 MediaRadar, equips marketing, sales and analytics leaders with the intelligence they need to stay ahead. Our platform delivers always-on, AI-enabled Creative, Competitive, Commercial and Market Intelligence—spanning ad strategy, media spend, creative assets and brand messaging across 30+ media channels and five million brands.

The result: faster, cleaner and more actionable intelligence that drives competitive advantage.

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Governance Analyst to support the day-to-day execution of our taxonomy, rules, and reference data framework. This role turns governance standards into working artifacts — authoring and maintaining taxonomies, business term definitions, and data rules in our governance platform, and keeping them accurate, consistent, and free of conflict as the organization scales.

You will be the hands-on engine behind the governance function, working closely with the Senior Data Governance Lead, Data Operations, and the Reference Data team to maintain the rule and taxonomy libraries that drive classification and data quality. This is a high-ownership, execution-focused role for someone who values structure and precision and wants to see governance standards actually used in production rather than living only as documentation.

**Requirements**
**Responsibilities**
* Author, maintain, and version taxonomies, business term definitions, and classification hierarchies in the governance platform
* Translate approved governance decisions into structured, testable data rules and apply rule IDs consistently across taxonomies
* Run routine rule-library analysis to detect duplicates, conflicts, and coverage gaps, and prepare findings for governance review
* Maintain metadata, documentation, and change history so definitions and rules remain traceable and auditable
* Support intake and triage of new rule and definition requests from Data Operations and business stakeholders
* Prepare reference data and golden-record candidates for governance certification, flagging anomalies and exceptions
* Produce clear documentation and quick-reference guides that help stewards and analysts apply standards independently
* Assist in preparing governance reporting, dashboards, and stakeholder updates

**Success Measures**
**Success in this role will be measured by:**
* Rule \\& Taxonomy Integrity - Low and declining rates of duplicate, conflicting, or orphaned rules and definitions
* Coverage - Measurable progress against taxonomy and reference data coverage targets across tiers
* Turnaround - Timely, accurate processing of rule and definition requests within agreed SLAs
* Traceability - Complete, auditable change history and documentation for governed artifacts
* Usability - Stewards and analysts can apply standards from documentation without repeated escalation
* Operationalization - Authored rules and definitions are actively used in classification and quality workflows

**Key Qualifications And Role Requirements**
* 3-5 years of experience in data governance, data management, data quality, analytics, or data operations
* Hands-on experience maintaining taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, business glossaries, or rule libraries
* Strong attention to detail and comfort working with structured data, spreadsheets, and governance tooling
* Ability to translate governance decisions into precise, consistent, testable rules
* Comfort with ambiguity and evolving standards in a maturing governance environment
* Familiarity with data quality dimensions (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness)
* Exposure to DAMA / DMBOK concepts a plus
* Clear written and verbal communication skills

We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences makes us stronger and more innovative. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

In accordance with the EEO-1 reporting requirements, we collect demographic data as part of our efforts to ensure fair and equitable hiring practices across all levels of our organization. A final compensation offer will ultimately be based on the candidate's location, skill level and experience, and the Company's pay equity.

We are also committed to ensuring our recruitment process is accessible to all applicants. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at

 **Senior Data Analyst** 
 you will be a senior individual contributor within the global Data, Analytics and AI team, turning ecommerce and consumer data into trusted, decision-ready insight for stakeholders across regions. You will own the definition, build-out, and governance of key metrics and dashboards — partnering with Product, Marketing, Finance, and Regional teams to make sure the business is steering on numbers it can trust. This role sits at the center of our analytics foundations: our data platform as the single source of truth, and the emerging semantic layer.

In this role you will move fluently between SQL, the data warehouse, and visualization tools to answer business questions, build self-service products, and certify the definitions that everyone else consumes. title: Graduate Programme 2027: Data Scientist and Analyst

 Our Graduate Programme is built for ambitious graduates who want to launch their careers in fintech.  Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Scientists and Analysts work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. We’re looking for Graduate Data Scientists and Analysts who are analytical, curious, and ready to deliver impact with data.

You’ll begin with an immersive boot camp designed to give you hands-on experience across the full data lifecycle. After that, you'll join a dedicated product team to specialise in your preferred data domain.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

* A solid foundation in maths and statistics
* An interest in analytics engineering, product analytics, data science, or ML engineering
* Great problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset
* Fluency in English and excellent communication skills
* Full-time availability from early or late 2027

Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D\\&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. title: Data & AI Manager
description:
**Data \\& AI Manager**
**Tu misión**
 Serás la persona responsable de consolidar y hacer evolucionar la función de datos en TeamSystem España, un grupo con varias entidades legales que hoy operan con distintos niveles de madurez analítica sobre un modelo basado en Power BI y SQL.

Tu día a día combinará la ejecución directa de proyectos de analítica avanzada y machine learning —desde el diseño del modelo hasta su puesta en producción— con la construcción de una visión de datos unificada y pragmática para todo el grupo, actuando además como puente entre el negocio local y la plataforma corporativa de datos (Data Mesh sobre Azure + Databricks).

No buscamos un perfil puramente estratégico ni puramente técnico: buscamos un/a player-coach que defina la hoja de ruta y sea capaz de ejecutarla con sus propias manos mientras hace crecer el equipo.

**Tus responsabilidades**
* Definir la hoja de ruta de datos del grupo: inventariar los activos actuales por entidad (fuentes SQL, BigQuery y Excel, visualización en Power BI, niveles de madurez) y priorizar el impacto sobre la perfección técnica.
* Implantar políticas de gobierno y calidad de datos adaptadas al tamaño y madurez de cada entidad —ownership, calidad, linaje y acceso—, estandarizando definiciones, métricas y KPIs a nivel de grupo y garantizando el cumplimiento del RGPD en coordinación con el DPO y Ciberseguridad.
* Evolucionar el ecosistema actual (Power BI + SQL como core) hacia una arquitectura más escalable, evaluando cuándo y cómo incorporar Azure, Databricks o herramientas corporativas, y racionalizando las soluciones ad-hoc existentes.
* Coordinar con el equipo corporativo de Data Platform (Italia) la integración progresiva de las entidades españolas en la plataforma Data Mesh, incluyendo la migración o federación del entorno BigQuery hacia la plataforma común.
* Ejecutar de forma directa proyectos de analítica avanzada y modelos predictivos con impacto real en el negocio: predicción de churn, forecasting de ingresos, scoring de clientes, detección de anomalías, automatización contable y optimización de precios — construyendo pipelines de ML end-to-end hasta su monitorización en producción.
* Impulsar el uso responsable y gobernado de la GenAI en flujos internos, y habilitar los datos para features de AI embebidas en los productos de TeamSystem España.
* Liderar y hacer crecer el equipo de datos (actualmente un analista/data engineer más recursos externos), siendo su referencia técnica directa, definiendo el plan de incorporaciones y gestionando el presupuesto de datos y AI.
* Actuar como interlocutor principal entre IT España y la dirección de negocio para todo lo relacionado con datos e inteligencia analítica.

**El perfil que buscamos**
 Buscamos una persona senior, pragmática y profundamente técnica: alguien que se sienta igual de cómodo/a construyendo y desplegando un modelo de ML en producción que presentando la hoja de ruta de datos del grupo ante la dirección de negocio.

Experiencia: mínimo 7 años en roles de datos o analítica, con al menos 2 en posiciones de liderazgo técnico o gestión, y con historial de consolidación de modelos de datos dispersos en entornos multi-entidad o grupos empresariales.

Idiomas: español nativo e inglés B2 o superior, ambos imprescindibles.

**Hard skills**
* SQL avanzado a nivel experto sobre múltiples motores (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, BigQuery o similares).
* Power BI avanzado en entornos corporativos reales: modelado, DAX, publicación y gestión de workspaces.
* Python y pandas a nivel avanzado para análisis y ETL.
* Machine learning aplicado (scikit-learn, XGBoost, MLflow) y estadística para modelos predictivos, con experiencia real desplegando modelos en producción.
* Arquitectura de datos y modelado dimensional.

**Soft skills**
* Perfil hands-on con mentalidad player-coach: capaz de definir la estrategia y ejecutarla personalmente cuando el equipo lo requiere.
* Liderazgo técnico con capacidad de influir en equipos sin autoridad directa y de hacer mentoring del equipo local.
* Comunicación efectiva con interlocutores muy heterogéneos: desde analistas de negocio hasta dirección y equipos jurídicos.
* Capacidad analítica y de resolución de problemas complejos en entornos con alta heterogeneidad técnica, gestionando múltiples entidades con realidades distintas.
* Adaptabilidad a entornos en evolución y cultura de mejora continua.

**Valoramos también:**
* Conocimiento de Azure (Data Factory, Blob Storage, Synapse), Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) o Google BigQuery.
* Experiencia en MLOps, orquestación de pipelines (Airflow, dbt) y data governance.
* Experiencia en pruebas de concepto y despliegue de capacidades de GenAI y LLMs.
* Certificaciones Microsoft PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-203 (Azure Data Engineer) o DP-900.
* Italiano básico, para la coordinación con el equipo corporativo de Data \\& AI.

**Qué ofrecemos**
* Contrato indefinido a jornada completa.
* Modalidad híbrida (2-3 días presencial) en nuestras oficinas de Madrid.
* Incorporación a un equipo en crecimiento dentro de un grupo tecnológico europeo con presencia internacional.
* Un proyecto con recorrido real: construirás la función de datos de España desde una etapa temprana, con proyección de crecimiento hacia posiciones de mayor responsabilidad.
* Formación continua y desarrollo profesional.

title: Purchase to pay master data Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 Buscamos incorporar a una persona como Senior Master Data \\& Procure-to-Pay Analyst para formar parte del equipo de Finanzas y Operaciones, con un papel clave en la gestión, calidad y evolución de los datos maestros asociados al proceso Purchase-to-Pay (P2P), apoyando a las marcas de Infojobs, coches net y milanuncios.

La persona seleccionada será responsable de garantizar la integridad, calidad y mantenimiento de la información crítica de proveedores y datos relacionados con compras y pagos, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas, la eficiencia operativa y la mejora continua de los procesos.

Será una posición con alto grado de autonomía, orientada a personas con experiencia en Master Data Management, gobierno de datos y procesos Procure-to-Pay, capaces de conectar las necesidades del negocio con las soluciones tecnológicas y operativas.

**Formación y experiencia**
* Formación universitaria en Administración y Dirección de Empresas (ADE), Finanzas, Economía, Supply Chain o áreas relacionadas.
* Se valorará formación complementaria en:
+ Compras y Procurement.
+ Procure-to-Pay (P2P) / Source-to-Pay (S2P).
+ Gestión de proveedores.
+ Data Governance y calidad de datos.

* Se valorarán certificaciones o formación específica en Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
* Experiencia de 4 a 5 años en Master Data Management (MDM).
* Experiencia demostrable como Especialista, Analista o SME de Procure-to-Pay en organizaciones complejas o internacionales.
* Experiencia en calidad y gobierno de datos (Data Quality \\& Data Governance) aplicada a procesos financieros y de proveedores.

**Conocimientos técnicos**
* Conocimiento sólido de:
+ Gestión de datos maestros de proveedores.
+ Estructuras de datos, modelos de información y mapeo de campos.
+ Procesos Source-to-Pay (S2P) y Purchase-to-Pay (P2P).
+ Políticas de gobierno corporativo y procedimientos internos.

* Experiencia trabajando con Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
* Se valorará experiencia con SAP u otros sistemas ERP financieros.

* Capacidad para analizar grandes volúmenes de información y transformar datos en propuestas de mejora.

* Identificar oportunidades de mejora en los procesos de mantenimiento y gobierno de datos.
* Asegurar la correcta aplicación de controles y estándares de calidad de datos.

**Soporte a usuarios y resolución de incidencias**
* Actuar como punto de referencia para usuarios internos en procesos y herramientas Procure-to-Pay.
* Analizar y resolver incidencias relacionadas con:
+ Alta y mantenimiento de proveedores.
+ Procesamiento de facturas.
+ Procesos de pago.
+ Pendientes financieros (open items, domiciliaciones bancarias, Travel \\& Expense).

* Coordinar la resolución de incidencias complejas con equipos internos y externos.

**Optimización de procesos y mejora continua**
* Analizar el ciclo completo Procure-to-Pay para identificar oportunidades de optimización.
* Proponer e implementar mejoras orientadas a aumentar la eficiencia, automatización y cumplimiento de procesos.
* Colaborar con equipos de IT y negocio en actualizaciones, implantaciones y mejoras funcionales de sistemas.
* Participar en la evolución de las soluciones P2P asegurando su alineación con las necesidades del negocio.

title: AI-First Product Analyst
description:
**About Smartcat**
 Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

**Why This Role Exists**
 At Smartcat, we believe analytics should not simply explain what happened. It should actively shape what happens next.

As an AI-First Product Analyst, you will partner primarily with Product leadership while also supporting strategic initiatives from the Office of the CEO. Your defining mandate is to work AI-first: rather than building dashboards and pulling reports by hand, you'll teach and enable Scout (our company AI agent) and other AI teammates (personal agents) to handle analytics requests autonomously — so that when a stakeholder needs a dashboard or an answer to a data related question, they can get it from Scout directly, and you step in only on the problems that genuinely need a human.

This role is fundamentally different from a traditional BI analyst. We are not looking for a task-doer who services a queue of dashboard requests. We are looking for an analyst-thinker who actively helps stakeholders reason about their data instead of just delivering it.

You will spend your time on two things: (1) enabling Scout — identifying what it takes to answer a recurring question, building the data and logic behind it, and teaching the system to do it reliably going forward; and (2) tackling the harder analytical problems — investigating product hypotheses, uncovering hidden growth opportunities, challenging assumptions with data, and proposing better ways to analyze the business. As the AI layer takes on the repetitive work, your leverage compounds.

We are looking for someone who combines analytical rigor, business curiosity, AI fluency, and startup execution speed.

**Mission**
 Enable Smartcat to make better product and business decisions through AI-powered analytics, scalable data products, and actionable insights that drive customer growth, adoption, retention, and expansion.

**Requirements**
**Experience**
* 5+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Product Intelligence, Growth Analytics, or related analytical roles.
* Proven experience supporting Product organizations in SaaS or technology companies.
* Demonstrated track record of driving business outcomes through analytics and insights.
* Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth startup environments.

**Technical Skills**
* Advanced SQL proficiency, including:
+ Complex joins
+ Window functions
+ Query optimization
+ Common Table Expressions (CTEs)
+ Large-scale data analysis

* Experience with Business Intelligence platforms such as:
+ Looker
+ Omni
+ Grafana
+ Similar modern BI tools

* Ability to build and maintain scalable dashboards and reporting systems.
* Python experience for data analysis is strongly preferred.

**AI Fluency (Required)**
 This is an AI-first role.

Candidates should demonstrate an Adoptive or Transformative level of AI fluency and be able to show examples of:

* Using AI to redesign analytical workflows.
* Automating repetitive reporting processes.
* Building AI-assisted research and analysis systems.
* Leveraging multiple AI tools to improve speed and quality of decision-making.
* Applying AI beyond simple prompting to create measurable business impact.

**Business \\& Communication Skills**
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to sift through large amounts of information and identify the most important signals.
* Strong business judgment and curiosity.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to tailor insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to influence stakeholders through data-driven recommendations.
* Comfortable working independently with significant ownership.

**Additional Qualifications**
* Experience collaborating across Product, Revenue, Customer Success, and Engineering organizations.
* Experience working with distributed global teams across multiple time zones.
* Basic understanding of Machine Learning concepts is a plus.
* Receptive to feedback and committed to continuous improvement.

**Who Thrives Here**
* Highly analytical and deeply curious.
* Obsessed with understanding the real problem before proposing solutions.
* Comfortable challenging assumptions with data.
* Acts quickly and embraces ambiguity.
* Uses AI as a force multiplier.
* Thinks like an owner.
* Loves turning complexity into clarity.
* Balances strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

**Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far**
* **A global, connected team** 
 We’re a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.
* **Be part of an AI Native Organization** 
 We are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.
* **Innovating a $100 Billion industry** 
 Smartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
* **Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together** 
 We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.
* **Smartcat Culture Code: Where Diversity Meets High Performance** 
 At Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

title: Process Intelligence & Analytics Specialist
description:

 Process Intelligence Manager __

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will work as Process Intelligence \\& Analytics Specialist, and report to the Global IS Process Intelligence Manager. You will leverage process intelligence across Information Systems and Corporate Functions to uncover inefficiencies, optimize processes, and enable automation at scale. You will also contribute to laying the foundation for agentic AI by building robust process semantics and a fact-based understanding of how processes operate end-to-end.

You will translate business needs into high-impact use cases and deliver actionable improvements that generate tangible, measurable business value. You will play a key role in scaling the adoption of Process Intelligence as a strategic capability across the organization.

In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact. This role is contributing to the Information Services (IS) Core function Globally.

**You Will Be Mainly Accountable For**
* Drive end-to-end process analysis using process intelligence to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and automation opportunities across Corporate Functions
* Work closely with business and technical stakeholders to understand needs, challenge assumptions, and co-create high-impact use cases
* Translate business needs into actionable use cases and deliver data-driven recommendations that create tangible, measurable business value
* Build and maintain robust process semantics and data foundations to enable scalable, reusable process intelligence capabilities
* Contribute to laying the foundation for agentic AI by structuring process knowledge into machine-interpretable logic and decision frameworks
* Design, implement, and scale process intelligence use cases end-to-end, combining hands-on delivery with strategic thinking to ensure solutions are impactful, sustainable, and adopted at scale
* Promote and scale the adoption of Process Intelligence as a strategic capability, acting as a trusted advisor to drive fact-based decision-making

**Our Team Dynamics**
 You will join a passionate, high-performing team of process intelligence experts who thrive at the intersection of business, data, and technology. Together, we turn complex processes into clear, fact-based narratives that reveal how work really happens, and where the greatest opportunities lie. We don’t just analyze processes; we actively shape and improve them.

In our team, curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning are key. You will be encouraged to challenge the status quo, experiment with new ideas, and help build Process Intelligence as a core capability, and a key enabler of the next generation of AI.

* You can translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language to non technical audiences; you have demonstrated success building trusted relationships, and co-creating solutions across functions and organizational levels.

**What’s in it for you?**
 We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

* 🕓 Flexible Work Practices: We get that life happens – we support a healthy balance between your professional and personal life.
* 💚 Wellbeing Program: From mental health support to wellness activities, we’ve got your back—mind and body.

**More About Us**
 Our mission in ABB IS (Information Systems) is to harness the power of information technology to deliver valuable, reliable, and competitive IS services for ABB. If you have a strong technical skills, analytical mind, and the drive to help us stay ahead of the competition, you are the one we are looking for.

By connecting its engineering and digitalization expertise, ABB helps industries run at high performance, while becoming more efficient, productive and sustainable so they outperform. **About the Role**

* **Optimise Across Verticals:** Identify where operational support is inconsistent or underdeveloped across flights, ground transportation, and stays, and build the standards, tooling, and processes that bring all three to the same level of reliability.
* **Set the Standard:** Define operational standards and governance frameworks that reduce BAU workload and increase reliability across teams and markets. Lead retrospectives and drive scalable process refinements.

title: Senior Software Engineer - iOS

title: Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced Consultant
description:
**About TechTorch** TechTorch is a high-growth enterprise technology consultancy that partners with the world's leading private equity-backed businesses. We deliver AI-powered solutions, accelerators, and data-driven transformation initiatives that drive measurable value at speed and scale.

**Role Overview** We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced Consultant to join TechTorch's Commercial Excellence Practice. This is a senior, hands-on delivery role for a practitioner who has deep, configured-in-production knowledge of Salesforce Revenue Cloud - including Product Catalog, Pricing, CPQ, Contracts, Amendments, and Billing - and who can lead solution design and implementation end-to-end with PE-portfolio clients.

You will be the go-to Revenue Cloud expert on client engagements, responsible for hands-on configuration, solution architecture, client workshops, and technical oversight. You will work alongside TechTorch architects, delivery leads, and AI-native tooling to accelerate outcomes and deliver measurable commercial value.

**What You'll Do**

**Solution Architecture \\& Design** Design scalable, production-ready Salesforce Revenue Cloud solutions aligned to client quote-to-cash processes.

Architect end-to-end CPQ and billing solutions including product catalog, pricing models, approval workflows, contracts, amendments, and revenue recognition inputs.

Provide platform strategy and thought leadership on integrating Revenue Cloud with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and downstream ERP or billing systems.

Document solution designs, data models, integration patterns, and architectural decisions for client review and internal knowledge management.

**Revenue Cloud Hands-On Configuration**

**Deep, hands-on configuration experience is required across the following Revenue Cloud capabilities:** **Product Catalog:** Create and manage products, product families, product attributes, and product rules (option constraints, configuration rules, pricing conditions).

**Pricing \\& Price Books:** Configure standard price books, segmented pricing, discount schedules (block, slab, term), price waterfall, and price rule actions.

**Quote Configuration:** Build and configure quote templates, quote line editor, quote approval processes, guided selling flows, and output documents.

**CPQ Logic:** Set up product bundles, required components, optional features, exclusion rules, and look-up / summary pricing rules.

**Contracts \\& Amendments:** Configure contract creation from orders, amendment flows, co-term logic, and renewal quote automation.

**Orders \\& Order Management:** Configure order activation, order products, and handoff to fulfilment or billing workflows.

**Billing (Revenue Cloud / Stripe / NetSuite):** Set up billing schedules, invoice runs, credit notes, payment terms, and integration handoff to downstream billing or ERP systems such as NetSuite SuiteBilling or ZoneCo.

**Revenue Recognition:** Support SSP configuration, performance obligation setup, and revenue schedule inputs where required.

**Usage-Based \\& Subscription Billing:** Configure usage summaries, rated usage, subscription products, and evergreen or auto-renew logic.

**Agentforce Revenue (Advanced Advantage):** Knowledge of Agentforce Revenue capabilities, AI-assisted quoting, product recommendation agents, and pipeline-to-revenue automation is highly desirable.

**Implementation Leadership** Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to transform requirements into effective, configured Salesforce solutions.

Lead and facilitate discovery workshops, solution design sessions, and UAT planning.

Translate business requirements into user stories, functional specifications, and configuration workbooks.

Own delivery of configured Revenue Cloud solutions through sprint cycles from dev sandbox to production.

**Integration Design** Architect and oversee integrations between Revenue Cloud and ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Sage), financial platforms, HCM, and fulfilment applications.

Define integration data contracts, field mappings, sync direction, frequency, error handling, and monitoring.

Work with middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Workato, or similar iPaaS tools to govern integration delivery.

Ensure revenue data accuracy and reconciliation between Salesforce and downstream finance systems.

**Governance \\& Standards** Develop best practices, development standards, and architectural guidelines for Revenue Cloud implementations.

Define naming conventions, metadata governance, deployment processes, and change management controls.

Maintain configuration documentation, decision logs, and sprint-level delivery artefacts.

**AI-Native Delivery** Use AI-native delivery practices including LLM-assisted requirements analysis, solution documentation, Flow generation, and rapid prototyping.

Apply conversational development workflows to generate, refine, test, and explain Salesforce artifacts such as Flows, validation rules, Apex logic, and integration specifications.

Use AI tools responsibly while maintaining strong consulting discipline, quality standards, and platform best practices.

**Mentorship \\& Stakeholder Management** Serve as trusted Revenue Cloud advisor to client stakeholders, translating complex platform capabilities into clear business outcomes.

Mentor junior consultants and analysts in Salesforce architecture, configuration, and delivery best practices.

Support pre-sales activities including solution scoping, effort estimation, and proposal development.

**Who You Are**

**Revenue Cloud \\& Quote-to-Cash** Hands-on, production-level experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud (formerly CPQ + Billing) - not just awareness, but built and delivered.

Deep understanding of the full quote-to-cash lifecycle: quoting, pricing, approvals, contracting, amendments, renewals, order management, billing, and revenue recognition.

Proficiency configuring Salesforce CPQ core features: product catalog, price rules, product rules, bundle configuration, discount schedules, quote templates, and output documents.

Experience with Salesforce Billing: billing schedules, invoice runs, usage-based billing, credit notes, payment terms, and billing integration patterns.

Experience supporting integrations with billing or finance systems such as NetSuite SuiteBilling, ZoneCo, Stripe Billing, or equivalent.

Knowledge of Agentforce Revenue and AI-assisted revenue automation is a plus.

**Salesforce Core Platform** Strong proficiency across Salesforce Core - Sales Cloud, Revenue Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.

Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration: objects, fields, record types, page layouts, permission sets, flows, approval processes, reports, and dashboards.

Solid understanding of Salesforce data model, sharing model (OWD, role hierarchy, sharing rules), and security considerations in a Revenue Cloud context.

Knowledge of PSA capabilities (Certinia/FinancialForce, Kantata, or Kimble) is a plus.

**Solution Design \\& Integration** Experience participating in the design and implementation of integrations between Salesforce and ERP, HCM, billing, and financial systems.

Familiarity with middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Workato, or similar tools.

Good understanding of Salesforce APIs, data models, data synchronisation, integration patterns, and governance considerations.

Ability to work closely with architects, developers, business users, and project managers to deliver scalable and maintainable Salesforce solutions.

**AI-Native Capability** Demonstrated ability to use AI-native delivery practices, including LLM-assisted requirements analysis, solution documentation, rapid prototyping, and prompt engineering.

Comfortable using conversational development workflows to generate, refine, test, and explain Salesforce artifacts.

Ability to use AI tools responsibly while maintaining strong consulting discipline, quality standards, and platform best practices.

**Soft Skills** Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills - able to present to both technical and executive audiences.

Ability to translate business requirements into clear Salesforce solution recommendations and configuration trade-offs.

Comfortable leading discovery workshops, documenting requirements, creating user stories, and supporting UAT.

Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and multiple concurrent engagements.

Experience mentoring junior consultants or analysts is a plus.

**Qualifications**

**Experience** 5+ years of Salesforce experience, with strong hands-on consulting and implementation delivery.

3+ years of direct, hands-on Salesforce Revenue Cloud (CPQ and/or Billing) configuration and delivery experience.

Proven delivery of at least two end-to-end Revenue Cloud implementations from requirements through go-live.

Experience working within or alongside PE-backed businesses or high-growth commercial environments is a plus.

**Certifications (Preferred)** Salesforce Certified Administrator Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist (strongly preferred) Salesforce Revenue Cloud Consultant (strongly preferred) Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect is a plus, but not required.

PSA vendor certifications (Certinia/FinancialForce, Kantata, or Kimble) are a plus.

**Client First:** We focus relentlessly on delivering outcomes that create value for our clients.

**We, Not Me:** We win together. Collaboration drives transformation at scale.

**AI First:** We embed AI at the core, enabling scalable, high-leverage solutions.

**Own It:** We take accountability for results, delivering on what we promise.

**Agile Mindset:** We adapt quickly and proactively seek better ways to move forward.

**What We Offer** The opportunity to work at the forefront of AI-powered enterprise technology consulting, specifically on Revenue Cloud and Quote-to-Cash transformation.

This is a senior, hands-on development role for an engineer who has deep, production-grade experience building and customising Salesforce Revenue Cloud - including CPQ extensions, Billing integrations, Apex invocables, LWC components, and platform automation - and who can translate complex quote-to-cash requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions.

You will be the technical engine on Revenue Cloud engagements, responsible for Apex development, Flow architecture, integration build, and code quality. You will work alongside TechTorch solution architects, consultants, and AI-native tooling to deliver at pace for PE-portfolio clients.

**What You'll Do**

**Revenue Cloud Development - Hands-On Build**

**Deep, production-level development experience is required across the following Revenue Cloud and platform capabilities:** **CPQ Apex Extensions:** Build and maintain CPQ Apex classes such as SBQQ.QuoteCalculatorPlugin, CPQ Price Rules callbacks, Product Configurator extensions, and Custom Script replacements.

**Billing Automation:** Develop Apex triggers, invocable methods, and batch jobs to automate billing schedules, invoice generation, payment processing, credit note creation, and billing exception handling.

**Amendment \\& Renewal Logic:** Build Apex-driven amendment and renewal flows including co-term calculations, proration logic, contract line management, and renewal opportunity creation.

**Invocable Apex for Flows:** Design and build invocable Apex methods called from Record-Triggered and Screen Flows to extend Revenue Cloud processes beyond declarative limits.

**LWC Development:** Build Lightning Web Components for custom quote line editors, pricing calculators, product configurators, approval UIs, and billing dashboards embedded in the Salesforce UI.

**Platform Events \\& CDC:** Use Platform Events and Change Data Capture to trigger real-time integrations and downstream system notifications from Revenue Cloud transactions.

**Batch \\& Async Apex:** Write batch, queueable, and scheduled Apex for large-volume Revenue Cloud operations including invoice runs, renewal processing, and usage rating.

**Flow Architecture:** Design and build Record-Triggered Flows, Screen Flows, Autolaunched Flows, and Subflows supporting CPQ and Billing process automation at scale.

**Validation \\& Rules:** Implement validation rules, custom formula fields, and Apex-based constraint logic enforcing quote, contract, and billing data quality standards.

**Agentforce Revenue (Advanced Advantage):** Knowledge of Agentforce Revenue SDK, agent actions, agent topics, and AI-assisted quoting or billing automation is highly desirable.

**Integration Development** Design and build integrations between Revenue Cloud and ERP systems (NetSuite, SAP, Sage), billing platforms (ZoneCo, Stripe), and financial systems.

Develop REST and SOAP API integrations, inbound and outbound, with appropriate error handling, retry logic, idempotency, and monitoring.

Build and maintain integration payloads, field mapping specifications, and data contract documentation for each connected system.

Work with middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Workato, or similar iPaaS tools to govern integration delivery and operational monitoring.

Ensure revenue data integrity, reconciliation, and traceability between Salesforce and downstream finance or billing systems.

**DevOps, CI/CD \\& Release Management** Own technical delivery through the full dev lifecycle: development, code review, unit testing, sandbox validation, staging deployment, and production release.

Use Salesforce DX (sfdx), version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset, or equivalent) for reliable, repeatable deployments.

Manage metadata deployments, change sets, scratch orgs, and sandbox refreshes across project environments.

Write and maintain Apex unit tests meeting or exceeding 85% code coverage, with a focus on meaningful assertions over coverage gaming.

Troubleshoot and resolve production issues including governor limit violations, SOQL performance, integration failures, and Flow errors.

**AI-Native Development** Use AI-native delivery practices including LLM-assisted code generation, Apex development, Flow design, and integration specification drafting.

Apply conversational development workflows using natural language prompts to generate, refine, test, debug, and document Salesforce technical artifacts.

Use AI tools responsibly while maintaining strong engineering discipline, code quality, security standards, and platform best practices.

Contribute to TechTorch's AI-native accelerator library by documenting reusable patterns, prompt templates, and technical tooling.

**Technical Leadership \\& Collaboration** Collaborate closely with solution architects and consultants to translate functional designs into technical build plans.

Participate in technical design reviews, code reviews, and sprint retrospectives.

Mentor junior developers in Salesforce development standards, Revenue Cloud patterns, and AI-native tooling.

Produce clear technical documentation including solution designs, API specs, data flow diagrams, and deployment runbooks.

**Who You Are**

**Revenue Cloud \\& Quote-to-Cash Development** Hands-on, production-level development experience extending Salesforce Revenue Cloud (CPQ and Billing) - not just configuration, but code written and deployed to production.

Deep understanding of the CPQ data model: SBQQ__Quote__c, SBQQ__QuoteLine__c, SBQQ__Product2__c, SBQQ__PriceRule__c, SBQQ__ProductRule__c, and related objects.

Deep understanding of the Billing data model: blng__Invoice__c, blng__BillingSchedule__c, blng__UsageSummary__c, blng__Order__c, and payment-related objects.

Experience writing CPQ Apex extensions including Quote Calculator Plugin, custom pricing logic, and product configuration callbacks.

Experience developing Apex for amendment flows, renewal automation, proration, and co-term billing logic.

Experience integrating Revenue Cloud with NetSuite SuiteBilling, ZoneCo, Stripe Billing, or equivalent downstream billing systems.

Knowledge of Agentforce Revenue SDK and AI-assisted quoting or billing automation is a strong plus.

**Salesforce Core Development** Expert-level Apex development: triggers, classes, invocable methods, batch, queueable, scheduled, and test classes with meaningful assertions.

Strong Lightning Web Component (LWC) development including component composition, wire adapters, Apex integration, and UI API usage.

Deep understanding of Salesforce governor limits, SOQL and DML best practices, bulkification patterns, and performance optimisation.

Strong understanding of Salesforce security model: OWD, role hierarchy, sharing rules, with-sharing / without-sharing, field-level security, and permission sets.

Proficiency with Flow Builder: Record-Triggered Flows, Screen Flows, Autolaunched Flows, Subflows, and Apex-called and Apex-invoked patterns.

Familiarity with Salesforce Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, and Sales Cloud development patterns is a plus.

**Integration \\& APIs** Strong understanding of Salesforce REST and SOAP APIs: Bulk API, Streaming API, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and Composite API patterns.

Experience designing and building bi-directional integrations with error handling, retry, idempotency, and operational monitoring.

Familiarity with middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Workato, or similar iPaaS tools.

Ability to produce and maintain integration data contracts, field mappings, and API specifications for downstream and upstream systems.

**DevOps \\& Engineering Discipline** Proficiency with Salesforce DX, Git-based version control, scratch orgs, and metadata-driven development.

Experience with CI/CD tooling: GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset, or equivalent.

Commitment to code quality: meaningful unit tests, peer code review, static analysis (PMD / Salesforce Code Analyser), and consistent naming and documentation standards.

Ability to troubleshoot complex production issues including governor limits, SOQL performance, async failures, and integration errors.

**AI-Native Capability** Demonstrated ability to use AI-native delivery practices including LLM-assisted development, rapid prototyping, and AI-supported documentation.

Comfortable using conversational development workflows to generate, refine, test, debug, and explain Apex, Flows, LWC, integrations, and APIs.

Ability to use AI tools responsibly while maintaining strong engineering discipline, code quality, security, and platform best practices.

**Soft Skills** Strong communication and collaboration skills - able to work with architects, consultants, business users, QA teams, and project managers across global time zones.

Ability to translate business requirements and solution designs into high-quality, documented technical deliverables.

Able to explain technical options, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Strong problem-solving mindset with attention to quality, maintainability, and long-term scalability.

Experience mentoring junior developers is a plus.

**Qualifications**

**Experience** 5+ years of Salesforce development experience with strong hands-on implementation delivery.

3+ years of direct, hands-on Salesforce Revenue Cloud (CPQ and/or Billing) development experience - code written and deployed to production.

Proven delivery of at least two end-to-end Revenue Cloud development engagements from technical design through go-live.

Experience working within or alongside PE-backed businesses or high-growth commercial environments is a plus.

**Certifications (Preferred)** Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I (required) Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II (strongly preferred) Salesforce Certified Administrator or Platform App Builder Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist (strongly preferred) Salesforce Revenue Cloud Consultant (desirable - demonstrates domain depth alongside technical skill) Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect is a plus, but not required.

PSA vendor certifications (Certinia/FinancialForce, Kantata, or Kimble) are a plus.

**Our Values** Our values reflect the DNA of the private equity-backed companies we serve - focused on speed, ownership, accountability, and results.

**Client First:** We focus relentlessly on delivering outcomes that create value for our clients.

**We, Not Me:** We win together. Collaboration drives transformation at scale.

**Get Stuff Done:** We execute with speed and precision - because in PE, time matters.

**AI First:** We embed AI at the core, enabling scalable, high-leverage solutions.

**Own It:** We take accountability for results, delivering on what we promise.

**Agile Mindset:** We adapt quickly and proactively seek better ways to move forward.

**What We Offer** The opportunity to work at the forefront of AI-powered enterprise technology consulting, building production Revenue Cloud solutions for PE-portfolio companies.

A high-impact engineering environment where code quality, delivery speed, and technical ownership are rewarded.

Exposure to top-tier private equity firms and their portfolio companies across multiple industries and geographies.

A global, collaborative team focused on results, innovation, and technical excellence.

Access to TechTorch's AI-native delivery tooling, Revenue Cloud accelerator library, and internal knowledge base.

You’ll tackle complex distributed systems problems while helping drive internal innovation on the frontlines of AI-assisted engineering.

We work with data at scale, and our pipeline is built with a diverse tech stack (Java, Kafka, Redis, public cloud services, and more). We are remote-first, with team members distributed across several locations, but we have a strong presence in Barcelona and we often take advantage of our lovely offices.

* Work closely with product and sibling teams to understand product specifications and influence the roadmap for the Service Architecture Intelligence products at New Relic.
* Create automation and tooling to make our systems more scalable, easier to deploy.

* A collaborative work style that includes colleagues in important decisions and leads to shared code ownership.
* Adaptability in a rapidly changing industry and a proactive drive to push the boundaries of modern software tools.
* Proficiency in English.

* Proven experience evaluating, benchmarking, or developing custom agentic AI tools, prompt workflows, or developer automation scripts.
* Contributions to open source projects.
* Deep understanding of the value that build and test automation brings to development team efficiency and reliability, with a passion for applying these techniques.

title: Head of Product, Connect
description:
**About the company** At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think "Stripe for Travel." By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.

With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.

Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.

Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

### **About the role** *Remote in Europe, or hybrid from Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or Casablanca.*

**You'll inherit a product group with major customers, real scale, and some of its highest-value product decisions still open and yours to make.** You'll step into a broad portfolio spanning APIs, enterprise products, booking experiences, mapping, data, and supplier technology, with live products already serving major global partners.

Your opportunity is to turn that breadth into a more coherent and commercially focused product group. You'll decide which products can become major growth drivers, how they should fit together, and where sharper pricing, packaging, and product direction can unlock more adoption and revenue.

You'll have the mandate to act on those decisions. You'll report directly to our CEO, work closely with a highly technical engineering organisation, and stay close to the customers, products, and detailed decisions that shape the outcome. As the group grows, you'll build the product function around the direction you establish.

### **What makes it interesting for you**

* You'll work with a customer and partner base that includes Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre, on products that sit directly in how they build and sell travel.
* Your scope goes beyond the roadmap: you'll own the commercial performance and P\\&L behind Connect, including decisions around pricing, packaging, adoption, and where to place the biggest bets.
* You'll work across very different product and customer models, from APIs and enterprise platforms to booking experiences, mapping, data, and supplier technology.
* You'll get meaningful equity in a profitable company that has grown 10x since 2022.

### **The kind of problems you'll work on**

* Which parts of Connect have the potential to become major growth drivers, and where should we stop investing?
* How should products across APIs, booking, mapping, data, and supplier technology fit together for different customer segments?
* Where can better pricing, packaging, and positioning turn existing technology into significantly more adoption and revenue?
* Where should we make common platform bets, and where do enterprise customers need more tailored solutions?

You'll start close to the product, likely taking direct ownership of the core product, LiteAPI, while you build a deeper understanding of the wider Connect portfolio and its customers.

From there, you'll set direction across the group, working with Engineering on what gets built, Sales and customers on commercial opportunities, and Product GTM on adoption. As Connect grows, you'll also build the PM team and define ownership across the portfolio.

### **This role fits if you**

* have personally owned a technically complex platform, API product, or connected portfolio, making decisions about where to invest, scale, reposition, or stop
* have owned pricing, packaging, segmentation, adoption, and commercial performance, ideally for enterprise products
* have enough technical depth to understand architecture, steer product decisions with Engineering, and challenge strong technical teams
* still enjoy detailed product work and want to stay close to customers, engineers, data, and execution
* have operated with broad ownership and limited structure, whether as a founder, early product leader, or in a similarly autonomous environment
* have led PMs before, or have the experience to build and lead a small product function as Connect grows Experience with fintech infrastructure, marketplaces, developer platforms, data products, or similarly complex B2B platforms would be especially relevant.

Nuitee moves fast, with limited process and a high expectation of ownership. You'll probably struggle here if you need clear structures before acting, prefer decisions to move through several layers, or lean towards a hands-off Head role that takes you away from the detail.

If this resonates, we'd love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV.

**Why Nuitee?** At Nuitée, we're not just reimagining travel—we're building the infrastructure to power it.

* Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée's API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.
* World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we're equipped to scale our ambition globally.
* Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.
* Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others

description:
AI Engineer
  
About the company Biorce is a pioneering Healthtech company dedicated to revolutionizing drug development through the power of AI. We are passionate about accelerating medical advancements and improving patient outcomes.

Our team comprises seasoned clinical research professionals, data scientists, and AI experts, working collaboratively to bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and real-world clinical needs.

With an unwavering commitment to revolutionize healthcare, we envision a world where all patients benefit from accelerated and cost-effective access to treatments. Biorce is poised to redefine the landscape of healthcare, shaping a future where innovation and accessibility converge for the betterment of humanity.

About the role Following our successful expansion into the U.S. and continued growth across Europe, we are seeking a Mid-Level AI Engineer to help drive our AI and Data engineering from our Barcelona hub.

Reporting directly to our AI / Engineering leadership, this person will play a critical role in building sophisticated AI systems that go beyond simple chat interfaces.

This role will focus on designing agentic workflows, managing complex state in LLM applications, and ensuring that our generative features are reliable, steerable, and scalable.

Who Were Looking For We are looking for an AI Engineer with experience in software or ML engineering and hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based applications in production.

Someone with an agentic mindset, who understands that LLMs are more powerful when treated as reasoning engines within a larger system rather than just text predictors. This person should be able to manage conversational state and memory in complex, non-linear AI graphs while applying strong software engineering rigor to AI development.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and implement complex, multi-step AI workflows using LangGraph or similar frameworks to manage state, loops, and conditional logic.
* Develop, test, and version-control advanced prompts, Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, ReAct.
* Use Vertex AIs Help me write and prompt optimization tools to refine system instructions.
* Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG, pipelines, including document parsing, embedding optimization, and vector database management.
* Establish automated evaluation frameworks using the Vertex AI Gen AI Evaluation Service to measure hallucination rates, groundedness, and relevancy.

Requirements Must-haves

* 2/3+ years in software/ML engineering, with at least 1 year of hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based applications in production.
* Experience with orchestration tools such as LangGraph, Stateful Actors, LangChain, CrewAI, or Vertex AI Agent Builder.
* Experience with the GCP ecosystem, including Vertex AI Studio, Cloud Run for serverless AI apps, BigQuery for data grounding, and Cloud Storage.
* Advanced RAG techniques, Hybrid search, Parent-Document Retrieval, Query expansion.
* Deep understanding of how to manage conversational state and memory in complex, non-linear AI graphs, cycles, nodes, and edges.
* Ability to treat AI engineering like software engineering, applying CI/CD, unit testing for prompts, and structured logging using Cloud Trace and Cloud Logging.

Nice-to-Haves

* Experience designing agentic workflows using LangGraph or similar frameworks.
* Experience with prompt engineering and optimization, including Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, and ReAct.
* Experience building and maintaining RAG pipelines, including document parsing, embedding optimization, and vector database management.
* Experience establishing LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation frameworks.
* Experience using Vertex AI Gen AI Evaluation Service to measure hallucination rates, groundedness, and relevancy.

Why Join Us?

* A dynamic work environment with an international team, where collaboration and diversity thrive.
* Work alongside top talent, united by a shared purpose and committed to making a real impact.
* Comprehensive private health coverage to ensure your physical and mental well-being.
* Hybrid work model offering flexibility to balance your professional and personal life.
* Company events to celebrate achievements and enjoy time together.
* Get equipped with a MacBook to enhance your productivity and work experience.
* Our office is pet-friendly! Youll likely be greeted by a few wagging tails upon arrival.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

title: E2E Process Reinvention Partner – AI Transformation program
description:
Job Description:
* We are your **Energy Technology Partner**. We electrify, automate, and digitalize every industry, business, and home, driving efficiency and sustainability for all.

At Schneider Electric, our values – IMPACT (Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork) – are the foundation of everything we do. Becoming an Impact Maker means turning sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization.

Are you ready to lead the digital transformation to create a more sustainable world?

If you are up to challenge your creativity and make an impact, we are excited to welcome you!

**Schneider Digital** is the digital department of Schneider Electric, leading the digital transformation in the company by giving support globally to our internal teams and our clients. Schneider Digital consists of 6 Digital Hubs worldwide which are strategically located to ensure a 24/7 support across the company (France, China, India, USA, Mexico and Spain). Our Digital Hub in Barcelona is formed by +450 employees working in strategic projects and different roles such as Data, Cybersecurity, ERP, Cloud, Infrastructures, IT Project Management or Digital Marketing.

The **DCR AI Operations** team is premised on a fundamental insight: deploying AI tools is not enough. The processes, ways of working, and delivery frameworks that govern how DCR teams operate must be reinvented alongside the technology.

The Transformation \\& Change stream drives this reinvention across all DCR capabilities. Its mandate covers current-state process mapping, co-design of AI-enabled future states with domain teams, definition of the digital delivery framework, and tight integration of process redesign with pilots being validated in H2 2026. The E2E Process Reinvention Partner is the expert who translates these ambitions into executable process transformation — engaging with DCR capability teams to produce the Reinvention Vision per capability, define new ways of working, and build the delivery artefacts that allow the organisation to scale what it learns from pilots.

**What will you do?**

**Key Responsibilities** The E2E Process Reinvention Partner leads process transformation design, ensuring AI is embedded into reinvented ways of working, not layered onto existing ones.

Scope: DCR capabilities: Customer Support | Services | Pricing \\& Quotation | Customer Experience | Platform \\& Data | Cybersecurity

* **Map current processes \\& design AI-enabled future states – Process design role**
* For each DCR capability, map the current-state process landscape and define the impact of AI on roles, workflows, and team structures.
* Facilitate reinvention workshops with domain SPOCs to co-design AI-enabled future-state ways of working, grounded in the programme's use case portfolio.
* Produce the Reinvention Vision per DCR domain, capturing transformation ambitions, AI agent integration points, and anticipated capacity reallocation; maintain it continuously as pilots deliver evidence.
* **Define new ways of working \\& support pilot delivery – Transformation integration role**
* Define new WoW frameworks: how AI agents integrate into daily operations, how human-AI collaboration is structured, and how accountability is maintained across each domain.
* Coordinate with Delivery teams to translate process redesign into actionable agent specifications and acceptance criteria; support pilot execution and lead post-pilot WoW validation.
* Integrate pilot learnings into the Phase 3 deployment playbook; perform process feasibility assessments for priority use cases.
* **Build the digital delivery framework \\& programme artefacts – Framework development role**
* Design and update the end-to-end SDLC adapted for Agentic AI, covering agent development, skills definition, artefact libraries, and delivery guidance (including BMAD methodology).
* Collaborate with EIT and the AI Hub to embed process design standards, quality gateways, and compliance controls within the SDLC.
* Build the programme's library of reusable process templates and delivery assets to accelerate and standardise Phase 3 scaling.

(External) English Qualifications:
**What qualifications will make you successful?**

**Qualifications:**

* Business or Engineering Degree
* 8+ years in Process Design, Business Transformation, Digital Operations, or Management Consulting
* Demonstrated experience redesigning end-to-end processes in the context of digital technology deployments (ERP, AI, automation, CRM)
* Experience with SDLC frameworks, Agile delivery methods, or digital product lifecycle management
* Prior exposure to AI, Agentic AI, or automation platforms (e.g. Microsoft Copilot Studio) is a strong advantage
* Experience navigating complex and multicultural organisations

**Skills:**

* Process analysis and future-state design
* Facilitation and structured workshop management
* Documentation, synthesis, and artefact development
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Fluent in English

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Join Impress – Europe’s Leading Health-Tech Innovator!

We're looking for a strong **Machine Learning Engineer** with 3+ years of hands-on experience and with deep fundamentals in ML algorithms and modeling. You'll design and ship models that drive decisions across our business — scoring, ranking, uplift, forecasting, recommendation, and NLP — owning each problem from formulation through production and measured impact. Our Data \\& ML team builds the models that power patient and operations decisions at Impress, Europe's largest orthodontic clinic chain, mining signal from patient communications. You'll have room to take these further and to open up new modeling directions as the business grows.

**Why we’re cool:**

* Work with an international and multicultural team
* Competitive salary
* Teeth aligner and whitening benefits
* Collaborative work environment and positive culture
* Opportunities to grow within a fast-paced, innovative company and real start-up experience with big challenges
* Fresh fruits and healthy snacks at the office

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Frame and solve diverse ML problems** — classification, regression, ranking, uplift / causal modeling, forecasting, recommendation, anomaly detection, and some NLP processing.
* **Build models across the algorithmic spectrum** — from gradient boosting and classical ML to deep learning (mostly inference) — choosing the right tool, not the trendy one.
* **Apply NLP / DL to unstructured data** (text, conversations, communications): classification, intent detection, embeddings, summarization, information extraction.
* **Design experiments and A/B tests** — define offline metrics and online success criteria, reason about baselines, causal effects, and statistical significance, and prove that models actually move the needle.
* **Own the full lifecycle** — data extraction and feature engineering, training and evaluation, deployment, retraining, and monitoring for drift and data quality.
* **Set the technical bar** — bring rigor to evaluation, guard against leakage and overfitting, and mentor on solid ML practice.

**Requirements:**

* **Strong ML fundamentals**: probability and statistics, optimization, bias/variance, regularization, model evaluation, and a real understanding of the algorithms behind the libraries.
* **Breadth of modeling experience**: tree ensembles (boosting/bagging), linear models, clustering, and deep learning (CNNs/RNNs/transformers) — and the judgment to choose between them.
* **Experimentation**: Familiarity with uplift / causal inference and experimentation, or a strong drive to master it.
* **NLP / LLM experience** (embeddings, transformers, fine-tuning or prompting).
* **Technical Stack**: Strong Python and the ML ecosystem (NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn; PyTorch or TensorFlow; gradient-boosting libraries).
* **Production Track Record**: shipping models to production, not just notebooks — and measuring their impact.
* **Software Fundamentals**: clean code, SQL, version control, testing.

**Nice to have:**

* **MLOps maturity**: experiment tracking, CI/CD for models, feature stores, model monitoring.
* **Infrastructure**: Cloud (AWS / GCP), data warehouses, orchestration (Airflow or similar), serving (FastAPI, Docker).
* **Community**: Publications, competitions.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:

The ideal candidate moves fluidly between designing a multi-agent architecture, building an N8N automation workflow, iterating on an LLM prompt, and integrating elements like API calls in data pipelines — all while keeping the end-user experience and operational excellence at heart.
