title: Técnico control operativo y auditoría logística
description:
La posición se centra en el control y análisis de las operaciones logísticas de distribución, con un seguimiento diario de las rutas mediante herramientas específicas de gestión. Se realizará un análisis comparativo entre los tiempos planificados y los tiempos reales de ejecución, identificando cualquier desviación, analizando sus causas y proponiendo acciones correctoras concretas. Además, se llevará el seguimiento de diversos indicadores de rendimiento, conocidos como KPIs, que incluyen la productividad, la puntualidad, la eficiencia y la calidad general del servicio prestado, elaborando para ello informes periódicos de seguimiento y análisis de resultados que permitan una visión clara del desempeño operativo.

Otra parte fundamental del rol consiste en la optimización continua de las rutas y el soporte directo al equipo de reparto, manteniendo un contacto fluido con los repartidores para resolver incidencias operativas y ayudar a corregir desviaciones. Se brindará apoyo activo en la mejora de la planificación y organización de las rutas, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos diarios y los estándares de servicio establecidos. Este trabajo conlleva la detección constante de oportunidades de mejora para incrementar la eficiencia general del proceso y reducir la aparición de incidencias, contribuyendo así a una operación más fluida y confiable.

Finalmente, la posición incluye la realización de auditorías operativas en el campo, mediante acompañamientos periódicos a los repartidores durante el desarrollo de sus rutas. Esta actividad permite una verificación presencial de la correcta ejecución de los procesos de entrega y el control del cumplimiento de los protocolos establecidos, incluyendo los procedimientos de manipulación de la mercancía. La observación y análisis de los tiempos reales de operación en campo es clave para identificar mejoras en los métodos de trabajo y para documentar buenas prácticas, culminando en la elaboración de informes de auditoría detallados y el seguimiento de las acciones correctoras acordadas.

Se requiere experiencia previa en áreas como logística, transporte, distribución, control de procesos u operaciones. Es imprescindible un buen manejo de herramientas informáticas, destacando el dominio de Excel. El candidato debe tener capacidad para trabajar con datos, indicadores de rendimiento y herramientas de seguimiento operativo. Se valorará positivamente la experiencia específica en seguimiento de rutas, control de tiempos o gestión operativa. Es un requisito obligatorio poseer el carnet de conducir de clase B y disponibilidad para realizar acompañamientos en ruta durante la jornada laboral. Se requiere formación de nivel universitario, preferentemente en áreas relacionadas con la administración logística.

title: Digital Campaign Executive
description:
TEAM LEWIS is a global marketing agency that has moved from start-up to multi-national in a little over two decades. Its success is due to a combination of factors: it’s ability to read the future and prepare for it; leveraging cutting edge AI; strategic thinkers delivering award winning campaigns; expanding client relationships into new markets or services; and above all, independence from outside investors. ##### **About the job:** Buscamos un/a **Digital Content \\& Account Executive** para incorporarse al equipo digital. Será responsable de coordinar el día a día con clientes, principalmente B2B, y de desarrollar, gestionar y analizar contenidos para redes sociales.

El puesto tendrá un foco especial en **LinkedIn**, como canal clave para la construcción de marca, el liderazgo de pensamiento y la generación de oportunidades de negocio en entornos B2B. También participará en la creación de contenidos y el seguimiento de actividad en Meta y otros canales digitales cuando el proyecto lo requiera.

Buscamos una persona organizada, con muy buena capacidad de redacción, criterio estratégico y orientación a resultados, capaz de convertir necesidades de cliente en planes de contenido accionables.

**Gestión de clientes y proyectos**

* Coordinarse con perfiles de diseño, paid media, PR, copywriting y community management para ejecutar campañas integradas.

**Contenido y redes sociales**

* Desarrollar planes editoriales y calendarios de contenido para LinkedIn, Meta y otros canales relevantes.
* Redactar y adaptar contenidos para redes sociales, especialmente para audiencias B2B: posts corporativos, contenidos de liderazgo de pensamiento, casos de éxito, campañas, efemérides y piezas de employer branding.
* Adaptar el tono, formato y mensaje a cada cliente, audiencia y plataforma.
* Gestionar la publicación y programación de contenidos, así como la revisión final de copies y creatividades.
* Identificar tendencias, oportunidades de conversación y buenas prácticas para mejorar la relevancia de los perfiles sociales de los clientes.

* Realizar el seguimiento de los principales indicadores de rendimiento: alcance, impresiones, engagement, crecimiento de comunidad, clics, tráfico y conversiones, entre otros.

* Identificar los formatos, mensajes y temáticas con mejor rendimiento para optimizar los planes de contenido.

* Mantenerse al día sobre novedades de LinkedIn, Meta y otras plataformas sociales, aplicándolas cuando aporten valor a las cuentas.

* Experiencia previa de al menos dos años en social media, content marketing, comunicación digital o gestión de cuentas, idealmente en agencia.
* Experiencia trabajando con clientes B2B y comprensión de sus dinámicas de comunicación y toma de decisión.
* Conocimiento práctico de LinkedIn y Meta, tanto desde una perspectiva de contenido como de análisis de rendimiento.
* Excelente capacidad de redacción en español y capacidad para adaptar mensajes a distintos sectores y públicos.
* **Nivel alto de inglés, escrito y hablado (primera entrevista será completamente en inglés)**

* Manejo de herramientas de programación, escucha social y reporting. Se valorará experiencia con Sprinklr, Hootsuite, Metricool, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Business Suite o herramientas similares.
* Organización, autonomía y capacidad para gestionar varios proyectos simultáneamente.
* Actitud proactiva, atención al detalle, mentalidad colaborativa y orientación a resultados.

##### **Qué ofrecemos:**

* Contrato indefinido
* Formato híbrido con **flexibilidad real**
* 25 días de vacaciones al año + tu día de cumple libre para que lo celebres con quien quieras
* Horario de de 9:00 a 18:00 de lunes a jueves y viernes de 8:30 a 14:00
* Jornada intensiva durante el verano de 8:00 a 15:00

* 1.000€ de bonus personal añadido a tu nómina al participar en nuestro charity program con la Fundación TEAM LEWIS

title: DEMAND PLANNER

title: Técnico de planificación de redes eléctricas de alta tensión. Iberdrola Redes Inteligentes Valencia.
description:
¿Has estudiado Ingeniería Industrial con especialidad eléctrica y quieres orientar tus primeros pasos profesionales hacia la planificación y desarrollo de redes eléctricas?

En Iberdrola Redes Inteligentes buscamos personas con base técnica, capacidad analítica y motivación por participar en la evolución de la red de alta tensión, clave para avanzar en la electrificación y la transición energética.

***¡Forma parte de la energía que mueve el futuro!***

***¿Qué harás en tu día a día?*** Te incorporarás a **Iberdrola Redes Inteligentes** en nuestras oficinas de Valencia, para contribuir a la **planificación** de la red de **alta tensión** .

* **Construir escenarios de demanda y generación** para distintos horizontes de planificación, incorporando previsiones de crecimiento, evolución territorial, nuevas cargas y tendencias energéticas como generación distribuida, autoconsumo, almacenamiento y electrificación de la demanda.
* **Realizar estudios técnicos de red** mediante herramientas de simulación eléctrica, analizando el comportamiento de la red en distintos escenarios de explotación y de red planificada.
* **Modelizar elementos de la red eléctrica** , como subestaciones, líneas, transformadores, reactancias, baterías de condensadores, generación, demanda y elementos equivalentes en herramientas de cálculo de red.
* **Ejecutar flujos de carga** para evaluar saturaciones, perfiles de tensión, pérdidas y márgenes de capacidad de líneas y transformadores.
* **Identificar restricciones y necesidades de refuerzo** derivadas de sobrecargas, incumplimientos de tensión, balance de reactiva, crecimiento de demanda o integración de nueva generación.
* **Analizar redes malladas y contingencias** , aplicando criterios de seguridad de suministro, incluyendo análisis N-1 de líneas, transformadores, barras relevantes y contingencias combinadas cuando proceda.
* **Evaluar redistribuciones de flujo y cuellos de botella** tras contingencias, proponiendo medidas de mitigación como refuerzos, nuevos enlaces, cambios topológicos, seccionamientos, telemandos o soluciones transitorias.
* **Estimar la capacidad disponible en nudos de alta tensión** para demanda, generación y almacenamiento, considerando capacidad firme, contingencias, límites térmicos y tensiones.
* **Analizar solicitudes de acceso y conexión** y su impacto sobre la red existente y planificada, incluyendo restricciones aguas arriba o dependencias con la red de transporte.
* **Plantear y comparar alternativas de desarrollo de red** , como nuevas líneas, repotenciaciones, cambios de conductor, ampliaciones de subestación, transformación adicional, reconfiguración de mallas o automatización.
* **Trabajar con datos y herramientas digitales** , utilizando SQL, Power BI, Python, Excel u otras soluciones para analizar información, elaborar informes y mejorar procesos técnicos.
* **Participar en la mejora metodológica y tecnológica** de las herramientas de planificación de la red de alta tensión, incorporando automatizaciones y el uso responsable de inteligencia artificial cuando aporte valor.

Aprenderás participando en estudios técnicos reales de planificación, combinando análisis eléctrico, modelización, datos, criterios regulatorios y visión estratégica del desarrollo de la red.

***¿Qué perfil buscamos?***

* **Grado en Ingeniería Industrial y Máster con especialidad eléctrica.**
* Conocimientos técnicos valorables en flujos de carga, redes de transporte y distribución, conceptos de cortocircuito, regulación de tensión y reactiva, calidad de suministro y planificación de inversiones.
* Conocimiento y destreza en herramientas de cálculo de red, programación en Python, Excel avanzado, VBA, SQL/Access, tratamiento de datos y manejo de prompts en herramientas de inteligencia artificial.

title: Marketing Data Analyst

What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.

For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.

Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. **The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:**

You'll own performance diagnostics and reporting (WBR/MBR) across every marketing channel, using Looker and BigQuery to explain not just what happened, but why. You'll partner directly with marketing leadership on media mix and budget decisions, design incrementality and causal impact experiments to prove true marketing lift, help calibrate our Marketing Mix Models alongside our econometrics partners, and champion self-service analytics by scaling our governed Looker semantic layer so regional teams can find their own answers.

* Solid grounding in marketing science - attribution vs. incrementality, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), and causal inference methods such as geo-holdout or "go-dark" testing

* Experience collaborating with external econometric or data science partners on MMM calibration

title: RevOps Performance Analyst
description:
**About Pleo**
 Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a RevOps Performance Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between raw data and strategic execution and be part of the GTM engine as we scale our automated spend management solutions across Europe. If you're excited about turning ambiguity into actionable insights and are passionate about FinTech and data-driven growth, then this is the opportunity for you!

**Who You'll Be Working With And Reporting To**
 You'll report to our Manager, Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our team of RevOps specialists is highly collaborative and dedicated to optimising the entire revenue lifecycle. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data Engineering and Finance to ensure a single source of truth for all company-wide KPIs

**What You'll Be Doing**
 As a RevOps Performance Analyst, you will:

* Create holistic insights across the entire revenue funnel (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success) to identify bottlenecks and conversion opportunities. Interpret ambiguous GTM questions and translate them into measurable metrics and analytical approaches.
* Develop and maintain automated dashboards that act as the "Single Source of Truth" for GTM KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and pipeline velocity.
* Challenge or refine requests when definitions, logic, or business relevance are unclear. Recommend improved metrics or analytical approaches when they better address the underlying business need.
* Design analytics data models and tables to ensure data integrity across the tech stack (CRM, Billing, BI tools), ensuring all data is stored and transferred securely. Identify the correct system of record and reconcile discrepancies across sources. Partner with Data \\& Analytics when data engineering or architecture support is required.
* Support senior management and our C-Level stakeholders with data-driven recommendations on resource allocation and GTM strategy; highlighting risks, trade-offs, and expected impact.
* Build and continuously improve predictive models for sales forecasting and churn propensity to provide actionable forward-looking insights.
* Analyse the impact of key variables in the sales process—such as discounting behaviours, lead routing efficiency, and promotion effectiveness—to drive operational excellence.

**What You Bring**
 You'll thrive in this role if you have:

* A solid understanding of SQL, data modeling and predictive statistical techniques
* Strong communication skills and the ability to translate messy business questions into clean, measurable metrics
* A passion for challenging the status quo and refining logic when business relevance is unclear
* Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise high-impact tasks for senior leadership
* Experience with SaaS metrics (NRR, Gross Margin, Magic Number)
* A background in RevOps, Sales Ops or Strategic Finance within a high-growth environment

**Why is this role a good fit for you**
**This role is a good fit for you if:**
* You love the detective work of finding out why a conversion rate dropped and proposing the fix
* You enjoy being the bridge between technical data engineers and non-technical sales leaders
* You want to see your analytical models directly influence the company's GTM strategy in real-time

**This role is not a good fit for you if:**
* You prefer working on static reports rather than dynamic, evolving business problems
* You are uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or senior management when the data tells a different story
* You prefer a siloed environment where you don't have to worry about the upstream or downstream impact of data

**How You'll Develop In This Role**
 In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

* Lead a full-funnel audit to drive impact in lead-to-close efficiency
* Collaborate with data engineering to improve our underlying RevOps data architecture and dbt models
* Grow your skills in executive presence, presenting quarterly performance deep-dives to our GTM leadership We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on larger strategic projects, stepping into a leadership track, or mastering advanced data engineering skills within the RevOps domain Please note: You will need to be physically based in one of the locations listed on the advert with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of our locations.

**Show me the benefits!**
* 💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
* 🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
* 🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
* 🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
* 🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
* 🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
* ❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
* 👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

**The interview process**
 We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

* Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.
* Hiring Manager Interview: A 45- minutes interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can adapt to the role
* Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
* Final Interview: Final conversation with a Senior Leader Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a vast numbers of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

* We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
* Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
* Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

**About Your Application**
* English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
* A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
* Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
* Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
* Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
* Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
* Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

 Junior Commercial Data Analyst

**Company:** 
 Macmillan Iberia/ Macmillan Polska

**Location:** 
 Madrid/ Warsaw (Hybrid Work)

**Industry:** 
 Publishing / Educational Technology

**Application Deadline:** 
 14th August 2026

**About Springer Nature**
 Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and @SpringerNature.

**About The Brand**
 Macmillan Education provides world-class content in the most relevant, engaging and flexible formats to support students, teachers and institutions in lifelong learning.

Visit macmillaneducation.com and follow @MacmillanEducation / @MacmillanELT

**About The Role**
 The
 **Junior Commercial Data Analyst** 
 supports the commercial and pricing team by collecting, processing, and maintaining pricing and sales data, ensuring accuracy and consistency across systems. The role focuses on executing established processes, preparing reports, and assisting with data analysis to enable informed decision-making. While the position is primarily operational, we aim to provide opportunities for the successful candidate to develop technical data management and analytical skills and, over time, take ownership of running and presenting his or her own analyses.

**Team:** 
 Works within the Pricing \\& Analytics function, part of Commercial Development and Pricing.

**Role Responsibilities**
**Pricing Support**
* Collect pricing and product data from various departments following data request protocols, maintaining clear documentation, and ensuring timely delivery of required information.
* Process pricing updates in relevant business systems by adhering to predefined workflows, validating entries against approved guidelines, and escalating discrepancies for resolution.
* Assist in preparing annual price lists by consolidating regional inputs, applying global standards, and supporting the Supervisor in quality checks before finalization.

**Data Processing \\& Maintenance**
* Standardize, clean, and process data for reporting and pricing activities by applying established templates, running automated scripts where available, and performing manual checks to ensure data integrity.
* Maintain accurate records of data updates and changes through systematic logging and version control practices to support audit and compliance requirements.

**Analytics \\& Reporting**
* Support monthly sales reporting and revenue optimization projects by extracting relevant data, applying basic analytical techniques, and formatting outputs for review by senior team members.
* Assist in creating dashboards and summaries for internal stakeholders by using standardized reporting tools and ensuring clarity and consistency in visual presentation.

**Collaboration**
* Work closely with the Pricing Strategy \\& Analytics Supervisor to ensure alignment with established processes by attending regular check-ins, sharing progress updates, and incorporating feedback promptly.
* Liaise with other teams to resolve data-related queries through clear communication, timely follow-up, and adherence to agreed service levels.

**Process Improvement**
* Contribute ideas for improving data collection and reporting workflows by identifying recurring issues, suggesting practical solutions, and supporting implementation under guidance.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives in pricing and reporting by assisting in testing new tools or processes and providing feedback on usability and efficiency.

**Experience, Skills \\& Qualifications:**
**Essential**
* Technical Skills: Comfortable using Excel for data organization and analysis; basic understanding of and willingness to enhance data visualization tools and ERP systems.
* Organizational Skills: Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Analytical Thinking: Interest in developing analytical skills and understanding pricing principles.
* Communication: Clear and professional interaction with internal teams.
* Languages: English required (C1 CEFR); Spanish desirable for regional collaboration.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Basic familiarity with data processing tools; interest in learning advanced analytics.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

**To apply** 
 please submit a CV and a cover letter outlining your key ambitions for the role, and current notice period.

**Springer Nature Skills associated with this job profile include:** 
 SN-Big Data Management, SN-Customer-Focused, SN-Data analytics / Quantitative Skills, SN-Decision Quality, SN-Business Insights, SN- Market Intelligence, SN-Goal Alignment, SN-Data Security \\& Governance At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress – and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish.

If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence, or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodations.

Learn more about our DEI work here: https://group.springernature.com/gp/group/taking-responsibility/diversity-equity-inclusion For more information about career opportunities at Springer Nature, visit:

title: Data Analyst & SIOP

title: King's AI/ML & Data Science Talent Pool
description:
**Craft:**
 Data, Analytics \\& Strategy

**Job Description:**
**Join King’s AI/ML \\& Data Science Talent Pool!**
 At King, we’re always interested in connecting with talented people across AI, Machine Learning, Data Science and Analytics who are passionate about using data and technology to create better experiences for millions of players.

Whether you’re an Associate, Mid-level, Senior, Principal or Lead Data Scientist, AI/ML Engineer, Research Engineer or Product Analyst, we’d love to hear from you. By joining our Talent Pool, you’ll be considered for future opportunities across our game teams and central AI/ML and Data Science teams. If your background aligns with a role, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will get in touch to discuss it with you.

**What We’re Typically Looking For**
 Our teams work across areas including applied AI research, player behaviour modelling, personalisation, recommendations, experimentation, decision automation, game and product analytics, content optimisation, forecasting and production ML systems.

While every role requires a different combination of skills, we often look for people with experience in:

* Applying data science, machine learning, statistics or analytics to solve player, product or business challenges.
* Developing models, experiments, analyses or data products that improve player experience, personalisation, content, decision-making or business performance.
* Taking work from exploration and prototyping through to implementation, production or measurable product impact.
* Building or working with reliable data and ML pipelines, evaluation approaches and scalable systems.
* Bringing expertise in one or more areas such as machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling, optimisation, deep learning, reinforcement learning, generative AI or data visualisation.
* Using relevant tools and technologies for your field. Depending on the role, these might include Python, SQL, Spark, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, cloud platforms, dashboards, experimentation platforms or ML pipelines. We don’t expect candidates to have experience with all of these.
* Collaborating with Engineering, Product, Game Design, UX and other disciplines to turn opportunities into practical, player-focused solutions.
* Communicating complex ideas clearly through analysis, documentation, model evaluations, prototypes, dashboards or presentations.

We welcome people from both academia and industry; from PhD students and early-career professionals to experienced specialists and technical leaders.

Your experience might come from gaming, consumer technology, entertainment, e-commerce, fintech, advertising, research or another data-rich environment. What matters most is your curiosity, collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for solving complex problems and delivering meaningful impact.

**Why King?**
 At King, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to games and experiences enjoyed by millions of players around the world. You could work with large-scale data, explore emerging technologies, help bring models into production or use analytics to inform decisions that directly affect our players.

Our AI/ML, Data Science and Analytics teams work in collaborative, cross-functional environments where curiosity, experimentation, technical excellence and practical impact are encouraged.

Whether you’re passionate about applied AI research, ML engineering, product analytics, experimentation or scalable ML systems, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution while continuing to develop your craft.

***Interested?***
 Submit your profile to our Talent Pool!

Every profile submitted is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team. If your skills and experience align with the types of AI/ML, Data Science or Analytics opportunities we hire for, we’ll add your profile to our Talent Pool and may reach out if a suitable opportunity becomes available.

If we don’t believe your background currently aligns with these opportunities, we’ll let you know and won’t progress your profile into the Talent Pool at this time. You’re always welcome to apply for other opportunities at King that match your skills and experience.

We appreciate your interest in King and look forward to connecting with you if the right opportunity arises.

**About King**
 With a mission of
 *Making the World Playful* 
 , King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as
 *Farm Heroes Saga* 
 . King games are played by more than 200 million monthly active users. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**About Us** Prime Insights is a Sweden-based technology company reaching millions of diverse users through our proprietary Market Research Panel. Beyond our world-class Market Research Panel, we are scaling our Offerwall and Play-to-Earn (P2E) ecosystems. We connect millions of users to games and products they love, leveraging sophisticated targeting to ensure high engagement for advertisers and maximum rewards for our users.

As part of our Central Data Team, you will be the backbone of our intelligence, building the models and systems that power our international community.

We are looking for a
 **Data Scientist** 
 who can build predictive models, recommendation systems, and experimentation frameworks to improve user engagement, LTV, and fraud detection in a high-scale product environment.
 **Experience in AdTech, Gaming, or similar industries is a strong plus.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Predictive Targeting \\& Personalization: Build recommendation engines that match the right offer (game/survey) to the right user at the right time to maximise user engagement.
* User Lifetime Value (LTV) Modeling: Develop models to predict long-term user value and churn, allowing us to optimize user acquisition spend.
* Fraud \\& Anomaly Detection: Guard the ecosystem by building real-time systems to detect "farming," bot behavior, and VPN spoofing.
* Statistical Rigor: Serve as the internal consultant for experimentation (A/B testing) design, ensuring results are statistically significant and unbiased.
* Advanced Analytics: Move beyond descriptive reporting into diagnostic and predictive analytics.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **3+ years of experience in Data Science** 
 , ideally within AdTech, Gaming, or FinTech.
* Core Tech Stack: Expert proficiency in
 **Python** 
 (Scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost, PyTorch) and
 **Advanced SQL.**
* **AdTech Knowledge:** 
 Familiarity with concepts like
 **CPM, ROAS, Attribution, and Post-back loops.**
* Strong communication skills: Able to clearly explain findings, assumptions, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experimental Design: Deep understanding of
 **A/B testing in high-traffic environments** 
 where "noise" is high.
* **Product Curiosity:** 
 You don’t just build models; you want to understand the psychology of why a user clicks one game over another.

**How to Apply** Use the
 **Easy Apply** 
 button.

❗
 **Important:** 
 We are not considering freelancers working on multiple projects simultaneously. This is a
 **full-time position** 
 for a dedicated Data Scientist who is ready to commit to a single product ecosystem and contribute meaningfully to its long-term success.

title: Analista de Control de Gestión
description:
PERFIL DE CARGO ANALISTA DE CONTROL DE GESTIÓN, SISTEMAS \\& BI – AGRÍCOLA Área: Control de Gestión Agrícola Reporta a: Jefatura de Control de Gestión

* PROPÓSITO DEL CARGO Buscamos un(a) Analista de Control de Gestión, Sistemas \\& BI que contribuya a transformar la manera en que se gestiona, consolida y reporta la información agrícola de la compañía.

El área de Control de Gestión trabaja con información proveniente de 12 campos agrícolas, utilizando SAP como sistema central, además de Excel y distintas plataformas internas. Actualmente, una parte importante del procesamiento y consolidación de la información se realiza mediante procesos manuales y bajo diferentes criterios y formatos entre las distintas operaciones.

El principal desafío del cargo será ordenar, estandarizar, sistematizar y progresivamente automatizar estos procesos, generando información confiable, comparable y oportuna para los distintos usuarios internos y externos.

Será un rol con una fuerte orientación hacia los datos, sistemas y Business Intelligence, pero estrechamente vinculado con el negocio. La persona deberá comprender cómo se genera la información desde su origen, identificar oportunidades de mejora y desarrollar las herramientas necesarias para que Control de Gestión pueda disponer de información de calidad en tiempo y forma.

El objetivo de mediano plazo es avanzar desde un modelo basado principalmente en planillas y procesos manuales hacia una gestión integrada, automatizada, estandarizada y cada vez más cercana al tiempo real.

* PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES
* Control y Consolidación de Información Agrícola Recopilar, procesar y consolidar información proveniente de los 12 campos agrícolas gestionados por el área.

Descargar, estructurar, depurar y validar información proveniente de SAP y otras plataformas.

Preparar bases de datos y planillas de control, asegurando consistencia, trazabilidad y calidad de la información.

Homologar información proveniente de distintos campos que actualmente utilizan diferentes criterios, estructuras y formatos.

Detectar diferencias, errores e inconsistencias en la información y gestionar su corrección con las áreas correspondientes.

Preparar información para su utilización en reportes, análisis y presentaciones para clientes internos y externos.

Mantener criterios y estructuras de información que permitan realizar análisis comparables entre las distintas operaciones.

* Estandarización y Automatización de Procesos Identificar procesos manuales, repetitivos y susceptibles de ser automatizados.

Diseñar e implementar soluciones que permitan reducir progresivamente la dependencia de planillas y procesos manuales.

Estandarizar formatos, estructuras, indicadores y criterios de reportería entre los distintos campos.

Automatizar procesos de extracción, transformación, consolidación y visualización de información.

Desarrollar herramientas que permitan mejorar la velocidad, confiabilidad y disponibilidad de los datos.

Proponer e implementar permanentemente mejoras en los procesos y herramientas utilizadas por el área de Control de Gestión.

Documentar procesos y estructuras de información para facilitar su continuidad y escalabilidad.

* Business Intelligence y Sistemas Utilizar SAP, Power BI y Excel avanzado como herramientas centrales para la gestión y análisis de información.

Desarrollar, mantener y mejorar dashboards e indicadores para visualizar el desempeño de los distintos campos.

Trabajar con bases de datos y múltiples fuentes de información para construir reportes integrados.

Participar en la integración y optimización de plataformas internas de la compañía.

Trabajar coordinadamente con el área de TI para resolver necesidades de integración, automatización, conectividad y desarrollo de sistemas.

Apoyar la construcción progresiva de una arquitectura de información que permita contar con una fuente única, confiable y trazable de datos.

Identificar oportunidades de integración entre las distintas plataformas utilizadas por la compañía.

* Información para la Gestión del Negocio Preparar información de gestión para las distintas sociedades y operaciones agrícolas.

Generar reportería para clientes internos, incluyendo Control de Gestión, Contabilidad, Finanzas y áreas operacionales.

Preparar información para clientes externos, incluyendo fondos de inversión vinculados a las operaciones agrícolas.

Apoyar procesos de cierre, presupuesto, forecast y seguimiento de indicadores agrícolas.

Facilitar el acceso oportuno a información que permita comprender el desempeño de las distintas operaciones.

Contribuir a transformar datos operacionales en información útil para la toma de decisiones.

A mediano plazo, el desafío será avanzar hacia una mayor trazabilidad y disponibilidad de información relacionada con:

Producción y rendimiento de los campos.

Ubicación y estado de la fruta.

Procesamiento.

Destino comercial.

Clientes y ventas.

Indicadores productivos.

Indicadores económicos.

Evolución y desempeño de las distintas operaciones.

CONOCIMIENTOS TÉCNICOS Nivel avanzado Excel avanzado.

Power BI.

Manejo y estructuración de bases de datos.

Deseable SAP.

Power Query.

DAX.

SQL.

Herramientas de automatización e integración de datos.

Experiencia en conexión entre distintas fuentes de información.

Modelamiento y transformación de datos.

Desarrollo de procesos automatizados de reportería.

Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en integrar distintas fuentes y sistemas para reducir la intervención manual y generar reportería automatizada y confiable.

title: (Senior) Product Analyst
description:
**Who are we?**
**Tripledot** 
**Studios** 
 is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who
 **LOVE** 
 making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

**Role Overview**
 You will be embedded within a cross-functional development team and contribute throughout the full lifecycle of features and A/B tests - from defining success metrics and supporting experiment design to analysing results and recommending the next iteration. You will combine real-time data, player behaviour insights, industry trends and business intuition to validate hypotheses and optimise the player experience.

Working closely with Product Managers, developers, QA, art, level design and Live Operations, you will develop a deep understanding of player journeys, product performance and business outcomes. You will also collaborate with teams such as User Acquisition and present insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

This role will suit someone who goes beyond explaining what is happening in the data to recommending what the team should do next.

**Key Responsibilities**

title: Engineering Manager
description:
### **Descripción**

**Si tienes experiencia profesional sólida en Golang y Kubernetes, sigue leyendo.**

### **Engineering Manager · Cloud Europeo (Observability / PostgreSQL)** **Ubicación:** Barcelona, híbrido **Salario:** 85.000 – 100.000 € brutos/año + pack de beneficios

#### **Sobre el proyecto** Colaboramos con el hub tecnológico en Barcelona de uno de los mayores grupos de distribución y retail del mundo, con presencia en más de 30 países y cientos de miles de empleados. Además de dar soporte tecnológico a todo el grupo, han construido su propia plataforma cloud, con la ambición real de convertirse en una alternativa europea frente a los grandes proveedores americanos. Cuentan con la colaboración y el apoyo de instituciones europeas, y están en plena fase de expansión en Barcelona.

#### **El rol** Liderarás uno o dos equipos de entre 5 y 6 ingenieros, apoyándote en un Engineering Lead técnico para la ejecución más profunda del dominio. Tendrás voz directa en la arquitectura técnica y en las decisiones que definen cómo se construye el producto.

Serás pieza clave en construir el equipo: decidirás qué perfiles encajan con la cultura del proyecto y liderarás la planificación de crecimiento a medida que el equipo escala.

También actuarás como puente entre los equipos de España y Alemania, siendo el manager de referencia local para tu equipo.

**Responsabilidades principales**

* Apoyar el desarrollo profesional de tu equipo, ayudando a cada persona a avanzar hacia sus objetivos de carrera.
* Ser responsable del diseño, desarrollo, provisión y operación de los servicios de tu dominio, incluyendo la validación y sostenibilidad de los diseños de sistema.
* Conducir code reviews, asegurando que el código cumple los estándares de escalabilidad, mantenibilidad y corrección.
* Tener visión técnica completa del producto y participar activamente en la definición del roadmap.
* Liderar la planificación de recursos del equipo según el roadmap de producto.

**Cómo funciona el día a día** El equipo entregará un MVP cada trimestre. La estrategia de producto ("el qué") la define el Product Owner; tú definirás "el cómo": diseño técnico, arquitectura y ejecución. Al trabajar sobre una plataforma cloud propia, tendrás amplio margen para la investigación y la toma de decisiones autónoma dentro del equipo.

#### **Las dos posiciones abiertas**

**Observability** Un dominio hoy pequeño dentro de una compañía en plena expansión, centrado en seguridad IT y servicios de plataforma (Secrets Manager, Telemetry, Mail Out). Se valora experiencia específica en criptografía y cifrado.

**PostgreSQL** El producto más maduro y de mayor éxito comercial de la plataforma, con miles de instancias ya en producción. El reto aquí será dar estabilidad a un sistema de alta criticidad con una base de clientes real. Liderarás un equipo híbrido España/Alemania de unas 10 personas. Tener conocimientos previos de bases de datos ayuda a ganar credibilidad técnica desde el primer día.

#### **Qué buscamos**

* Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia previa como lead, con un perfil claramente técnico detrás.
* Experiencia profesional sólida desarrollando con Golang y Kubernetes.
* Capacidad de mantener visión de conjunto en un entorno rápido y con prioridades múltiples.
* Fuertes habilidades de resolución de problemas y comunicación.
* Mentalidad de Servant Leader: motivación real por guiar personas según sus necesidades.
* Inglés fluido para el día a día. El alemán es un plus.

#### **Por qué es interesante**

* **Peso técnico real**: combinarás liderazgo de equipo con decisiones reales de arquitectura.
* **Filosofía salarial sin techo de cristal**: un perfil experto técnico y uno de gestión, al mismo nivel de responsabilidad, cobran igual.
* **Momento de expansión**: el equipo va a duplicar su tamaño en el próximo año, así que quien entre ahora en liderazgo formará parte activa de esa construcción.
* **Impacto rápido**: cada trimestre se entregará un MVP real a producción, así que tus decisiones se verán reflejadas rápido.

#### **Condiciones**

* Salario: hasta 100.000 € brutos/año para perfiles excepcionales, con revisión salarial anual en enero.
* Modelo híbrido y flexible: en torno a 2-3 días semanales en oficina.
* Beneficios (\\~3.700 €/año, mayoría netos): retribución flexible (ticket restaurante y transporte), seguro médico privado, ayuda al teletrabajo, wellbeing budget, clases de idiomas y formación continua.

title: AI Data Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life by providing life science, diagnostic and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, application and both measurement and asset management expertise.

Builds the data products and pipelines a pod runs on; turns raw domain data into model-ready assets. Pods do not wait for the Fabric to be complete; they build the Fabric through execution, and this role is where that happens for the data plane. Every domain data product built in a pod is constructed to certification standards from the start, because the second consumer of the asset is the point, not an afterthought.

The role goes beyond the conventional pipeline engineering. AI consumption changes what ?model-ready? means: data must be retrieval-ready, semantically annotated, contract-governed, and quality-scored, and the AI Data Engineer often uses agents to do the building, generating metadata, resolving entities, and classifying unstructured domain content rather than hand-curating at a scale that cannot hold.

**Responsible for**
* Domain data products and pipelines serving the pod's use case, built to the data plane's certification standards: semantic definition, data contract, entitlement metadata including agent identity, lineage, and certification tier from day one.
* Data quality and model-readiness, including quality scoring against the defined dimensions and the quality signals that feed the evals spine; when quality falls below threshold, this role is the one who says so before the agent does something embarrassing with it.
* Working relationships with the domain's data owners and stewards, so that steward-validated definitions and certified sources ground the pod's retrieval rather than whatever was easiest to reach.
* Retrieval foundations for the pod: structured and unstructured grounding, vector and graph assets where the use case requires relationship reasoning, built on the platform estate rather than parallel infrastructure.
* AI-built curation in practice: deploying metadata generation, entity resolution, and content classification agents against the domain's data, contributing those outputs to the registry.
* Reusable assets back to the Fabric: every domain data product is a candidate for certification and enterprise reuse, documented and handed to the data plane for promotion, not a point integration that dies with the pod.
* Works with the business teams and IT to develop domain data models.
* Applying broad understanding of on premise and cloud deployment topologies, creates data collection frameworks to capture, manage, store and utilize large sets of structured, unstructured and/or disconnected data from a wide variety of internal and external sources.
* Oversees the establishment of data set processes and builds data structures based on business and technical requirements to funnel data from multiple sources and store using any combination of storage forms (e.g. cloud, local databases) as required.
* Consults in design standards and assurance processes for software, systems and applications development to ensure compatibility and operability of data connections, flows and storage requirements.
* Creates data tools for analytics and data scientist team members that assist them in building and optimizing our analytics products.
* Prepares and manipulates data for predictive and prescriptive modeling. Uses data to discover tasks that can be automated. Identify ways to improve data reliability, efficiency and quality.
* Reviews internal and external business and product requirements for data operations and activity and suggests changes and upgrades to systems and storage to accommodate ongoing needs.

**What Success Looks Like In Year One**
* The pod's use case running entirely on contract-governed, quality-scored data products, with no undocumented side channels into source systems.
* Multiple domain data products from the pod certified into the registry and consumed or queued for consumption by multiple use cases.
* Quality signals from the pod's domain flowing into the evals spine, with at least one instance where a quality threshold correctly gated an agent behavior.
* Measurably faster data-to-build time driven by reuse and process optimization

**Qualifications**
* Strong data engineering with experience building for AI consumption: retrieval-ready, semantically annotated, contract-governed data products, not only warehouse tables and dashboards.
* Hands-on familiarity with the platform estate (Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, vector and graph stores) and with operating under data contracts, lineage, and certification requirements.
* Experience with RAG data foundations: chunking, embedding, hybrid retrieval, and the failure modes that show up in agent behavior rather than in pipeline monitoring.
* The disposition to work inside a business domain: you interview stewards, read the pipeline code that produces the data to understand what it actually means, and treat domain knowledge as the scarce input.
* Curiosity about AI, its potential and its pitfalls. The field moves monthly, and the people who thrive here are genuinely curious about both sides of it: what these systems can newly do, and where they fail, mislead, or quietly degrade. We want people who read the failure analyses as eagerly as the launch posts, who experiment on their own initiative, and who hold excitement and skepticism at the same time without letting either one win permanently.
* Lifelong learners. Whatever expertise a candidate arrives with will be partially obsolete within a year, and that is not a defect of the candidate; it is the condition of the field. We hire people who have reinvented their toolkit before and expect to do it again, who learn in public, and who treat being wrong as information rather than injury. A history of deliberate self-reinvention counts for more than any single credential.
* Excellent communication and the ability to influence. Nothing in this organization ships by authority alone. Every AI CoE role here persuades: domain experts to engage, stewards to share what they know, sponsors to stay honest about value, and functions like Legal, Quality, and Security to move from gatekeeping to partnership. We look for people who write and speak clearly, who adapt their register from bench scientist to Board, and who change minds through credibility and clarity rather than escalation.
* The instinct to generalize: you build for the second consumer of the asset, not only the first.
* Bachelor's or Master's Degree or equivalent.
* Typically, at least 8+ years relevant experience for entry to this level.

**Additional Details**
 This job has a full time weekly schedule.

Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
**About Block Labs**
 Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of
 **Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming** 
 . We don't just ship features; we engineer high-scale, production-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products.

We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi-agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high-frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence.

We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong.

****The Role****
 Data \\& Intelligence now sits at the centre of several products we are developing, and we need a platform that is both dependable and capable of supporting more advanced intelligence over time.

This role reflects that shift. We are designing a new data platform that will act as the backbone for everything from real time decisioning to predictive modelling. As a Data Platform Engineer in the Data Team, you will own the end-to-end real-time pipeline, serving data across a unified analytical warehouse and feature-serving layer. You are not building dashboards. You are engineering the commercial nervous system of a multi-tenant platform designed to scale from one operator to 10x with marginal infrastructure cost.

****Key Responsibilities:****
* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines using AWS Glue (PySpark), or equivalent orchestration and transformation tools.
* Engineer and optimise the ClickHouse warehouse for sub-second query performance across all back-offices.
* Implement data contracts between back-office and the platform. Onboarding a new operator is a config change, not new tables, topics, or feature views.
* Build the feature-serving layer providing pre-computed features to AI agents at millisecond latency.
* Integrate with third-party databases, back-office APIs, and external systems (CRM, affiliates, acquisition platforms).
* Establish monitoring, alerting, and maintenance procedures including pipeline health checks, freshness monitoring, anomaly detection, and data contract SLA enforcement.
* Own CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code for data workloads.
* Collaborate with data scientists, agent engineers, BI developers, and infrastructure teams to translate data requirements into reliable, production-grade pipelines.

****About You:****
* 3+ years building and operating production data pipelines at scale, with hands-on experience across both streaming and batch paradigms.
* Expertise in Apache Kafka (or Amazon MSK): topic design, consumer group management, offset handling, schema registry operations, and production troubleshooting of lag, rebalancing, and throughput issues.
* Strong SQL and warehouse engineering skills: experience with columnar analytical databases (ClickHouse strongly preferred, or similar: Druid, BigQuery, Redshift).
* PySpark / Spark Streaming proficiency: writing transformation jobs that normalise, enrich, and enforce business rules on event streams. Experience with AWS Glue, Apache Airflow, or Apache NiFi is a strong plus.
* Data modelling discipline: ability to design normalised, multi-tenant schemas where tenant isolation is a filter, not a fork. Experience with data contracts and schema governance.
* CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code experience: automated testing of data pipelines, version-controlled deployments (CloudFormation, Terraform, or CDK), and familiarity with containerised workloads (ECS Fargate or Kubernetes).
* Data quality and observability mindset: experience implementing pipeline health monitoring, automated data validation (Great Expectations or equivalent), freshness checks, and anomaly detection.

****Nice to Have****
* Experience in iGaming, online casino, poker, or sportsbook platforms.
* Exposure to blockchain or crypto-native transaction flows, including on-chain event ingestion, token-denominated accounting, or stablecoin settlement.
* Comfortable operating in an AWS-native environment (MSK, Glue, S3, DynamoDB, ECS, IAM). You understand serverless tradeoffs and can size infrastructure for cost efficiency.
* Feature store experience (SageMaker, Feast, or Tecton) building offline/online feature pipelines that serve ML models at inference time.
* Prior work in regulated industries (financial services, gambling, fintech) where data lineage, auditability, and compliance are non-negotiable.
* Experience migrating legacy query engines (Athena, Trino, Presto) to modern analytical warehouses with reconciliation frameworks to validate correctness.

****How We Work****
* Fully remote with asynchronous-first communication. EU time zone overlap is preferred.
* Small, high-autonomy team within the Data function. You report to the Head of Data and co-ordinate with the AI, BI, and Infrastructure Teams.
* Architecture decisions are documented and debated. You will participate in design reviews and own your domain decisions.
* We build for multi-tenant scale from day one. Every pipeline, schema, and contract you ship must absorb a new operator without engineering effort.
* On-call rotation will be established in the run phase. During the build phase, the focus is velocity with quality. No firefighting legacy systems.

**What kind of culture can I expect?**
 Mature, mission-driven, and low-ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here.

title: Staff Database Engineer
description:
We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.

**Job Description**

**ABOUT US** Managed Sportsbook Services provides end-to-end sportsbook operations, covering risk management and odds provisioning across supported sports and markets. The service ensures continuous operational support for sportsbook activities, enabling stable and consistent delivery of betting services.

**THE CHALLENGE** You will take on a staff, hands-on role within the database team, directly supporting the 24/7 operation of MSS and customer databases. You will be actively involved in the design, administration, and support of database systems across development, test, and production environments.

You’ll be expected to take ownership of complex technical work-resolving incidents, delivering technical implementations, and working closely with engineers, project teams, and stakeholders to ensure robust, secure, and high-performing database services under high transaction volumes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Hands-On Technical Contribution**

* Take ownership of complex database activities including performance tuning, troubleshooting, migrations, and architecture design.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex incidents, including performance degradation, locking and blocking issues, and data integrity problems.
* Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to support critical production systems.
* Promote and apply best practices in database administration, tuning, query optimisation, documentation, and automation.

**Technical Database Management**

* Perform hands-on installation, configuration, tuning, patching, and upgrading of Oracle 12c/18c/19c on Linux and Windows platforms.
* Ensure optimal performance and availability through proactive monitoring and tuning.
* Design, implement, and maintain backup and recovery strategies using RMAN and Data Guard.
* Create and maintain operational documentation and configuration standards.

**Performance Optimisation \\& Query Tuning**

* Analyse and optimise SQL queries using execution plans, AWR/ASH reports, SQL Trace, and Oracle Diagnostics Pack.
* Identify and remediate inefficient SQL, poor indexing strategies, and suboptimal optimizer statistics.
* Investigate and resolve locking, blocking, and deadlock scenarios, including root cause analysis and long-term preventative measures.
* Work with application and engineering teams to improve query design, schema structures, and transaction handling.
* Tune memory structures (SGA/PGA), I/O, and resource usage to support high transaction volumes and low-latency workloads.

**Cloud Technologies (AWS / OCI)**

* Design and implement cloud-based database solutions using AWS RDS and OCI DBaaS.
* Perform hands-on migrations from on-premises to cloud environments using tools such as Oracle GoldenGate.
* Monitor and optimise cloud resource utilisation for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability.

**Security \\& Compliance**

* Implement and maintain database security controls including auditing, encryption, and access management.
* Carry out patching and vulnerability remediation in collaboration with infrastructure and security teams.
* Ensure systems meet compliance and regulatory requirements.

**Monitoring \\& Incident Management**

* Define and track technical KPIs related to database uptime, performance, reliability, and query efficiency.
* Use tools such as Oracle Diagnostics Pack, OEM, Zabbix, and Grafana to monitor system health and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Perform detailed root cause analysis for performance incidents, including SQL regressions, deadlocks, and resource contention.
* Implement permanent fixes and automation to prevent recurrence of operational issues.

**Success will be evaluated by**

* Technical quality and impact of your hands-on contributions.
* Reliability, performance, and availability of database systems.
* Effectiveness in automating database administrative duties, incident handling, change execution, and project delivery.
* Accuracy and completeness of technical documentation and reporting.
* Proactive improvements in system performance and operational stability.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and service continuity.

**ABOUT YOU**

* You’re a senior-level Oracle DBA with strong hands-on experience in Oracle 12c/18c/19c, container/pluggable and autonomous databases, and a track record of delivering in high-availability environments.
* You have experience working collaboratively within DBA or infrastructure teams and supporting less experienced colleagues when needed.
* You thrive in deeply technical roles where you’re actively solving problems and delivering solutions.
* You’re comfortable working across on-prem and cloud platforms, including AWS and Oracle Cloud.
* You have deep knowledge of backup, recovery, security, and performance tuning best practices.
* You're calm under pressure, detail-oriented, and focused on continuous technical improvement.

description:

**Reference:** 
 382_26_ES_EMW_RE2

**Job title:** 
 Workflows Engineer for AI processes (RE2)

**About BSC**
 The Barcelona Supercomputing Center - Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain. It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R\\&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries.

**Look At The BSC Experience**
 BSC-CNS YouTube Channel Let's stay connected with BSC Folks!

We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research. In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under-represented sex will be favoured.

We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences.

If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team.

**Context And Mission**
 Within the Computational Earth Sciences group, the Models and Workflows (MWT) team studies and develops essential frameworks and tools for efficiently running modeling experiments on HPC infrastructures. MWT is a growing team of approximately 30 members, closely collaborating with the Performance, Data, and AI teams, as well as the other scientific groups within the Department.

The successful candidate will contribute to the deployment and development of state-of-the-art external and in-house workflow solutions supporting the complete lifecycle of AI-based scientific workflows, from data preparation and model training to validation, deployment, and reproducible execution. The work will be carried out within European research projects developing next-generation AI-enabled digital twins for climate applications, integrating HPC systems, AI infrastructures, and large-scale data services.

The position offers the opportunity to collaborate with leading European research institutions in the areas of AI, climate science, workflow technologies, and research software engineering.

Learn more on our website: https://bsc.es/research-development/research-areas/computational-earth-sciences/models-and-workflows-team

**Key Duties**
* Develop, maintain, and deploy workflow solutions for AI-driven scientific applications.
* Contribute to the development of reproducible and traceable computational workflows following FAIR principles and research software engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with AI researchers, climate scientists, and software engineers to integrate new AI models into operational workflows.
* Contribute to software testing, continuous integration, documentation, and dissemination of developed technologies.
* Participate in European collaborative research projects and interact with international partners.

**Requirements**
* Education
+ BSc in Computer Science, Computational Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
+ Having a Master’s degree will be valued.

* Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience
+ Experience in scientific software development using Python.
+ Experience deploying and developing workflow solutions for scientific or AI applications.
+ Experience with workflow management systems (e.g. Autosubmit, Airflow, or similar).
+ Experience with AI model lifecycles
+ Experience working with Linux environments and HPC systems.
+ Experience using version control systems (Git) and collaborative software development practices.
+ Experience with container technologies such as Docker or Singularity.
+ Knowledge of software engineering best practices, including testing, documentation, and continuous integration.

* Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience
+ Troubleshooting and debugging skills.
+ Good written and spoken English.
+ Understanding of HPC computer architecture issues, including CPU, accelerators, memory, interconnect, parallel I/O, and computational performance in general.
+ Knowledge of HPC job schedulers (Slurm, PBS or similar).
+ Knowledge of climate or Earth system modelling workflows.
+ Experience participating in European or international research projects.
+ Contributions to open-source software projects.

* Competences
+ Earth system models are sophisticated tools and High-Performance Computers are complex systems. The candidate needs to have excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude to address new challenges and perfect the current solutions so they gain reliability and efficiency.
+ This is a specialized position so the successful candidate is expected to have a demonstrated learning capacity and the motivation to maintain a learning progression during the contract.
+ The candidate will work within international collaborative projects, so it is mandatory to be able to fulfill schedules and coordinate with members from other institutions, as well as disseminate the advances in international workshops.

**Conditions**
* The position will be located at BSC within the Earth Sciences Department
* We offer a full-time contract (35h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state-of-the-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures
* Duration: Open-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration
* Holidays: 22 days of holidays + 6 personal days + 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement
* Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona
* Starting date: ASAP

**Applications procedure and process**
 All applications must be submitted via the BSC website and contain:

* A full CV in English including contact details
* A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered.

**Development of the recruitment process**
 The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases:

* Curriculum Analysis: Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. - 40 points
* Interview phase: The highest-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated. - 60 points. A minimum of 30 points out of 60 must be obtained to be eligible for the position.

The recruitment panel will be composed of at least three people, ensuring at least 25% representation of women.

In accordance with OTM-R principles, a gender-balanced recruitment panel is formed for each vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will begin the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. At a minimum, a personality questionnaire as well as a technical exercise will be conducted during the process.

The panel will make a final decision, and all individuals who participated in the interview phase will receive feedback with details on the acceptance or rejection of their profile.

At BSC, we seek continuous improvement in our recruitment processes. For any suggestions or comments/complaints about our recruitment processes, please contact recruitment@bsc.es.

For more information, please follow this link.

 The vacancy will remain open until a suitable candidate has been hired. Applications will be regularly reviewed and potential candidates will be contacted.

 BSC-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment principles (OTM-R). This is applied for any potential candidate in all our processes, for example by creating gender-balanced recruitment panels and recognizing career breaks etc.

title: Enginyer de dades àrea acompanyament i orientació a l’estudiant
description:
Busques una feina en què el teu talent transformi realment l'entorn? A la UOC, no som només una universitat; som una institució dinàmica, determinada i ambiciosa que impulsa el canvi social i educatiu. Amb més de 30 anys d'història, vam ser la primera universitat
 *online* 
 del món. La nostra missió és generar, transferir i connectar coneixement per construir una societat més crítica, responsable i inconformista.

Uneix-te a l'equip de l’Àrea d’acompanyament i orientació a l’Estudiantat de la UOC. Ens trobem immersos en un procés de transformació profunda del nostre model d’acompanyament i d’atenció a l’estudiantat, amb l’objectiu de fer-lo més eficient, personalitzat i centrat en la millora contínua de l’experiència dels nostres usuaris. Estem implantant Salesforce, redissenyant processos, canals d’atenció i indicadors clau de qualitat.

La persona seleccionada tindrà la missió clau de liderar i transformar les dades estructurades i desestructurades en coneixement institucional propi per optimitzar de manera contínua el model d’acompanyament i d'atenció a l'estudiant de la Universitat.

El perfil actuarà com a motor per a la presa de decisions basada en l'evidència, garantint el rendiment de comptes i desenvolupant capacitats predictives i d'anticipació a les necessitats de la comunitat universitària.

**Quines seran les teves funcions?**

* Gestió del Model de Dades Integral: Definir i liderar el redisseny del model de dades de l’àrea d'Acompanyament i d’Atenció de la Universitat, integrant-lo estretament amb la informació operativa i analítica procedent de la implantació de Salesforce i la comunitat de dades.
